izzyondroid:com.cuscus.wifiaudiostreamin.name: WiFi Audio Streaming
izzyondroid:com.cuscus.wifiaudiostreamin.summary: Stream audio over your local network
izzyondroid:com.cuscus.wifiaudiostreamin.description:
WiFi Audio Streaming is a versatile Android application that allows you to stream audio over your local network. It works as a multi-protocol audio hub: act as a server to capture and send your Android device's audio, or as a client to receive and play audio from another device. With support for standard protocols, you can even stream directly to a web browser or media player.
 Key Features: 
 Multi-Protocol Architecture: Stream using the native low-latency protocol (WFAS v2, now an open, documented specification), standard RTP for media players, or HTTP to listen directly from any web browser (Chrome, Safari, Smart TVs).
 Password Protection & Encryption: Control exactly who can connect with Off, Ask, or Key authorization modes, and optionally encrypt the whole stream end-to-end with ChaCha20-Poly1305.
 Internal Audio Streaming: In Server mode, stream your device's internal audio (apps, games, music) to other devices (requires Android 10+).
 Smart Auto-Connect: Automatically connect to prioritized IP addresses as soon as they are detected on the network, even in the background.
 Automation Ready: Trigger the app with shortcuts, deep links, or NFC tags, and save full server/client configurations as one-tap presets.
 Widgets & Quick Settings: Control your server or client directly from your home screen using interactive widgets, or use the Quick Settings tiles for instant access.
 Automatic & Manual Discovery: Clients automatically find available servers on the local network via a lightweight UDP discovery beacon. Manual IP connections automatically detect if the host is using Unicast or Multicast.
 Unicast & Multicast Support: Stream directly to a single device (Unicast) or to multiple clients simultaneously (Multicast), ideal for multi-room setups.
 Advanced Configuration: Customize sample rate, channels, buffer size, latency and payload size, and manually select your active network interface to bypass VPN routing issues.
 Modern Interface: Rebuilt from the ground up with Jetpack Compose and a full Material 3 Expressive redesign, with dynamic colors and a dedicated Dark Screen mode for OLED displays.
 The project is also available for Windows and Linux! Turn your computer into a wireless audio transmitter, receiver, or web server. Find the desktop version at GitHub and at GitLab .
 The WFAS wire protocol is fully documented and comes with an open-source, dependency-free C99 reference implementation for embedded and firmware projects (ESP32, STM32, RP2040, and more). Find it at GitHub .

izzyondroid:com.dessalines.rankmyfavs.name: Rank-My-Favs
izzyondroid:com.dessalines.rankmyfavs.summary: Rank your favorite things, using simple pair-wise matchups.
izzyondroid:com.dessalines.rankmyfavs.description:
Do you keep lists of your favorite things, such as movies, books, recipes, or music albums? You might keep list(s) that looks like this:
 Network (1976)
 Lone Star (1996)
 Devils (1971)
 The Seventh Seal (1957)
 ... Many more films_h 
 But how do you rank these?
 You might be tempted to order them by preference, but this could quickly get overwhelming for long lists.
 A much easier method is to use pairwise comparisons , which shows you single head-to-head pairs, and has you choose which one you like best.
 After doing a small number of these matchups, Rank-My-Favs can confidently create a ranked list for you.
 Under the hood, Rank-My-Favs can sort by either the win-rate, or the more advanced Glicko rating system.

izzyondroid:com.gero.newpass.name: NewPass
izzyondroid:com.gero.newpass.summary: Securely store and manage passwords of your digital realm with NewPass.
izzyondroid:com.gero.newpass.description:
NewPass is a secure password management application designed to generate and store strong passwords locally on your device. With NewPass, you can create highly secure passwords for your accounts and services without the need to remember them.
 Key Features: 
 Password Generation: NewPass provides a robust password generator that allows you to create complex and secure passwords tailored to your specific requirements. You can customize the length and the character set (Uppercase, Numbers and Special).
 Local Storage: Your passwords are stored locally on your device, ensuring complete privacy and control over your data. NewPass does not store any passwords on external servers, minimizing the risk of unauthorized access (If you uninstall the app, your password are lost!).
 AES Encryption: NewPass encrypts all stored passwords using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode before saving them in the local database.
 SQLite Chiper: NewPass utilizes SQLCipher, an extension for SQLite databases, to bolster security further by encrypting entirely the database, ensuring robust protection against unauthorized access. The encryption key is chosen by the user upon the first launch of the app, and it remains saved and encrypted in an EncryptedSharedPreferences. It is then requested every time the app is launched.
 User-Friendly Interface: NewPass features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, making it easy to generate, view, and manage your passwords. The app offers convenient options for copying passwords to the clipboard and securely sharing them with other applications.

fdroid:com.anopticlabs.gravel.name: Gravel
fdroid:com.anopticlabs.gravel.summary: A de-googled, hardened fork of the Pebble companion app for de-googled phones
fdroid:com.anopticlabs.gravel.description:
Gravel is a de-Googled, hardened fork of the Pebble mobile app by Core Devices, for Pebble and Core Devices watches on GrapheneOS, LineageOS and other phones without Google Play services or Firebase.
The watch features are here: pairing, notifications and replies, calendar, music, health, weather, watchfaces and apps, firmware updates, and voice dictation. What is gone: Play services, Firebase, telemetry, analytics and crash reporting. The battery analytics page depended on that telemetry and has no data here, and upstream's Index AI features do not work.
Hardening:
- Code that watchapps run inside Gravel gets no internet or location access until you grant it, per app, so some watchfaces and apps need a grant before they work fully. On phones where Gravel's UDP filter can't be turned on, such as LineageOS and CalyxOS, watchapps without internet access still run their code by default if Android System WebView is up to date. Their real-time connections (the kind video calls use) then depend on a single layer instead of two. You can turn that code off under Watch App Permissions. With an older WebView, that code does not run
- Classic PebbleKit, which broadcasts watch data to apps on your phone, is off by default; turn it on under Watch App Permissions if a companion app stops receiving watch data
- The speech and text engines each run in an isolated Android process
- Other exported Android interfaces are authorization-gated or removed, and plain-HTTP traffic is blocked
- Core watch firmware comes from the public PebbleOS releases and is verified before install
- App store searches are sent when you tap search, not while you type, with the search provider's analytics switched off
Dictation runs on the phone with whisper.cpp, built from source; the speech model is an optional, integrity-pinned download. You can also send dictation and Notebook recordings to your own transcription server over https. Gravel's own weather is off until you turn it on, and Current Location weather sends a nearby town's position (the largest within 10 km, else the nearest), not the phone's; watchapps you allow online can still get weather from the same server. Weather place search runs on the phone, from a town list built into the app (GeoNames, geonames.org, CC BY 4.0); a place can also be entered by latitude and longitude.
The Notebook stores voice and typed notes and reminders on the phone (Android 9 and newer; voice notes also need a processor that can run both engines). It can also take recordings from a Pebble Index 01 ring (early beta). The text model that writes titles, tags, and a reminder's wording runs on the phone, and so does speech recognition unless you set up a transcription server; the text model is an integrity-pinned download you start yourself. Notes are stored encrypted, and backups are encrypted files written where you choose. A reminder that goes off is shown as a notification and sent to the watch like any other.
Gravel contacts the Core Devices and Rebble web services, Algolia when you search the app store, GitHub for firmware and the Notebook watch app, and Hugging Face when you download a speech or text model, as well as an app store source or transcription server you add yourself and any host a watchapp you grant internet access connects to. Where Gravel's UDP filter can't be turned on and a watchapp without that grant still runs its code (see Hardening above), that code's real-time connections depend on one layer instead of two.
Background location is used so location-based watchapps, and weather once you turn it on, work while the app is closed.
Gravel is not affiliated with or endorsed by Core Devices. "Pebble" and "Core Devices" are trademarks of their respective owners; Gravel is an independent fork of their GPLv3 source code.

fdroid:com.github.samotari.paynoway.name: PayNoWay
fdroid:com.github.samotari.paynoway.summary: Bitcoin wallet app made to test payment systems against double-spend attacks.
fdroid:com.github.samotari.paynoway.description:
Double-spending is no longer a theoretical possibility but a practical reality. Most of the end-user applications used widely today leave their users vulnerable to being defrauded via double-spend attacks. PayNoWay is a tool that you can use to test the applications that you, or your business, depend on to accept on-chain cryptocurrency payments.
Features:
- Send payment transactions with the same UX flow as other wallet applications.
- Easily broadcast double-spend transaction after a payment is sent, to return the funds to the internal wallet address.
- Fetch current network fee rate, or set a custom value.
- Optionally set automatic broadcasting of double-spend transactions.
- Control what happens to the payment transaction output - "Drop it" or "Replace with dust".
- By default double-spend transactions are broadcast to several web services simultaneously to improve chances of confirmation.
- Bitcoin mainnet and testnet networks
- Several address types - Legacy (p2pkh), SegWit backwards compatible, SegWit (bech32).
- Transaction history view where you can re-broadcast any past transaction, copy to clipboard any transaction as raw hexadecimal, or update any locally stored transaction by fetching it from the configured web service.
- Statistics dashboard (Payments vs. Double-spends) which shows total number of transactions as well as their total values. Optionally reset the dashboard at any time.
Disclaimers:
- This app is intended to be used for testing and educational purposes.
- Please do not use this app to double-spend against merchants without their explicit consent.
- A successful double-spend is not guaranteed - use at your own risk.
- You are responsible for creating a backup of your private key(s). Without a backup, if you delete the app or lose your device, your funds will be permanently lost.
Permissions:
- Camera, flashlight - To scan QR codes that contain an on-chain addresses, payment requests, and optionally a private key (WIF) during configuration.
- Access network state - For detecting if the device is offline. This helps provide feedback to you, the user, in case of temporary loss of network connectivity.
- Internet - To query web service APIs to broadcast transactions, fetch minimum relay fee rate, fetch transaction history and unspent transaction outputs.

fdroid:com.siddarthkay.syncup.name: SyncUp
fdroid:com.siddarthkay.syncup.summary: An open-source Syncthing client for iPhone and Android.
fdroid:com.siddarthkay.syncup.description:
An open-source Syncthing client for iPhone and Android, powered by the Syncthing daemon via gomobile.
Syncthing's official Android client was archived in December 2024. No single client ran on both phones from one codebase, so this one was built. The daemon runs in-process via gomobile, with a React Native UI scaffolded from react-native-go.
Differences from other clients:
Daemon runs in-process on Android. The Go daemon lives inside the app via gomobile. There is no subprocess to manage, no IPC between a background service and the UI, and no service-restart handling.
Auto-accept folders from trusted peers. When you add a peer, you can toggle auto-accept so any folder they share is added to your device automatically without a prompt. Other pending offers show up as accept/ignore cards in the Folders tab.
QR pairing works both ways. Display your device's QR for a peer to scan, or scan theirs. The 56-character device ID never needs to be typed by hand.
UI updates in near real time. Long-polling /rest/events means config changes, folder state, and incoming offers reach the UI in about a second, instead of on a polling interval.

fdroid:com.sidhant.triplematch.name: Triple Match
fdroid:com.sidhant.triplematch.summary: A minimal, open-source 3D tile-matching puzzle game.
fdroid:com.sidhant.triplematch.description:
Triple Match is a minimal, open-source 3D tile-matching puzzle game.
Privacy-First:
Triple Match is designed to respect user privacy unconditionally. It collects no data, contains no trackers, and works 100% offline.
- No Telemetry or Tracking: Zero analytics, crash reporters, tracking SDKs, or device identifiers.
- No Accounts or Sign-ins: No account creation, email capture, or profile requirement. Just open and play.
- 100% Offline Play: Operates entirely on-device without internet access. No server dependencies.
- Zero Ads: No ad networks, tracking beacons, or cross-site fingerprinting scripts.
- Local-Only Storage: Game progress and settings are stored locally on your device. Data never leaves your hardware.
- Transparent and Open Source: Clean, inspectable codebase with minimal dependencies. No hidden data collection routines.

fdroid:com.simpol.permissionssummary.name: Permissions Summary
fdroid:com.simpol.permissionssummary.summary: List which apps have access to sensitive permissions on your device
fdroid:com.simpol.permissionssummary.description:
Permission Summary is a lightweight, open source Android app that helps you quickly check which apps have access to sensitive permissions on your device — in just a few seconds.
 The app only lists user-installed apps and only those with dangerous permissions. These are permissions Android classifies as potentially privacy-invasive and require explicit runtime approval.
 Permissions Checked: 
 Camera — Access to your device's camera
 Microphone — Record audio
 Location — Fine & coarse location (GPS, Wi-Fi, etc.)
 Storage — Access to files, media, photos, or music
 Contacts — Read, write, or access contact data and accounts
 Calendar — Read or write calendar events
 Phone / Call Log — Read phone state, call logs, answer calls, etc.
 SMS — Send or receive SMS, MMS, and WAP push messages
 Body Sensors — Access data from heart rate, step counter, etc.
 Non-dangerous permissions like INTERNET , POST_NOTIFICATIONS , and BLUETOOTH are intentionally excluded to reduce noise.
 Features: 
 🔐 Grouped by Permission — Instantly see which apps request access to camera, mic, contacts, etc.
 🧼 User Apps Only — Filters out system apps and background clutter.
 🚫 Focus on Privacy — Shows only dangerous permissions and skips non-sensitive ones.
 📱 Modern UI — Built entirely with Jetpack Compose and Material 3.
 ⚡ Fast & Lightweight — Optimized for quick, offline use. No trackers, no nonsense.
 Privacy: Everything runs locally on-device and offline. No personal data is collected or shared.

apple-itunes:953286746.name: Darkroom: Photo & Video Editor
apple-itunes:953286746.description:
Transform your iPhone and iPad into a powerful editing suite with Darkroom, the award-winning photo and video editor designed for both aspiring photographers and professional creators. With desktop-quality tools at your fingertips, Darkroom rivals Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop — delivering a pro editing experience right on your mobile device.

Apple Design Award Winner 2020
App Store Best New App 2015
Why Choose Darkroom?
Advanced AI-Powered Editing: Harness cutting-edge AI tools for precise, depth-based edits and intelligent object detection. Enhance skies, skin tones, and landscapes with unmatched accuracy — or let AI-powered presets analyze your photo and optimize color and exposure in one tap.

RAW & ProRAW Support: Import and edit RAW and Apple ProRAW files at full fidelity. Every edit is non-destructive, so you can undo any adjustment at any time. Darkroom works directly with your Apple Photos library — no importing, no exporting, no friction.
Professional Tools for Every Creator:

Built for iPhone Photographers: With deep iOS integration — Shortcuts, widgets, iCloud sync, and seamless Apple Photos access — Darkroom stands out as the premier editing tool for mobile photographers. A fast, gesture-driven interface makes pro editing feel effortless.
Praise from Experts:
"Darkroom is one of the best apps around, offering extensive support for RAW and ProRAW photos and capabilities to batch edit photos with ease." — The Verge
"Its iPhone-specific features make Darkroom the leading editing app for iPhone photographers." — The Sweet Setup
Seamless Organization and Sharing:

flathub:com.yutovo.yutovo.name: Yutovo
flathub:com.yutovo.yutovo.summary: Visual calculator inside a text editor
flathub:com.yutovo.yutovo.description:
Yutovo is an application for solving various mathematical problems. Yutovo has a visual "paper" view for calculations. It uses a generally accepted mathematical syntax to display formulas. Yutovo is designed to solve everyday and engineering problems and can be used by different people and for different jobs.
 Graphical representation of mathematical formulas
 Math WYSIWYG editor
 Numbers and calculation results can have (almost) any number of digits and accuracy
 Following types of numbers are supported: real, integer, fractional, complex
 Measure of an angle can be changed
 Commonly used mathematical functions and constants are supported
 User variables and functions are supported
 Units, unit systems and translating values between them are supported
 Automatic recalculation of expressions
 Symbolic calculations
 Text editor with basic features
 Include documents
 Graphs of functions
 Syntax highlighting
 Library of examples and visual documentation
 Online version with the same features

flathub:io.github.ashbuk.dabri.name: Dabri
flathub:io.github.ashbuk.dabri.description:
A minimalist, privacy-focused desktop application for offline speech-to-text. Converts voice
 input directly into any active window (editors, browsers, IDEs, AI assistants) using Whisper or
 NVIDIA Parakeet models locally for speech recognition.
 For system tray integration on GNOME and automatic typing on Wayland, see the Desktop Environment
 Support Guide.
 Features:
 Offline speech-to-text, privacy-first: all processing happens locally
 Portable AppImage and Flatpak packages
 Cross-platform support for X11 and Wayland
 Linux desktop integration with GNOME, KDE, and others
 GPU and CPU support with Vulkan acceleration and CPU fallback
 Voice typing or clipboard mode
 Flexible audio recording with ALSA or PulseAudio/PipeWire
 Multi-language support, custom hotkey binding, visual notifications
 Model management: switch between Whisper models (base, small, medium, large-v3-turbo, large-v3),
 NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and Parakeet Ultra via tray or CLI

flathub:io.github.josephmawa.EncodingExp.name: Encoding Explorer
flathub:io.github.josephmawa.EncodingExp.description:
Encoding Explorer is a tool for learning character encoding. Below are the main features:
 Encode characters to ASCII, UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32
 Encode numbers to IEEE-754 half, single, and double precision format
 Supports real-time encoding
 Change the endianness of a multi-byte encoding
 Provides user-friendly interface for exploring encodings
 Switch to light, dark, or system mode

flathub:io.github.sitraorg.sitra.name: Sitra
flathub:io.github.sitraorg.sitra.description:
Get your fonts from online sources with a sleek, friendly user interface.
 Sitra provides a seamless experience for installing, uninstalling and previewing fonts.
 List fonts available on Google Fonts
 Preview the fonts using Fontsource CDN for privacy
 Get code to use the font in your project, via CDN or npm from fontsource
 Download the fonts on your device in ttf format from google
 Filter font by category using the toggle buttons or by family and subset using search

flathub:io.gitlab.elescoute.password.name: Password
flathub:io.gitlab.elescoute.password.description:
Password is a password calculator and random generator for Gnome written in Gtk/Vala.
 This app calculates strong unique passwords for each alias and passphrase combination.
 No need to remember dozens of passwords any longer and no need for a password manager!
 The calculator can use MD5, SHA1, SHA256 and SHA512 hash algorithms in combination with HMAC.
 Compatible with Linux Phone using Phosh (PinePhone, Librem 5).

flathub:net.unvanquished.Unvanquished.name: Unvanquished
flathub:net.unvanquished.Unvanquished.summary: Fast paced, first person strategy game
flathub:net.unvanquished.Unvanquished.description:
Unvanquished is a real-time strategy game played as a first-person
 shooter where evolving aliens and heavily armed humans fight for
 their survival.
 Become a marine, handle your big weapon and dress that
 impressive exoskeleton to save the human race like a boss. Or if
 you prefer, be a monstrous beast and save those cute grangers
 from those two-legged invaders who only know how to turn
 beautiful organic equilibrium into lifeless machines and dead
 concreted worlds.
 Unvanquished is an actively maintained evolution of the Tremulous game,
 based on the Dæmon game engine with 20 years of development added to
 the Tremulous gameplay and the Quake 3 engine.
 Unvanquished is an actively maintained evolution of the Tremulous game,
 based on the Dæmon game engine, result of 20 years of development added
 to the Tremulous gameplay and the Quake 3 engine.

flathub:net.werwolv.ImHex.name: ImHex
flathub:net.werwolv.ImHex.description:
ImHex is a modern Hex Editor for Reverse Engineers, Developers, Malware Analysists and Hackers who value
 their retinas when working at 3 AM once again.
 Features:
 Featureful hex view
 Custom C++-like pattern language for parsing and highlighting a file's content
 Data importing and exporting
 Data inspector allowing interpretation of data as many different types
 Huge file support with fast and efficient loading
 Strings search
 File hashing support
 Disassembler supporting many different architectures: ARM, x86, PowerPC, MIPS, and more
 Bookmarks
 Data analyzer
 Helpful tools such as an Itanium and MSVC demangler, ASCII table, Regex
 replacer, mathematical expression evaluator (calculator), hexadecimal
 color picker and many more
 Doesn't burn out your retinas when used in late-night sessions

flathub:org.gimp.GIMP.name: GNU Image Manipulation Program
flathub:org.gimp.GIMP.description:
GIMP is an acronym for GNU Image Manipulation Program. It is Community-driven Free Software
 for high-end image creation and manipulation.
 It has many capabilities. It can be used as a paint program, an expert quality photo retouching
 program, image composition, an online batch processing system, a mass production image renderer,
 an image format converter, etc.
 GIMP is expandable and extensible. It is designed to be augmented with plug-ins and extensions
 to do just about anything. The advanced scripting interface allows everything from the simplest
 task to the most complex image manipulation procedures to be easily scripted. GIMP is available
 for Linux, Microsoft Windows and macOS.

fedora-packages:cxsc/cxsc.name: cxsc

fedora-packages:cxsc/cxsc.description: C-XSC is the C language variant of the XSC (eXtensions for Scientific Computing) project. It provides routines that guarantee accuracy and reliability of results. Problem-solving routines with automatic result verification have been developed for many standard problems of numerical analysis, such as linear or nonlinear systems of equations, differential and integral equations, etc. as well as for a large number of applications in engineering and the natural sciences. Some of the features of C-XSC are: - Operator concept (user-defined operators) - Overloading concept - Module concept - Dynamic arrays - Controlled rounding - Predefined arithmetic data types real, extended real, complex, interval, complex interval, and corresponding vector and matrix types - Predefined arithmetic operators and elementary functions of the highest accuracy for the arithmetic data types - Data type dotprecision for the exact representation of dot products - Library of mathematical problem-solving routines with automatic result verification and high accuracy

fedora-packages:fbthrift/fbthrift-devel.name: fbthrift-devel
fedora-packages:fbthrift/fbthrift-devel.description: Thrift is a serialization and RPC framework for service communication. Thrift enables these features in all major languages, and there is strong support for C++, Python, Hack, and Java. Most services at Facebook are written using Thrift for RPC, and some storage systems use Thrift for serializing records on disk. Facebook Thrift is not a distribution of Apache Thrift. This is an evolved internal branch of Thrift that Facebook re-released to open source community in February 2014. Facebook Thrift was originally released closely tracking Apache Thrift but is now evolving in new directions. In particular, the compiler was rewritten from scratch and the new implementation features a fully asynchronous Thrift server. The fbthrift-devel package contains libraries and header files for developing applications that use fbthrift.

fedora-packages:gfs-philostratos-fonts/g.name: gfs-philostratos-fonts
fedora-packages:gfs-philostratos-fonts/g.summary: GFS Philostratos, a 19th century Greek revival of Griechische Antiqua
fedora-packages:gfs-philostratos-fonts/g.description: Griechische Antiqua was one of the historical Greek typefaces of the late 19th and early 20th century. It was designed by Μaurice Εduard Pinder, a German erudite artist and a member of the Academy of Science in Berlin. This is the most popular version which has appeared from 1870 to 1940 in the German speaking philological literature and in many classical and Byzantine editions by publishers like Teubner (in Leipzig) and Weidmann (in Berlin) such as: Anthology of Byzantine Melos by Wilhelm von Christ and Matthaios Paranikas (Leipzig 1871), Epicurea, by Heinrich Usener (Leipzig 1887), Mitrodorous by Alfred Koerte (Leipzig 1890), Pindar by Otto Schroeder (Leipzig 1908), του Aeschylus by U. von Wilamowitz-Moellendorff (Berlin 1910, 1915), Bachylides by Bruno Snell (Leipzig, 1934), The Vulgata by Alfred Rahlfs (Stuttgart 1935), Suidas Lexicon by Ada Adler (Leipzig 1928-1938) etc. E.J. Kenney lamented the abandonment of the type after the 2nd World War as a great loss for Greek typography (“From Script to Print”, Greek Scripts: An illustrated Introduction, Society for the Promotion of Hellenic Studies, 2001, p. 69). GFS Philostratos was digitized by George D. Matthiopoulos.

fedora-packages:glpk/glpk.name: glpk

The GLPK package includes the following main components: * Revised simplex method. * Primal-dual interior point method. * Branch-and-bound method. * Translator for GNU MathProg. * Application program interface (API). * Stand-alone LP/MIP solver.

fedora-packages:python-steps/python3-ste.name: python3-steps-mpich
fedora-packages:python-steps/python3-ste.description: STEPS is a package for exact stochastic simulation of reaction-diffusion systems in arbitrarily complex 3D geometries. Our core simulation algorithm is an implementation of Gillespie's SSA, extended to deal with diffusion of molecules over the elements of a 3D tetrahedral mesh. While it was mainly developed for simulating detailed models of neuronal signaling pathways in dendrites and around synapses, it is a general tool and can be used for studying any biochemical pathway in which spatial gradients and morphology are thought to play a role. STEPS also supports accurate and efficient computational of local membrane potentials on tetrahedral meshes, with the addition of voltage-gated channels and currents. Tight integration between the reaction-diffusion calculations and the tetrahedral mesh potentials allows detailed coupling between molecular activity and local electrical excitability. We have implemented STEPS as a set of Python modules, which means STEPS users can use Python scripts to control all aspects of setting up the model, generating a mesh, controlling the simulation and generating and analyzing output. The core computational routines are still implemented as C/C++ extension modules for maximal speed of execution. STEPS 3.0.0 and above provide early parallel solution for stochastic spatial reaction-diffusion and electric field simulation. Documentation can be found here: http://steps.sourceforge.net/manual/manual_index.html

fedora-packages:qatzip/qatzip.name: qatzip
fedora-packages:qatzip/qatzip.description: QATzip is a user space library which builds on top of the Intel QuickAssist Technology user space library, to provide extended accelerated compression and decompression services by offloading the actual compression and decompression request(s) to the Intel Chipset Series. QATzip produces data using the standard gzip* format (RFC1952) with extended headers. The data can be decompressed with a compliant gzip* implementation. QATzip is designed to take full advantage of the performance provided by Intel QuickAssist Technology.

firefox-addons:2756539.summary: 2FAS Auth Browser Extension is simple, private, and secured: one click, one tap, and your 2FA token is automatically entered!
firefox-addons:2756539.description:
2FAS Auth Browser Extension is simple, private, and secure: 1 click, 1 tap, and your token is automatically entered!
Add 2FAS Auth to your web browser with our extension! Enter 2FA tokens automatically without re-typing for better security!
The 2FAS Auth Browser Extension allows you to log in to any online service with 2-factor authentication enabled, faster! 
Easy set up in three steps:
1. Install the extension on your desktop browser
2. Open the 2FAS Auth app on your phone and pair your phone with your desktop browser
3. Start using the 2FAS Auth Browser Extension
When you want to log in using a 2FA token, simply select two-factor authentication token input field, click the 2FAS Auth Browser Extension icon, and confirm login on your phone!
Secure and fast log in.
Simply pair the service you want to login to with your 2FAS Auth app, then 2FAS Auth will automatically select your token for future logins, no searching or typing required!
Free access — no account required.
2FAS Auth is an easy-to-use authentication app that protects access to your online services and accounts. 
Relying on a single password for your personal accounts, like Facebook or Instagram, often puts your data and sensitive information at risk. 
The 2FAS Authenticator App generates one-time codes called Time-based One-time Passwords (TOTP) or HMAC-based (event-based) One-time Passwords (HOTP) for your account. By creating these codes offline and changing them every 30 seconds or every login, 2FAS drastically increases the security of your information.

bluejetty:00089503:ios.description:
Mood Tracker / Year in Pixels / Diary / Habits / Gratitude Journal / Routines / Photo Album / Sleep - Everything you need to improve your mental health in only ONE app.
Moodflow is a FREE app that captures your emotions, moods, thoughts, and general well-being. Also, Moodflow goes along with you throughout your life, and gives you a more profound understanding of yourself, not previously known to you. Ultimately, this will allow you to improve your mental health and help you become a better you.
## HOW DOES MOODFLOW WORK? ##
You do not even need to write anything down to get a meaningful insight or to keep a diary.
This is how easy Moodflow works:
Fill out a quick survey every day and gain insight into the WHAT and HOW it influences you over time.
◆ 1. Pick a rating for the day from 1 to 5.
◆ 2. Pick the emotions you experienced.
◆ 3. (optional) Write a note about everything relevant from the day.
◆ 4. (optional) Pick the activities you were involved in.
◆ 5. DONE! 
## WHAT WILL THIS DATA DO FOR ME? ##
As time goes by, these short entries will gather insightful data about yourself that you will be able to analyze in many ways. On the one hand, a Calendar will be filled with colors that reflect your emotional well-being. This will allow you to get an eagle-eye perspective on your life that you never had before. On the other hand, Moodflow comes with data-analyzing tools, that will help you find relationships between a plethora of different factors and your mood. Moodflow will help you understand yourself better by allowing you to identify the things that bring you up or those that pull you down.
## WHAT ELSE CAN MOODFLOW OFFER? ##
Additionally, Moodflow encourages you to develop better habits by including 28-day challenges. These challenges have different levels of difficulty and will ensure that you create simple but powerful habits. As some have claimed: "We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence is therefore not an act, but a habit".
More features? We have them!
◆ Multiple entries per day: Our mood fluctuates throughout the day. Therefore, you should be able to make as many entries as you want.
◆ No annoying ads: Support the app by watching an advertisement. But only if you want to.
◆ Gratitude Journal: Write something you are grateful for every day and benefit from the power of gratitude.
◆ Routines: Use Moodflows in-built Routine planner to create your perfect routine and keep track of it. Step by step!
◆ Statistics & Insight: Find relationships between multiple factors and your well-being with the multitude of charts offered.
◆ Journal mode: Read all your entries at once as you would in a conventional journal.
◆ Customize everything: Moodflow is a very personal app, this is why we give you the freedom of personalizing almost anything! 
◆ Color Editor: Create your own color palettes from scratch. Millions of possibilities!
◆ Background: Make Moodflow your personal app by even personalizing the background video or image.
◆ And a lot more!
▶ Download Moodflow Now! ◀
It is FREE and always will be.

The ParkLouie app, powered by ParkMobile, provides a convenient way to pay for parking in St. Louis, Missouri, using your mobile phone. Registering is free and takes less than two minutes to join. The ParkLouie app takes the stress out of parking. No more searching for coins. No worries about an out-of-service parking meter. With the ParkLouie app, starting your parking session takes just a few seconds. You can use the app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, Houston, Minneapolis, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, and more.
Why Use ParkLouie?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Find areas of the city where there is available parking and avoid areas where there’s no parking
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the ParkLouie and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the ParkLouie app
Find out more about ParkLouie by visiting www.parklouie.com.
How It Works
On-Street and Off-Street Parking:
• Enter the zone number on the posted signs around the meter
• Select the amount of time you want to park and confirm your information
• Touch the “Start Parking” button to begin your parking session
• Extend time in the app if you are running late
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find my car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked
• Multiple payment methods available
• Parking Availability feature shows streets with open parking spots in your area
About ParkMobile
ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider of parking payment solutions in the United States, helping over 40 million people easily find, reserve, and pay for parking from their mobile devices.
Looking for Help?
At ParkMobile, we’re serious about customer service. We process nearly 500,000 parking transactions every day and we know that every now and then, something might go wrong. If you have an issue, we will do everything we can to make it right. Our customer service is 24/7/365. If you need help, here’s how to get in touch with us:
Web: https://ParkMobile.io/
Online Help Center: https://support.ParkMobile.io/hc/en-us/requests/new
Video Tutorials: https://ParkMobile.io/tips-demos/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ParkMobile
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParkMobile/

bluejetty:00126512:ios.description:
L’App WINDTRE è Connessioni, Energia e Assicurazioni. È il modo più facile e veloce per controllare e personalizzare tutte le tue offerte.
L’App WINDTRE è anche Please don't call: il servizio GRATUITO che individua e segnala le possibili chiamate indesiderate proteggendo il tuo numero dallo Spam. Sarai tu a scegliere se rispondere!
Accedi a WINDTRE in qualsiasi momento, sotto copertura mobile o in Wi-Fi, per controllare la quantità di GIGA rimasti, minuti ed SMS disponibili e con un semplice tap aggiungi quello che ti serve. 
Con l’App WINDTRE puoi:
• Gestire le offerte di WINDTRE Luce&Gas: bolletta semplice, energia green e prezzo esclusivo per i Clienti
• Scoprire le polizze assicurative distribuite da Wind Tre S.p.A
• Ricaricare il tuo numero o quello dei tuoi amici in totale sicurezza, e scegliere il metodo di pagamento che preferisci tra carta di credito o PayPal. Attiva Autoricarica per non rimanere senza credito
• Personalizzare il tuo piano telefonico nella sezione OFFERTE: aggiungi GIGA, minuti ed SMS o attiva una nuova offerta (anche per l’estero)
• Gestire, in base al modello del modem*, la tua rete domestica: controlla lo stato della connessione internet e la velocità in upload/download, visualizza i dispositivi connessi alla rete e personalizza la rete Wi-Fi.
• Accedere al programma WINDAY, che ti premia con vantaggi, sconti e promozioni tutti i giorni (Apple non è uno sponsor)
• Attraverso la sezione Hub Servizi, acquistare servizi digitali, come ad esempio Google One
• Visualizzare il negozio di riferimento o scegliere quello che preferisci
• Contattarci in CHAT! Tutto il supporto di cui hai bisogno grazie all’assistente digitale WILL ed al nostro team di consulenti
• Controllare tutte le tue linee mobili e fisse e visualizzare, nella sezione LISTA MOVIMENTI, il traffico effettuato, gli addebiti e le ricariche fatte
• Consultare e pagare le fatture emesse
• Acquistare in qualsiasi momento i biglietti per i trasporti pubblici pagando con il credito telefonico
• Attivare le notifiche e la geolocalizzazione per ricevere promozioni e vantaggi esclusivi in tempo reale
Per essere sicuro di non perdere le ultime novità e le ultime offerte, ricordati di scaricare sempre l’ultima versione aggiornata dell’App.
Hai un suggerimento o una segnalazione? Scrivi a windtre.ios@app.windtre.it
Condizioni generali di utilizzo disponibili su www.windtre.it/tec-app-windtre-lug22/ 
Dichiarazione di accessibilità: https://ac.windtre.it/accessibility/declaration

bluejetty:00084213:ios.name: MultiPolls: Earn Real Money
bluejetty:00084213:ios.summary:
MultiPolls is a survey app designed for people who want a simple, reliable way to earn extra money by completing surveys that are relevant to them.
MultiPolls allows users to earn cash by taking paid surveys in their spare time, without ad
bluejetty:00084213:ios.description:
MultiPolls is a survey app designed for people who want a simple, reliable way to earn extra money by completing surveys that are relevant to them.
MultiPolls allows users to earn cash by taking paid surveys in their spare time, without ads, distractions, or unnecessary features. The app focuses entirely on surveys and rewards, making it easy to understand how it works and what to expect. Whether you have a few minutes during a break or more time at home, MultiPolls lets you complete surveys when it fits your schedule.
One of the biggest frustrations with many survey apps is spending time answering screening questions only to be disqualified. MultiPolls is built to reduce that problem by prioritizing relevance. The app uses artificial intelligence to match users with surveys that fit their profile, interests, and background.
Instead of showing every available survey, MultiPolls searches through thousands of survey opportunities and selects those that are more likely to be a good match. As you complete surveys and keep your profile up to date, the app continues to improve its recommendations. Over time, this helps users qualify for more surveys and spend less time on surveys that lead nowhere. When you are ready to cash out, you can withdraw your earnings directly to your PayPal account. This allows you to use your money however you choose, whether for everyday expenses or personal purchases.
Gift cards are also available based on availability. Popular options include Amazon gift cards and other major retailers. The reward system is straightforward, and the cash-out process is designed to be simple and predictable, without hidden conditions or complicated steps.
MultiPolls is intentionally simple. The app does not include ads, games, or unrelated content. Everything is centered around surveys, earnings, and account activity. The interface is clean and easy to navigate, making it accessible for both new users and people who have experience with other survey apps.
Users can clearly see available surveys, completed surveys, and reward activity. Upcoming features will expand this further by allowing users to track progress over time, review survey history, and manage cash-out requests directly in the app.
Your profile plays an important role in the surveys you receive. MultiPolls includes tools that allow users to keep their information accurate and up to date. Life changes such as a new job, relocation, or family updates can affect the types of surveys you qualify for.
With profile management features, users can update this information so the app can continue to deliver surveys that are a good fit. This helps improve matching quality and increases the likelihood of receiving surveys that pay well and match your situation.
MultiPolls is designed for users who want a focused survey experience. If you have used other survey or rewards apps such as Qmee Surveys, Survey Junkie, Zap Surveys, AttaPoll, Eureka Surveys, InboxDollars, Prime Opinion, VETRI, or Swagbucks, you may appreciate the simplicity and clarity of MultiPolls.
Rather than offering a wide range of unrelated features, MultiPolls concentrates on surveys, matching quality, and reliable payouts. This makes it a strong option for users looking for a survey app with PayPal payouts and fewer distractions.
MultiPolls is suitable for anyone who wants to earn extra cash in a flexible way. Surveys can be completed anytime and anywhere, making the app useful for students, professionals, parents, or anyone looking for a side income option that fits around their schedule.
Whether you want to earn a small amount during short breaks or build consistent rewards over time, MultiPolls adapts to how you use it.
Download MultiPolls and start earning money with paid surveys that match your profile. 
Privacy policy: https://www.multi-polls.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00080927:ios.summary: Create passport photos, visa photos, ID photos, and 2x2 photos from your iPhone in minutes. Passport Photo Maker & Editor helps you take or import a picture, remove the background, crop to the right shape, resize for common document photo f
bluejetty:00080927:ios.description:
Create passport photos, visa photos, ID photos, and 2x2 photos from your iPhone in minutes. Passport Photo Maker & Editor helps you take or import a picture, remove the background, crop to the right shape, resize for common document photo formats, and save, share, or print your result at home.
Need a US passport photo, visa photo, green card photo, DV Lottery photo, passport picture, or ID card photo? Start with a camera photo, gallery image, or iCloud file. The app guides you through a simple passport photo editor workflow so you can make a clean, printable document photo without a photo booth.
Why use Passport Photo Maker & Editor?
- Passport photo maker for common document photo sizes, including 2x2 photo layouts
- Visa photo and ID photo maker for travel, forms, school, work, and profile documents
- Automatic background removal to create a clean passport-style photo
- Background color options, including white, light gray, and custom colors
- Crop, resize, zoom, and position your photo with simple editing controls
- Photo filters and adjustments for a clearer final image
- Download to Photos, share as an image, or print passport photos at home
- Print multiple copies on one page to save time and paper
- Works with photos from camera, iPhone gallery, or iCloud
A better way to make document photos
Photo booths can be expensive and inconvenient. Manual editing can be slow. Passport Photo Maker & Editor gives you a focused passport photo app for creating printable ID photos, visa pictures, passport size photos, and application photos whenever you need them.
Use it for:
- Passport photo and passport picture editing
- Visa photo, eVisa photo, and travel document photos
- ID photo maker and ID card photo needs
- Green card photo and DV Lottery photo preparation
- 2x2 photo creation for common document formats
- Print-at-home passport photos and ID photos
How it works:
1. Take a new photo or import one from your gallery or iCloud.
2. Remove the background and choose a clean background color.
3. Resize, crop, zoom, and position the image.
4. Save, share, or print your passport photo at home.
Passport Photo Maker & Editor is built for people who want a fast, simple, practical way to create passport photos, visa photos, ID photos, and printable document photos from their phone.
Privacy Policy: https://www.appnursery.com/privacy/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00036026:ios.description:
aiMail is an AI-powered email writing assistant designed for corporate professionals, sales teams, and students. Powered by advanced Artificial Intelligence, aiMail helps you draft, proofread, and translate professional emails in seconds to save time, avoid typos, and overcome writer's block.
>> Core Use Cases & How aiMail Helps You:
• Sales Pitches & Client Communication: Generate persuasive business emails and follow-ups using formal tone templates to help you close deals faster.
• Job Applications & Career Networking: Instantly draft highly professional cover letters, networking outreach, and interview responses to stand out to recruiters.
• Global Networking: Break language barriers by translating and generating emails across multiple languages (including English, Spanish, French, German, and Japanese) to communicate effortlessly with international clients.
• On-the-Go Drafting: Dictate your thoughts via voice notes. aiMail will analyze your voice and structure it into a polished, ready-to-send email, perfect for busy commutes.
>> Key Features & Outcomes:
• Smart Grammar & Spell Check: Acts as your built-in proofreader, automatically detecting and correcting mistakes so you always sound polished and confident.
• Adjustable Tone & Style: Tailor your message to fit any specific situation—from formal and persuasive for business, to friendly and casual for personal connections.
• Direct Email Integration: Seamlessly connect with your favorite mail clients (Gmail, Apple Mail, Outlook, etc.) to send your newly drafted emails directly from the aiMail interface without switching apps.
>> Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ):
• What is aiMail used for? 
aiMail is used to write, edit, format, and translate both professional and personal emails quickly using AI.
• Can I send emails directly from aiMail? 
Yes, aiMail connects seamlessly with existing mail clients like Gmail, Apple Mail, and Outlook, allowing you to send drafted emails directly from the app.
• Does aiMail fix grammar mistakes? 
Yes, it features a smart grammar and spell-checker that automatically corrects typos and polishes your writing before you hit send.
• Is aiMail suitable for personal use? 
Absolutely. You can easily adjust the AI's writing tone from formal business language to friendly, casual phrasing for friends and family.
Rated 4.8/5 by 100k+ professionals worldwide, aiMail is your trusted assistant for efficient, clear, and confident communication.
Need help or have feedback? We'd love to hear from you at contact@presbtech.com
Please read the Terms of Use: https://4email.presbtech.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00062620:ios.description:
Keep your mind sharp and agile with Quick Brain! Discover a more engaging way to boost your cognitive abilities. Quick Brain isn't just about numbers; it’s a personal space for your mind to stay active, focused, and resilient. By blending simple arithmetic with creative puzzles, we’ve created a workout for your brain that feels like a game, not a chore.
A complete cognitive toolkit in one app:
By providing essential mental stimulation, our app helps you improve your memory and maintain a quick mind in your daily life.
UNLOCK YOUR MENTAL POTENTIAL
Quick Brain is a universal platform designed to support your intellectual growth. Regular sessions help you navigate complex tasks with ease by enhancing:
• Logic and Problem-Solving: Develop the ability to see patterns and find solutions faster.
• Memory and Concentration: Strengthen your focus and keep your mind from wandering.
• Thinking Speed: Train your brain to process information more efficiently under pressure.
• Mental Flexibility: Learn to switch between different types of tasks without losing momentum.
EXPLORE OUR PRACTICE MODES
We offer a variety of challenges to keep your training diverse and exciting:
• Strategic Puzzles: Classic 2048 and Sudoku to improve your foresight and planning. 
• Logic and Spatial Games: Matches and Connect Dots for non-standard thinking. 
• Reaction Drills: Quick Math and True/False modes to sharpen your instincts. 
• Custom Training: Adjust sessions to focus on what you need today. 
• Balance Mode: A dedicated space for testing your mental balance and accuracy.
Your journey starts with simple tasks that gradually adapt to your skill level. Studies show that engaging in rapid mental exercises activates the brain regions responsible for logic and memory. Just 5 minutes a day can help you build a lasting habit of mental clarity and confidence. It’s the perfect mindful break for a busy day.

bluejetty:00120579:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120579:ios.description:
SkySafari 8 is a powerful planetarium that fits in your pocket, puts the universe at your fingertips, and is incredibly easy to use!
Simply hold your device to the sky and quickly locate comets, planets, constellations, satellites, and millions of stars and deep sky objects. Whether you are a beginner or a longtime astronomy enthusiast, SkySafari 8 is your perfect stargazing companion, packed with interactive information, rich graphics, and a beautifully refined interface.
What’s New in Version 8
+ New Theme - A new look of the app with a fresh visual palette.
+ Image Gallery - Explore the universe through astrophotography. Import images directly from AstroBin.
+ Sky Tonight - Jump to the new Tonight section to see what’s visible in your sky right now. Expanded information has been designed to help plan your night and includes Moon & Sun info, calendar curations, and the best positioned deep sky and solar system objects.
If you're new to SkySafari 8, here’s what you can do:
+ Point & Identify - Hold your device to the sky and instantly identify stars, constellations, planets, satellites, and more. The chart updates automatically with your movements.
+ OneSky - See what other users are observing in real-time. This feature highlights objects in the sky chart and indicates how many users are looking at them.
+ Orbit Mode - Lift off from Earth and travel to the planets, moons, and stars.
+ Guided Audio Tours - Listen to more than four hours of audio narration to learn the history, mythology, and science of the heavens.
+ Pronunciation Guide - Learn how to correctly pronounce the names of hundreds of celestial objects, from stars to constellations and planets.
+ Simulate the Sky - See an eclipse in the past or future! Simulate the night sky from anywhere on Earth many years backward or forward in time.
+ Night Vision - Preserve your eyesight after dark.
SkySafari Premium Subscription Unlock amazing features with the optional Premium Subscription, including:
+ Massive Database - Access a massive deep sky database.
+ Custom Image Import - Upload and manage your own astrophotography images in the Image Gallery and show them in the sky chart. 
+ Enhanced Tools - Access curated news, events, connected stargazing features, a light pollution map, and more.
For telescope control and even more advanced features, check out SkySafari 8 Plus and SkySafari 8 Pro!

bluejetty:00121317:ios.name: Food Truck Chef™: Cooking Game
bluejetty:00121317:ios.summary: Looking for a fun cooking game for 2026 that you can play offline? Cook, serve and travel the world in Food Truck Chef™, the food truck simulator and cooking game where every street brings new dishes to master! Join Chef Emily, fire up the
bluejetty:00121317:ios.description:
Looking for a fun cooking game for 2026 that you can play offline? Cook, serve and travel the world in Food Truck Chef™, the food truck simulator and cooking game where every street brings new dishes to master! Join Chef Emily, fire up the grill and turn a little food truck into a cooking empire.
From burgers and tacos to sushi, pizza, pasta and waffles, you'll cook hundreds of tasty dishes for hungry customers. Serve fast, keep the orders flowing and collect bigger tips in this fun restaurant game of quick taps and smart time management. ⏱
Why you'll love Food Truck Chef™
• Cook 700+ dishes from around the world: street food, fast food, desserts, coffee and more
• Play hundreds of cooking levels across 17 food streets, from Pizza Street and BBQ Street to Sushi Street, Tacos Street and Waffle Street
• Upgrade your kitchen, appliances and ingredients to cook faster and earn more coins
• Decorate your food truck with new looks to delight customers and earn more tips
• Play offline: no Wi-Fi needed, cook anywhere
• Easy to learn, hard to master time management gameplay
Cooking challenges and events
• Super Chef mode: cook in fully upgraded kitchens with powerful boosters
• Food Street Carnival: compete against other chefs and climb the leaderboard
• Weekly Star Haul events with a new theme every week
• Party Bus, missions and achievements with gems to win
A world tour of street food
Grill sizzling steaks and bacon on BBQ Street, fry crunchy nachos and tacos, toss noodles on Oriental Street, bake cakes and croissants at the bakery, and brew lattes, espresso and mochas for coffee lovers. Every new location brings fresh recipes, new kitchen tools and new customers to serve.
Dishes and food streets
Cook your way through Pasta Street, Pizza Street, BBQ Street, Waffle Street, Oriental Street, Bakers Street, Falafel Street, Tacos Street, Sandwich Street, Sushi Street, Bacon Street, Ramen Street, the Cafe Bar and Tasty Town. On the menu: burgers, hot dogs, chicken, steaks, bacon, pizza, pasta, noodles, ramen, sushi, shrimp, tofu, tacos, nachos, falafel, shish kebab, sandwiches, bagels, pretzels, pancakes, waffles, pies, cupcakes, muffins, croissants, cheesecake, lattes, espresso, mochas and lemonade.
Fans of cooking games, food games, pizza games, restaurant games, kitchen games, cafe games and offline games will feel right at home. Whether you play for five minutes or an hour, Food Truck Chef™ serves up a fresh challenge every day. Grab your apron and let's cook!
Food Truck Chef™ is free to play. Some in-game items can be purchased with real money.
Questions or feedback? Write to us at support@nukeboxstudios.com
More about the game: www.nukeboxstudios.com/foodtruckchef

bluejetty:00171975:ios.description:
Are you still spending plenty of time making estimates and invoices?
Tired of complex calculations on invoice, estimate, expenses, purchase orders, etc.?
Do you want to process business billings and send estimates and invoices to customers anytime, anywhere?
Invoice Maker & Invoice Now is a professional invoice app to create estimates and invoices. It is a trusted and fast on-the-go invoicing solution for self-employed, small business owners, contractors, freelancers, etc. 
Key Features
- Invoice Maker & Invoice Now helps create professional estimates and invoices within a few steps anytime, anywhere
- Convert estimates into invoices easily
- Manage estimates and invoices for each business billing clearly with a free invoice generator & Invoice Now
- Make estimates and invoices professionally with well-designed invoice-maker templates
- Clear estimates and invoices status for payment tracking
- Customize estimates and invoices with company logo, websites, and terms in invoicing
- Save frequently used items and clients for further use
- Support all types of tax, on item or total
- Support discount, on item or total
- Support multiple currencies, numbers & date formats in invoicing
- Real-time preview during estimates and invoices creation
- Export estimates and invoices to PDF
- Send your estimates and invoices to others directly via email after invoicing
What makes Invoice Maker & Invoice Now stand out:
Smart Invoice Maker
Invoice Maker & Invoice Now is an all-in-one invoice app. It helps you create professional estimates and invoices in seconds. Convert estimates into invoices in one tap. One app for many needs.
Professional Invoice Templates
Using plenty of well-designed invoice templates, you can quickly create professional estimates and invoices. The template will constantly update to help you keep making professional invoice.
Customizable
The fast invoice maker & Invoice Now is highly Customizable. It allows you to customize company logos, website, personal signature, etc. Also, you can use your own currency, numbers & date formats
Clear Payment Status
You can know the clear status of each invoice you made. Get an overview of all payment statuses at a glance. Easy to organize and mark paid.
Invoice Anywhere
Make estimates and invoices, send them directly to your clients. Easily export to PDF, or directly print as soon as you finish.
If you have any questions, please contact us: invoicemaker@guloolootech.com

bluejetty:00035549:android.description:
Sync Translate – All-in-One Language Translator
Break language barriers anytime, anywhere 🌍. With Sync Translate, you can instantly translate text, voice, conversations, and photos across 100+ languages – even when you’re offline 📶. Perfect for travel ✈️, study 📚, work 💼, and chatting 💬 inside your favorite apps, this smart translator makes communication easier than ever.
Why Choose Sync Translate?
✨ Text Translator
Type or paste any word, phrase, or sentence and get fast and accurate translations in real time.
🎤 Voice Translator
Speak naturally and translate conversations instantly – ideal for travel, meetings, or chatting with international friends.
📷 Camera Translator
Just point your camera at menus, road signs, books, or documents to translate text automatically.
📶 Offline Translator
Download language packs and translate without internet access. Stay connected even on flights, remote trips, or abroad.
💬 Cross-App Translator
Use the floating bubble to translate text inside WhatsApp, Messenger, or any other app without switching screens.
📱 Screen Translator
Instantly translate any text displayed on your phone screen with a single tap.
⭐ Favorites & History
Save important translations and quickly recheck your history anytime.
Supported Languages
Sync Translate supports 100+ languages worldwide 🌐, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Italian, Turkish, Indonesian and many more.
Best For
✈️ Travelers – Read restaurant menus, road signs, and directions while abroad.
📚 Students and Learners – Improve language learning and pronunciation.
💼 Business and Work – Communicate with global colleagues and clients.
💬 Daily Life – Translate chats, social media, and on-screen content instantly.
Privacy and Permissions
Sync Translate may use the Accessibility Service API to help retrieve text from other apps and provide real-time translations. The app does not collect or store personal data – your privacy is always protected 🔒.
Why Download Sync Translate?
With its simple interface, powerful features, and offline support, Sync Translate is your essential companion for breaking language barriers 🚀. Start translating today and make global communication effortless.

bluejetty:00146892:ios.description:
Don't let stress control your life.
Take control of your stress levels with iStress. This app support for your Apple Watch and iPhone. Get your stress level, and insight into your stress status.
Key Features:
#Stress Monitoring:
Imagine having a personal stress coach right on your wrist. Our app utilizes advanced sensors on your Apple Watch to accurately measure your stress levels throughout the day. With just a glance at your wrist, you can instantly know how stressed or relaxed you are, enabling you to make immediate adjustments to protect your well-being.
#High Stress Alerts:
Your mental and physical health are deeply interconnected, and excessive stress can lead to serious health implications. That's why our app includes a built-in alert system that notifies you when your stress levels exceed a certain threshold. We care about your well-being and want to ensure you avoid the potential health risks associated with prolonged stress.
#Stress Analysis and Suggestions:
Understanding your stress patterns is key to managing them effectively. Our app goes beyond simple stress tracking and provides detailed analysis of your stress levels throughout the day. By gaining insights into what triggers your stress, you can take proactive steps to reduce its impact. 
#Trend Tracking:
Visualize the ebb and flow of your stress levels over time with our comprehensive trend tracking feature. By observing your stress data across days, weeks, or months, you can gain a deep understanding of how different factors impact your stress levels. Uncover patterns and trends that may go unnoticed otherwise, allowing you to make informed decisions about your lifestyle and develop healthier habits.
Download now and experience the transformative power of stress management at your fingertips. Your mental well-being is worth it.

bluejetty:00119222:ios.description:
Streamline Your Fieldwork with HubMobile
HubMobile is the essential tool for Drivers, Contractors, Sales Reps, and Managers using Hub Systems’ FMS application. Whether you’re on the road or in the field, HubMobile lets you stay connected and efficient with your iPhone or iPad.
Key Features:
 • Receive and Manage Jobs: Access your assignments, query job details, and update PODs—all in real-time.
 • Seamless Communication: Instantly message your team and receive updates directly from your company’s FMS system.
 • Live Progress Tracking: Despatchers can follow your location with constant GPS updates, enabling more efficient job allocation.
Getting Started is Easy:
 1. Download and install HubMobile.
 2. Contact your company to get their unique ID number.
 3. Enter the ID number in the setup screen and tap “Authenticate” to request access.
 4. Once approved, log in with your password and start working!
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can significantly reduce battery life.
Need Help?
For support or suggestions, please reach out to your despatcher or contact Hub Systems Support directly. Please do not use the App Review process for support inquiries.

bluejetty:00037699:ios.description:
#App Store 首页主打推荐、编辑推荐
#几十万热爱生活的用户共同选择
是否你...
总是忙忙碌碌，闲下来却觉得什么也没做？
总是打卡拍照，回忆起来却觉得模模糊糊？
总是记录留念，却尘封成山在相册/硬盘/云盘？
总是种草画册，不断期待不断收藏，却无从下手？
总是决心整理，眨眼间小孩&我们已长大，痛惜时光太快？
如果你也有这样的焦虑或期待，可以试试这款「片羽集」：
> 每天用一张照片和一段故事，记录下日常小确幸
> 日渐积累轻松创作出一本属于自己的《画册》
渡边有子《365日》：生活是一件件微不足道的小事，平淡的日子里总有动人的风景。
乔布斯：我们没有办法知道现在做的这件事在未来会怎样，但是当我们回头看的时候，所有的事情都会串联成一条线，你会发现每一个点都是有意义的。
热爱生活的人更容易被治愈，虽然日常生活还是柴米油盐酱醋茶，
但可以有另一种活法：
片羽集App为你在日常琐碎和忙碌节奏之外，
打造属于自己的记录小天地，有片刻平静下来回顾美好日常。
——————
> 你可以：
◎ 每天一篇照片日记，添加满意的照片，用文字描述心情/地点/天气、感悟或者发生的故事；
◎ 按月、按年来回顾自己的记录日历，还能随时补录；
◎ 可保存或分享记录为满满作品感的卡片海报到朋友圈等；
◎ 可保存或分享一周记录自动拼接为[一周日常]的长图；
◎ 可导出手帐样式的每月照片记录；
◎ 随时切换到《摄影集》画册样式，翻页浏览；
◎ 随机回顾，邂逅你记录的美好日常；
◎ 可以图墙(x3x6x9排列)的方式浏览所有图片，满满收获感;
◎ 桌面小组件：随机回顾/那年那月、本周/本月记录；
◎ 拥有更多持续更新中的精彩功能...
韩寒：相机是时间的停格器，摄影是抓住流逝时间里每个值得回忆的瞬间，好照片是若干年后你看到这张照片会微笑的。
三联生活：照片普通和美之间的壁垒，不是器材和装备，也不是模特和经费，二是拍摄者的心智和审美。
其实每个人都是独特的生活艺术家，
无论是清晨的阳光、小孩子的鬼脸、小猫的伸懒腰、旅途中的惊喜风景，
还是 #日常摄影/咖啡/养花/美食/创作，
#周末打卡/探店/露营，#假期旅行等等，
只要你想留下这一刻的感动，都可以记录下来，
一天天写成一本个人生活兴趣画册 或者 情侣/亲子/家庭画册...
没记录下来的生活才可惜，
因为多年之后再好的相机也拍不出现在模样、情景和感动...
唯有频繁记录，回忆才有迹可循。
在片羽集App，从最简单的每天一张照片和一段故事开始吧～
——————
解锁【片羽集Pro会员】后，可享受：
· 每月尽享 1G 记录空间，无压缩上传浏览原图；
· 创建多本《照片日记》，记录中上传多张图片；
· 沉浸式地以画册样式欣赏个人记录或导出PDF电子版；
· 自由补录去年、前年的历史记录；
· 享受极简/拍立得等精彩丰富的分享样式；
· 可配置显示信息项或隐藏水印等；
· 可设置保护作品版权的艺术家签名；
· 纯净无广告版本；
订阅价格：
1个月(Pro连续包月产品) ¥16.00；
12个月(Pro连续包年产品) ¥98.00；
终身会员 ¥368.00；
价格可能因地区而异，确认购买片羽集Pro的月/年会员自动订阅服务并完成支付后，将通过您的 iTunes 账户自动续订。苹果 iTunes 账户将在当前会员期限结束前 24 小时内收取续订费用，您也可以在购买后到 Apple Store 的账户设置中来管理和取消订阅。未使用的试用时长在购买订阅之后将自动作废。本服务由您自主选择是否取消，若您选择不取消，将为您开通下一个计费周期的续费服务。
隐私协议：https://www.lentoapp.com/moment/privacy.html
用户协议：https://www.lentoapp.com/moment/useragreement.html
---
如有任何问题和建议，
欢迎联系客服微信: lentowow

bluejetty:00176749:ios.description:
Do you enjoy world puzzles? Do you like finding words and figuring out clues and hints? Are you waiting for the next fun and challenging twist in word games? If the answer is yes, then Word Combo is the perfect game for you, and it's totally free!
Word Combo is the unique twist between puzzles, clues and trivia games. Put the word chunks in the correct order to form the right word. Each clue also serves as a hint to help you solve it! Word Combo has all the charm of crossword games, the intellect of trivia games, and the challenge of typical word puzzles. It offers a unique twist by combining elements from many different game genres.
Play level after level all of the game's word puzzles and enjoy the challenge of finding out the correct answer of the clues and the hints. Do you know the answer to the clues? Put the word chunks in the correct order and form your answer! Are some clues too hard? Use hints and other types of helpful items in your word puzzles. Play your own way, as Word Combo's puzzles are combination of clues, trivia, and puzzle thinking.
So come and enjoy our thousands of puzzles and solve the clues of each level. Check your trivia skills, use hints and solve as many of our word puzzles as you can. Can you answer all the clues? 
Word Combo is a free word puzzle game with ads and optional in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00173150:ios.description:
**One of “8 New Apps You Don't Want To Miss” – Mashable**
** “First Aid By American Red Cross is a fix for what ails you.” - Appolicious**
Accidents happen. That’s why it’s important to have lifesaving information at your fingertips so you can respond with confidence. The free First Aid mobile app by the American Red Cross puts expert advice for common emergencies in the palm of your hand—from the latest First Aid and CPR techniques to the nearest hospital location. Stay up to date on your lifesaving skills. Receive reminders to re-certify, as well as access to helpful videos, interactive quizzes and other lifesaving information.
Features:
• Easy to use Spanish language switch translation directly inside the app.
• Simple step-by-step instructions guide you through everyday first aid scenarios.
• Fully integrated with 9-1-1 so you can call EMS from the app at any time.
• Preloaded content means you have instant access to all safety information at anytime, even without reception or an Internet connection. 
• App user and lifesaving award stories 
• Quick, intuitive access to first aid information and videos via a search bar which is Siri/Bixby enabled 
• Interactive functionality, such as Hospital finder to find an emergency center near you and Metronome for practicing CPR 
• Interactive quizzes allow you to earn badges that you can share with your friends and show off your lifesaving knowledge
• Immediate, anywhere access so individuals can view their digital certificate, (if they took a blended learning course on the Red Cross Learning Center) and receive reminders to recertify.

bluejetty:00115487:ios.description:
Easy even for beginners!
The rules of “Re:ESCAPE: Escape Room Game” are simple!
Escape from locked rooms and various situations.
There are plenty of stages to enjoy, including a ferris wheel at an amusement park overlooking the sea, a tent at a camp in the forest, a reef area where a ship is moored, and a vast desert!
With easy controls, anyone can enjoy puzzle-solving escape games!
Stages will be added through regular updates.
【Included Stages】
Vehicles Series: Nonstop Bus
Mountain Series: Bungalow in the Forest
Shopping Street Series: Night Arcade
Seasonal Events Series: Christmas House
Zoo Series: Panda Forest
Seasonal Events Series: Trick or Escape
Desert Series: Dead Well
Ocean Series: Reef Area
Amusement Park Series: Ferris Wheel
Mountain Series: Tent in the Forest
【Features】
・This app includes many escape games.
・Only “tapping” is required to play.
・Detailed “hints” using images.
・“Auto-save” function.
・“Auto Answer” function that automatically enters the answers.
【How to Play】
・Tap the screen thoroughly.
・You can select item by single tap.
・You can enlarge item by double tapping.
・Keep enlarging item and tap another item, and you can get new item.
・When you are confused, take a look at the hints.
【Coins】
・Coins can be used for unlocking hints, answers, memo functions, the auto answer, etc.
・Coins can be earned by completing missions, etc.
・Coins can be purchased from the “Shop.”
【Missions】
・Earn rewards by logging in daily.
・Earn rewards by clearing stages.
・Earn rewards by finding hidden badges in stages, etc.
【Badge Collection】
・You can view a list of badges earned in each stage.
・Each stage hides “Gold Badge,” “Silver Badge,” and “Bronze Badge.” 
・The locations of badges are not revealed in hints or answers, so please make an effort to find them.
【Waypoint Marker】
・Display icons that indicate where you can move during the game.
・You can switch between them at any time pressing the button at the top of the screen.
【Memo】
・You can take notes freely using four different colored pens.
・You can increase the number of the memo pages by purchasing the corresponding item in the “Shop.”
【Auto Answer】
・Automatically enters the answers to puzzles.
【Important Note】
All coins in the app will be reset if you delete the app.
Please be careful when changing devices.
We plan to add a backup function in a future update.
【BGM and Sounds】
Amacha no ongaku kobo
MaouDamashii
On-Jin
Pocket Sound

bluejetty:00186349:ios.description:
Combines Oxford's largest single-volume English Dictionary and largest Thesaurus, plus audio all in one application —making this the largest Oxford English reference on ANY mobile platform.
● The entire Oxford Dictionary of English, Second Edition (ODE) 
● and Oxford Thesaurus of English, Second Edition (OTE).
　 Including extensive reading & reference material,
　 　over and above the core content
● 72,000 pre-recorded sound files from the Shorter Oxford English
　 Dictionary and Oxford SoundBank with native British voice actors.
_____________________________
◼ Application Features:
▪ full content of the unabridged texts 
▪ complete appendices and front matter
▪ unique three-way cross-referencing search
▪ real-time progressing look-up
▪ wildcard searches for unknown words & quizzes
▪ hyperlinking between dictionary & thesaurus
　 plus to and from appendices
▪ fallback online search for esoteric or archaic words and the latest slang
▪ automatic history
▪ bookmarks with editable notations
▪ iCloud Bookmark syncing
▪ an "AI Teacher" for deeper explanations or help for ESL students in 98 languages
▪ an AI boosted anagram generator
▪ online searching for rare words
▪ unique support for round-trip search from other apps
▪ "Share" module to search within other apps (with history)
▪ "Oxford Broadcast" for split-screen or second screens
▪ "Word-of-the-Day" messages
▪ "Today" & LockScreen widgets
▪ 3D Touch & DarkMode support
▪ iPad Pro multi-screen and Drag & Drop
▪ iPhone 17 & iOS26 support
▪ iPhone, iPod, iPad and macOS support
_____________________________
◼ ODE Description
▶ The foremost single-volume authority on the English language
▶ Hundreds of new words and senses derived from the latest research from the Oxford English Corpus, giving the most complete and accurate picture of the English language
The Oxford Dictionary of English is at the forefront of language research, focusing on English as it is used today, informed by the most up-to-date evidence from the largest language research programme in the world, including the 800-million-word Oxford English Corpus. This revised edition includes hundreds of brand-new words and senses, as well as up-to-date encyclopedic information, and extensive appendices covering topics such as countries, heads of state, and chemical elements.
◼ OTE Description
▶ Authoritative coverage of more synonyms and antonyms than any other A-Z thesaurus
▶ New and up-to-date synonyms and senses, based on the latest research from the Oxford English Corpus
▶ Accessible and easy to use, with synonyms given in order of usefulness and key synonyms highlighted
▶ Lists including foreign words and phrases, and imitative words added to the completely revised centre section giving useful vocabulary on a broad range of topics, from clothes and food, to medicine and music
▶ Special Features: Choose the Right Word boxes that help distinguish between close synonyms, plus Word Links panels: look up the word 'coin' and find the link with 'numismatic'
The WordFinder section of word lists has been fully revised and reorganized with its own quick-reference index and includes topics from clothes and food, to medicine and music, with new lists of foreign words and phrases, archaic words, imitative words, British and American equivalents, and more. It is an invaluable resource to help broaden your vocabulary and provide quick answers to word puzzles and crossword clues.

◼ Features:
▶ high-quality recordings with native English pronunciations
▶ accurate coverage of different homographs, variant forms and inflections
