bluejetty:00079115:ios.name: Unread: An RSS Reader
bluejetty:00079115:ios.summary: Rediscover the joy of reading your favorite writers and publications with Unread. Unread is an RSS reader with beautiful typography, comfortable gesture-based navigation, and a variety of color themes. Unread is available for iPhone, iPad,
bluejetty:00079115:ios.description:
Rediscover the joy of reading your favorite writers and publications with Unread. Unread is an RSS reader with beautiful typography, comfortable gesture-based navigation, and a variety of color themes. Unread is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Unread won the MacStories Selects 2025 Lifetime Achievement Award.
Capabilities include:
SYNCING: Our free Unread Cloud service keeps your devices in sync. Unread also syncs with Birchfeed, Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, FreshRSS, Gobbler, Inkwell, Inoreader, Miniflux, and NewsBlur.
AUTOMATIC WEBPAGE TEXT: For feeds that contain only article summaries, Unread will display the full article text from the webpage. Easily switch between feed text and webpage text for any article, and change the default for individual feeds.
WEBSITE ACCOUNTS: For news websites that require an account, sign in and get full webpage text.
SUBSCRIBE IN UNREAD: This share sheet extension lets you subscribe to a website’s feeds while visiting that website from Safari or any other web browser.
SAVE TO UNREAD: This share sheet extension creates an article in Unread with the contents of the webpage you are visiting from Safari or any other web browser. (Subscription required.)
COLOR THEMES: Unread provides a variety of color themes. Choose one theme for light mode and another for dark mode.
CACHING: Unread caches webpage text and images for instant loading and offline access. (Subscription required.)
READ-LATER SERVICES: Unread can save articles to Anybox, Flyleaf, GoodLinks, Instapaper, Matter, Pinboard, Plinky, Quick Reads, Raindrop.io, Readwise, Safari Reading List, and wallabag. On a device with a hardware keyboard, assign a custom keyboard shortcut to each. (Subscription required.)
SHORTCUTS: Perform shortcuts on articles and links inside articles. On a device with a hardware keyboard, assign a custom keyboard shortcut to each. (Subscription required.)
---
“Just a gorgeous app.”
– John Gruber, Daring Fireball
“Most importantly, I should stress again how refreshing it feels to have such a great native experience with Unread. The app is really fast, even when it’s loaded up with hundreds of feeds.”
— Niléane Dorffer, MacStories
“It’s an RSS reader made with taste. It has great typography, themes, search, and compatibility with the usual suspects. I love having this app on my Mac.”
— David Sparks, MacSparky
---
Unread has full VoiceOver coverage. Every screen and every feature is available to users with vision impairments:
• From any screen you can perform a magic tap, a two-finger double tap, to open a menu of options available for that screen.
• When on an article list, there are actions available for each article in the list. After selecting an article, invoke the accessibility rotor and then select “Actions”. There is an action to mark the article read or unread, an action to share the article, and many others.
• Use the VoiceOver escape gesture, a two-finger “Z”, to back out of the current screen.
---
UNREAD SUBSCRIPTION
Unread is a free app. Additional functionality is available with a $29.99 (USD)/year auto-renewing subscription:
• Article actions for sending articles directly to supported bookmarking and read later services, and for sharing via email or iMessage.
• Ability to execute shortcuts on articles and links.
• Caching of webpage text and images.
• Widget customization options.
• Save to Unread share sheet extension.
• Custom app icons.
• Premium support.
A subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Unread’s Terms of Use are available at:
https://www.goldenhillsoftware.com/unread/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00080065:ios.name: SNCF Connect: Trains & routes
bluejetty:00080065:ios.summary:
SNCF Connect, the all-in-one app for all your journeys
Travel with SNCF Connect, the leading app for rail and sustainable mobility, supporting more than 15 million users with their journeys across France and Europe.
With you every step of
bluejetty:00080065:ios.description:
SNCF Connect, the all-in-one app for all your journeys
Travel with SNCF Connect, the leading app for rail and sustainable mobility, supporting more than 15 million users with their journeys across France and Europe.
With you every step of the way
A true everyday travel companion, SNCF Connect lets you plan, book and manage all your journeys in just a few clicks:
- Plan ahead and organise your trips by finding the right journey at the best price
- Buy and access your tickets, cards/subscriptions and travel passes in one place
- Exchange and cancel your bookings easily
Everyday journeys and special occasions alike
Find all your train journeys in France and Europe in one place, along with your public transport journeys (metro, bus, tram) and even your carpooling and taxi/private hire trips. Travel with peace of mind thanks to car hire services, Allianz Travel, Junior & Cie, onboard catering, Mes Bagages and ALL Accor hotels.
Personalised and proactive information
SNCF Connect is more than just a ticket booking app. It is also a tool that keeps you informed and sends real-time alerts to make your journeys easier.
Features designed to help you every day
Plan a journey:
- Search for the best route to your destination
- Book your train tickets in France (TER, TGV INOUI, OUIGO Grande Vitesse and Train Classique, INTERCITÉS), to destinations in Europe (TGV Lyria, Eurostar (formerly Thalys), DB SNCF Voyageurs), in Germany (Deutsche Bahn) and in Switzerland (SBB CFF FFS)
- Buy public transport tickets in Paris and the Île-de-France region (IDFM network) and in 62 cities across France (metro, bus, tram, RER, Transilien SNCF, RATP)
- Book coach services (FlixBus, BlaBlaCar Bus), BlaBlaCar carpooling and Uber taxi/private hire services
- Set booking alerts, low price alerts and train full alerts to find the train ticket that suits you
- Place an option on a ticket to lock in the price for a set period
Book travel tickets and subscriptions:
- Buy all your train tickets, cartes Avantage and Carte Liberté, SNCF subscriptions including regional TER subscriptions, as well as Deutsche Bahn (Germany) and SBB tickets (Switzerland)
- In Île-de-France, top up your Navigo pass directly on your phone
- Buy and validate digital tickets and travel passes for the RATP & SNCF network in Île-de-France (Metro-Train-RER Tickets, Bus-Tram Tickets, Paris Region - Airports tickets, Navigo pass)
- Through your customer account, save your traveller profile, travel companions, payment cards, subscriptions, SNCF discount cards and loyalty cards
- Pay securely by bank card or PayPal, in one or several instalments, with your Chèques-Vacances Connect, Apple Pay or mobility budget cards
Travel with peace of mind on the day of departure:
- Save your frequent journeys
- Prepare your trip: find your e-ticket and save it to your Apple Wallet, add your journey to your calendar, or share it with friends and family
- Check departure and arrival times and platform information at the station
 - View live traffic updates and your train’s real-time location during your journey, and receive alerts in the event of disruptions or engineering works, including for journeys in Europe (Eurostar (formerly Thalys), TGV Lyria)
- Receive messages relaying onboard announcements made on your train (TGV INOUI, OUIGO, INTERCITÉS and TER)
- Find information about the formation of your TGV INOUI, OUIGO, TER, Transilien or RER train
- Make connections easier: get information on which coach/carriage to board or which exit to take
- Access your proof of purchase and travel documents
Need help?
- Quickly find an answer via the chatbot or online help centre
- Contact our advisers, available 7 days a week via messaging, telephone or social media...

bluejetty:00061703:ios.description:
Modern, Fast, Easy-to-Use Mobile Home Inspection Software by Spectora. 
Use the most intuitive mobile home inspection app on the market. Featuring a clean, modern interface, Spectora allows you to quickly mark defects and take photos for home inspections. With build-as-you-go templates and intuitive design, you'll finish inspections faster than ever and produce appealing, modern, web-based inspection reports that clients and agents love.
The Spectora property inspection app is designed to sync seamlessly with your web-based Spectora home inspection software. Web-based software allows Mac and PC use, or any operating system with a web browser. 
Efficiently write home inspection reports from your iPhone or iPad with custom, auto-populated comments so you're not typing on-site while interacting with your clients. Fast photo annotations allow you to easily add arrows, circles or squares to point out defects. Sync data to the cloud to finish up the report later, or publish on-site directly from the mobile app.
Spectora Mobile Home Inspection Software Features:
*Offline Inspections - no need for a connection between report import and export
* Offline Summary - review your recommendations with a client before leaving the site, even if you have no connection
*Export data to the cloud so it's at your desktop when you get home, or
*Publish directly from the mobile app
*Simple, clean layout and navigation
*Save default comments to your template for any section, item or defect (big time saver for common recommendations & defects!)
*Progress bar and per-section/item indicators show your progress
*Sections/Items show checkmarks when complete
*Flag-for-later feature to remind yourself of comments to finish later
*In-app reminders to yourself for each section/item
*Customizable to suit your workflow
*Location Builder lets you quickly add location tags from your presets
*Optionally include cost estimates
*Take videos or use the library to add existing videos
*Use the camera or photo roll for pictures
*Photo editor can add arrows/circles to point out defects with simple one-finger gestures
*Multiple photos per defect
*Large tap targets
*Breadcrumbs for quick navigation
*Automatic in-app content download for rapid feature addition and quick bug fixes
Spectora Mobile iOS app requires a Spectora account. Free trials available risk-free.
Come see how the Spectora platform can save you time and grow your business - no gimmicks.

bluejetty:00151102:ios.description:
Tradição, Qualidade e Inovação
Fundada em 1994, a Center Pão é uma das mais tradicionais padarias de Montes Claros. Nossa vocação gourmet tem destaque na produção própria, com produtos panificados, confeitos, frios e pratos quentes seguindo receitas exclusivas e de sabor inigualável. Ao longo dos anos a Center Pão cresceu e hoje conta com cinco lojas na cidade.
Apesar de se manter tradicional as suas origens, a Center Pão possui um conceito de referência inovador, sendo a primeira padaria a funcionar aos domingos e feriados em Montes Claros, implantar o conceito de self service de produtos panificados e oferecer, além do pão francês, uma grande variedade de produtos. Hoje temos panificação, confeitaria fina, rotisseria, mercearia e restaurante reunidos em nossas lojas.
A Center Pão procura entender as vontades e necessidades de cada um de seus clientes e busca traduzir isso em serviços e produtos diferenciados. Estamos sempre atentos às novidades regionais, nacionais e até internacionais, com o objetivo de encontrar produtos que façam nossos clientes viajarem sem sair de casa. Pensamos na forma mais atenciosa de atendê-los, de estar presente em seu dia a dia e fazer com que cada momento na Center Pão seja especial.
Missão
Estar presente no dia a dia de nossos clientes, conhecer seus desejos e necessidades, buscando traduzir isso em serviços e produtos alimentícios diferenciados superando sempre suas expectativas.
Visão
Ser uma das principais empresas de panificação do Brasil e referência de excelência em produtos e serviços alimentícios.
Valores
- Satisfação do Cliente
- Qualidade de produtos e serviços
- Inovação
- Valorização e respeito às pessoas
- Ética

bluejetty:00175405:ios.description:
تطبيق طرب الفيديو هو واحد من افضل تطبيقات الايفون والايباد المجانية المتوفرة على الآب ستور التي يمكنك الاعتماد عليها فمن خلال هذا التطبيق يمكنك تحميل مقاطعك المفضلة من الفيديو والملفات الى جهازك فهو التطبيق الأسهل من بين تطبيقات تحميل الفيديوهات المتوفرة لأجهزة ايفون .
حيث يتيح لك التطبيق أن تقوم بتحميل وتنزيل أي ملف من خلال الضغط على زر التحميل ليتم نقل الملف الى التطبيق بكل سهولة وسرعة .
التطبيق يتيح لك تنزيل العديد من الجودات المختلفة من الفيديوهات ، فضلاً عن ان التطبيق يمنح المستخدمين خاصية تحويل الفيديو الي صوت Mp3 .
ويمكن للمستخدمين الاستمتاع بمشاهدة و الاستماع الى مقاطع فيديو و موسيقى و تشغيلها ايضا في الخلفية من غير انترنت كما يمكنك التطبيق من مشاركة ونشر فيديوهاتك المحملة على تطبيق سناب شات من غير ظهور علامة فوق الفيديو انه من مكتبة الصور فبالتالي سوف يظهر الفيديو أنه تم تصويره الآن .
طرب الفيديو تطبيق مميز جداً يحتوي على العديد من الميزات التي ستمكنك من :
- تنزيل الفيديوهات من DropBox أو GoogleDrive أو icloud إلى جهاز iPhone أو iPad . يمكنك مشاهدة مقاطع الفيديو التي تم تنزيلها في وضع عدم الاتصال! ومشاركتها عن طريق السوشال ميديا مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي .
-واجهة الاستخدام بسيطة جداً.
-إتاحة التعديل على الفيديوهات المحملة من استديو الصور الخاص بك
-  إمكانية فصل الموسيقى من الصوت أو الفيديو كل على حده .
- ازالة الصوت البشري من أي مقطع صوتي أو مقطع فيديو .
- إمكانية قفل التطبيق للخصوصية . 
- إمكانية وضع ملصقات (ايموجي) على الفيديو .
- إمكانية الكتابة والرسم على الفيديو .
- (تسريع / إبطاء) الفيديو حسب اختيارك .
- قص مقطع الفيديو للحصول على البعد المناسب .
- يمكنك قص الفيديو وتقطيعه بسهولة للحصول على مدة فيديو قصيرة .
- يمكنك عكس مقطع الفيديو بشكل كامل .
-حفظ نسخة احتياطية من بياناتك على الايكلاود .
- إزالة الصوت " كتم " من اي فيديو أو مقطع .
- يتيح لك البرنامج بتنزيل عدة ملفات في نفس الوقت .
- يتميز مشغل الموسيقى في البرنامج ب سهولة الاستخدام ووضوح أدوات تحكم الplayer 
- يمكن للمشتركين التواصل مع فريق الدعم الخاص بالتطبيق عبر اعدادات التطبيق .
- يستطيع المستخدم ترتيب الملفات المحملة من خلال خاصية تحديد ملفاتي وترتبيها حسب الأحرف الأبجدية ، لعبت مؤخرا ، حمّلت مؤخرا .
- يمكن استعادة الملفات المحذوفة من سلة المهملات في التطبيق قبل ٤٠ يوم من تاريخ حذفها .
-إمكانية إعادة مشاهدة الملفات المنزلة بدون الاتصال بالإنترنت.
- يمكن من خلال التطبيق معرفة اسم الأغنية من خلال Shazam والانتقال اليها بكل سهولة .
- يدعم اللغات : العربية والإنجليزية .
- اضافة قفل الفيديو لمنع الوصول إلى ميزات شاشة مشغل الموسيقي .
وجه عام فإن هذا التطبيق هو تطبيق رائع يجعل من السهل جدا الوصول الى كل الفيديوهات الموجودة على هاتفك وكل ما يلزم للتعديل علی فيديوهاتك الاصلية ومشاركتها على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي مع أصدقائك .
-- "Remove Ads" Subscription --
- Enjoy the app without the interruption of any ads.
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew each month 24-hours before the end of the current period, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

"I'm starting to feel more comfortable speaking E
bluejetty:00120482:ios.description:
AI English speaking app that builds your English brain
An English learning service for intermediate and advanced learners who understand the material but struggle to express it in English!
"I'm starting to feel more comfortable speaking English!"
"I think now I can speak in English naturally without translation."
■ The key is ‘thinking in English’
Do you want to speak in English freely anytime, anywhere? Start training to ‘think and speak in English’ with the learning method developed by Plang. You’ll be able to express what you want to say just like a native speaker.
■ Casual conversation with native speakers
Start practicing your English conversation in situations in various situations such as conversations with foreign friends, at business meetings, and unexpected situations while traveling.
■ Personalized curriculum designed by AI
AI meticulously analyzes your English speaking skills. It identifies sentence lengths you can use, words you struggle with, and unnatural expressions and pronunciations. Based on this analysis, it suggests the most optimized learning path for you.
■ Shadowing for English speaking
Shadowing is the most popular English study method among interpreters! It involves listening to and repeating what a native speaker says. By understanding the context of the conversation while learning expressions, you’ll naturally adopt English thinking.
■ Learn original English through local video contents
You can study with over 200,000 local video contents, including dramas, movies, vlogs, and animations. You’ll get a full understanding of how English is actually used, beyond just theoretical knowledge. By immersing yourself in shadowing as if you were a character in the videos, you’ll find it so enjoyable that you won't want to stop!
■ Automated review system
Repetition is key! To be able to speak in real-life situations, it’s crucial to remember the sentences you’ve studied. The AI will relentlessly help you review those sentences until they stick in your mind.

bluejetty:00095736:ios.description:
Hushli is an AI journal that listens without judgment, helping you talk through life’s difficult moments and remember your emotional journey.
Whether you’re heartbroken, overwhelmed, anxious, or simply need someone to talk to, Hushli is here to listen.
Talk through what’s on your mind.
Sort through difficult emotions.
Find clarity in life’s ups and downs.
No judgment.
Nothing shared.
Just a private space where you can be yourself.
As you talk, Hushli remembers your journey.
Your thoughts become journal entries, while feelings and memories are captured in your Mood Jar. Each week, Hushli helps you look back, notice emotional patterns and small changes, and prepare for the week ahead.
What you’ll find inside
• Talk Anytime
A supportive AI companion, available whenever you need to talk
• Mood Jar
Capture feelings, memories, and meaningful moments throughout your day
• Auto Journal
Conversations naturally become reflections you can revisit anytime
• Weekly Report
Look back on your week, understand emotional patterns and small changes, and get thoughtful suggestions from Lumi for the week ahead
• See Your Journey
Revisit past memories, reflections, and how your emotional journey changes over time
• Private by Design
Face ID lock and encrypted storage keep everything safe and yours
Whether you’re getting through a breakup, reflecting on your day, or simply trying to make sense of what you’re feeling, Hushli is here.
One conversation at a time.
Hushli does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Subscriptions will auto-renew 24 hours before the current period ends, at the renewal rate.

bluejetty:00089075:ios.description:
Awaken to a new beginning in a world of dreams and fairy tales. [Grimlight]
The world of Phantasia is filled with mystery and wonder but has been eroded away by the Dreamless, shadowy entities that seek to corrupt all living things and consume the world into the endless void.
Even the Dominion lords who once defended the realms were corrupted and soon lost their reason and sanity. They are now mere shells of their former selves engulfed in madness and destruction.
Only you, the Dreamer, can banish the darkness by calling upon heroes of legend through fragments of their past memories to save the world from endless ruin…
■A Story of Dreams and Fairy Tales■
Call upon epic heroes from classic stories, grim fairy tales, and folklore such as Alice, Cinderella, Red Riding Hood, Snow White, and more!
With the power of the Dreamstone, summon your allies and save the world of Phantasia from the mysterious and deadly Dreamless.
■Anime-Style Illustrations■
Unlock characters with gorgeous art from top anime-style illustrators.
Listen to their voices and unlock their stories!
■Weapons and Tactics■
Plan your unique battle strategy with countless combinations of weapons, items, and Heroes. Acquire various weapons and items to customize and strengthen your heroes to make them even more powerful to attack and defend against the Dreamless onslaught for RPG survival.
■Simple and Easy Controls■
Deploy your heroes on the battlefield, and you're ready to start! Strategic combat with simple drag-and-drop controls. The right strategy and tactics can make the difference between victory and defeat. 
■Official Links■
Official Website: https://grimlight.global/
Official Twitter Account: https://twitter.com/GrimlightEN

Pick your device and your input tool leveraging the first CAD tool envisioned for multidevice. Hybrid workflow meets cross-functional team processes with automatic sync across devices. Work from any device or offline: design and collaborate at your best, everywhere.

• Generate real-life scenes from your models in seconds - powered by AI

Treasure Chests & Magic Items
bluejetty:00154123:ios.description:
Defeat powerful enemies, open treasure chests, and rise from novice adventurer to unstoppable Champion in Slay Quest! Enjoy auto combat, strategic planning, and ad-free adventures in this thrilling casual RPG.
Treasure Chests & Magic Items
Complete levels to earn treasure chests filled with valuable magic items. Equip them to gain special bonuses and supercharge your hero’s abilities!
Fifteen Unique Classes
Choose from 15 classes - each with distinct strengths and progression paths. Whether you favor cunning Rogues or devastating Mages, master the playstyle that suits you best.
Ten Distinct Enemy Sets
Encounter varied enemy factions, each demanding different tactics. Adapt and conquer as you forge your path to victory.
Auto Combat
Watch your hero battle automatically, or time your abilities for maximum impact. Combine laid-back play with deep strategic choices.
Resource Management
Upgrade health, damage, and energy regeneration to bolster your hero’s might. Every decision counts in your quest to topple the final boss.
Deep Strategy
Overcome challenging encounters using careful planning. Allocate resources wisely to outsmart formidable foes.
Ad-Free Adventures
Enjoy Slay Quest without forced ads. Watch optional ads for bonus rewards and faster progress - no interruptions required.
Immersive Gameplay & Vibrant Graphics
Feel the thrill of becoming a Champion as you explore a beautifully detailed fantasy world. Every triumph paves the way for new challenges and greater power.
Begin Your Epic Journey!
Download Slay Quest now and embark on the ultimate quest to become a legendary hero!

bluejetty:00015516:ios.name: My Town : Preschool
bluejetty:00015516:ios.summary: Grab your backpack, it’s time for My Town : Preschool! Build and play in your very own preschool. There are hours of fun ahead for telling stories about what life at school is like. My Town : Preschool has 8 unique locations to explore. You
bluejetty:00015516:ios.description:
Grab your backpack, it’s time for My Town : Preschool! Build and play in your very own preschool. There are hours of fun ahead for telling stories about what life at school is like. My Town : Preschool has 8 unique locations to explore. You can dress up the children before they get to school, take care of them when they get hurt on the playground and need a bandage and make lunch during breaks!
FEATURES:
*8 fun locations including a learning room, bathroom, nurse’s office, nap room, cafeteria and more! 
*NEW extra special feature! We’ve added EMOTIONS to all the characters, so now you can make each person laugh, cry, smile…they can mimic how YOU are feeling! 
*Brand new characters including preschool teachers, kids and their parents.
*New clothing designed for each season to dress up your characters.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00049171:android.description:
Banque Du Caire Mobile Banking – our bank is available 24/7! 
Banque du Caire mobile banking application is offering you a wide range of features to perform your banking transactions remotely in a secured and convenient way, just download BDC Mobile Banking from google / apple stores and get the benefits from the below features: 
• View and monitor your accounts transactions, balance and statement 
• View your credit cards balances as per last cycle
• View your loan summary and statement
• View Certificate deposits and Time deposit details
• Pay your Credit Card Bills 
• Pay credit cards bills for other Bank’s 
• Transfer between your own accounts or any account at BDC with EGP currency
• Transfer to any account outside BDC with EGP 
• Locate the nearest ATM/Branch
And much more… 
All you have to do is to download the application and login using your username and password of BDC internet banking service
If you are not registered in the internet banking service, kindly visit our nearest BDC branch to register 
For more information, kindly call 16990
Terms & Conditions Apply
Security:
• BDC has no responsibility when using the application on any device or operating system that has been modified outside the mobile device or operating system vendor supported or warranted configurations. This includes devices that are, for an example, “jail-broken” or “rooted
• Select a password that is difficult for others to guess.
• Do not share your password with anyone.
• Change your password regularly
• Keep your User Id and Password Confidential.
• Please be reminded that BDC employees will never ask you to provide your online Banking User Id/password 
• Always check last time you access your account through Mobile
Legal:
All transfers to other accounts inside or outside BDC, including settlement of non-BDC credit cards, require the use of OTP (“One Time Password”) token, in accordance with the regulations of the Central Bank of Egypt. The OTP token is an independent service that adds a higher level of identification and security and should be requested from BDC, as it is not included in this application.
By downloading BDC Mobile Banking application or setting up your device to download it automatically, you agree to the installation of this application, its future updates and upgrades. You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the application

bluejetty:00028715:ios.description:
鹊桥相织，共与天河！新《武林外传手游》资料片上线，这个夏天，与爱情有关！布叽岛游乐园再度拓建，打造爱情相关主题场景，全新场景“誓约岛”正式开幕，闪烁的桃心，浪漫的粉色沙漠，相约相思树下见证爱情！为了庆祝全新誓约岛开放，月老正式迁居誓约岛并开启跨服情缘，让服务器不再成为爱情的界限，少侠们可以在誓约岛上游玩情缘玩法，增进感情！凌风全新转职贯日登场，超强弓系转职，利用元素之力摧毁敌人，感受远程弓箭手独特玩法！跨服收徒开启，打破服务器界限，壮大师门；精英加入托管功能、奇遇奖励更新、竹林游记珍坊商店开放，全新玩法开启！
【誓约相见，开启浪漫机遇】
布叽岛游乐园开园至今，见证了无数江湖轶事，在月老撮合下，准备开启全新园区——誓约岛，给江湖情侣们，带来爱情主题乐园，也帮助江湖单身侠客，早日找到自己的眷侣！同时，誓约岛也新增相关支线任务，带你了解更多关于江湖情缘的故事！
【跨服情缘，邂逅你的故事】
时值七夕，月老为了庆祝七夕盛日和誓约岛建成，双喜临门之季，决定打破服务器的界限，让少侠们可以跨越服务器规则，缔结情缘！求婚地点从七侠镇调整至誓约岛！单身的侠客可以在誓约岛相思树下，祈缘寻缘，寻找属于自己的爱情！已结缘的侠侣们，相思树将提供诸多服务，让你DIY专属自己的情侣手账！
【贯日登场，元素之力新转职】
天雷贯耳，无懈出击！凌风一脉隐藏的能力展现，能利用自然界中任何元素作为箭矢，疾如风，迅如雷，侵略如火！元素箭三元相汇，风长火势，火引雷霆，任何敌人都会在箭矢之下灰飞烟灭！凌风全新转职——贯日登场！达到转职等级的凌风少侠，即可前往完成转职任务，感受全新转职贯日的强大！
【跨服师徒开启，扩充师门互帮协】
江湖上各大师门为了扩充人才，开始解除限制，广收门徒！师徒系统更新，开启跨服师徒选项。江湖侠客们，可以在师徒界面中，点击推荐跨服，即可开启跨服拜师收徒，找寻更多有缘之人！

bluejetty:00162876:ios.description:
Dive into the world of soccer with "Guess the Soccer Team", the perfect soccer quiz for all fans of this beautiful sport.
This game invites you to master the art of identifying soccer teams, where you will progressively unlock more challenging teams as you demonstrate your knowledge in soccer trivia.
THREE GAME MODES
Choose between three exciting game modes: Clubs, National Teams, and Iconic Teams. Test your knowledge by guessing 300 clubs, challenge yourself with 50 national teams, or explore soccer history by identifying 50 of the most iconic teams ever.
UPDATED DATABASE
All lineups are 100% updated for the current 2026/2027 season. It includes all national teams participating in international cups in Europe and America, and teams from the most renowned leagues:
• English League
• Spanish League
• Italian League
• German League
• French League
• Dutch League
• American League
• Portuguese League
• Saudi League
• Argentine League
• Turkish League
• Greek League
• Brazilian League
• And many more!
OFFLINE PLAY
Enjoy "Guess the Soccer Team" completely offline, perfect for playing anytime and anywhere without relying on an internet connection. Ideal for entertainment while travelling or in areas without internet access.
COIN SYSTEM
Utilise our coin system, which rewards your accuracy in the game. With each correctly guessed team, you accumulate coins that you can use to acquire hints that simplify the most challenging levels. There are 3 types of hints:
• Reveal the team's league/region/season (depends on the game mode)
• Reveal a player from the team
• Reveal the team
Get ready to elevate your soccer experience with each level and challenge in "Guess the Soccer Team". This game not only measures your current knowledge but also enhances your ability to recognize teams with just a glance at their lineup.
Are you ready to prove your mastery and become a legend in soccer trivia?

bluejetty:00168014:ios.description:
Welcome to GOSI App – your digital gateway to the Social Insurance's services!
Are you a Contributor, Employer or Beneficiary of social insurance in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia? Managing your insurance benefits just got easier with GOSI App. You can access a wide range of services and information designed to optimize your experience with the Social Insurance like never before.
Key features:
Individuals (Contributors & Beneficiaries):
• Easy access and login to GOSI app by activating your biometric feature, allowing you to view your active digital certificates without needing an internet connection.
• Quick inquiry capability without the need to log in.
• Availability of accessibility features for individuals (dyslexia, sign language, and color blindness)
• Access to your insurance benefits and the ability to submit transactions.
• Easy access to and management of your professional contributions.
• Simple issuance and display of your digital documents, such as Wage & Contributions certificates, and sharing them.
• Seamless management and updating of your personal profile.
• Access to offers and special features for members of the Taqdeer program.

Employers:
• Easy access to all essential features and services your organization needs, including custom dashboards, easy payment options, stakeholder management, certificate issuance, quick verification, and much more.
• Seamless app experience: Enjoy an intuitive and smooth experience with easy switching between individual and business accounts.
• Appreciation for all: Easily publish offers, create QR codes, distribute vouchers, and verify eligibility with ease.
• Business consultations: Access the expected wage calculator to estimate salaries and explore your salary range in the market.
• Conversational user interface: Navigate easily through the business conversational interface to find the services you need.
• Compliance indicator: A new service that allows employers to understand their organization’s monthly compliance status and offers guidance on how to properly improve and enhance compliance.
• Payment: Enables employers to easily pay bills by providing multiple payment options, ensuring a convenient and secure payment experience.
Download GOSI app today and enjoy a seamless experience

bluejetty:00044745:ios.name: Truthbrush
bluejetty:00044745:ios.summary: The Truthbrush is a small, decorative device that fits easily on any manual or electric toothbrush. It allows you to track all toothbrush events and monitor the duration and coverage. We all know that brushing twice a day for two minutes is
bluejetty:00044745:ios.description:
The Truthbrush is a small, decorative device that fits easily on any manual or electric toothbrush. It allows you to track all toothbrush events and monitor the duration and coverage. We all know that brushing twice a day for two minutes is essential to your health. Children often brush for a short duration, miss coverage areas, or simply forget to brush at all. You can't be with your kids for every brushing, Truthbrush can. 
With Truthbrush you can collect all brush event data seamlessly in the background. There is no start or stop button, it passively collects data so that you can view the trends over time. Truthbrush ends the "did you brush" argument and allows you to coach and reward your family for better oral health. According to the World Health Organization, dental care is the most unmet healthcare need in children and adolescents. Poor brushing leads to increased dental visits, cavities, periodontal disease, discolored teeth, and the loss of confidence that you get with a great smile. Studies have shown that bacteria in the mouth is related to heart disease, diabetes, pneumonia, and other serious health issues. Your family's health is the most important thing in your life. Truthbrush makes it possible to keep track of your family's toothbrush behavior and build great healthy habits.
The Truthbrush app shows daily toothbrush events and charts them over time. Understanding behavior and trends are critical to building great habits. The app displays the time of brushing, duration, and coverage. Truthbrush knows the difference between brushing teeth, applying toothpaste, and cleaning the brush. The app makes it easy to set goals and rewards, configure alerts and even share the brush event data with your dentist. Your dentist is a key partner in the health of your family. Truthbrush allows your dentist to check-in and helps without waiting for a six-month visit. The app allows you to set the beeping timer on the Truthbrush tracker for two minutes or any duration that you set. 
Key Features:
Track and monitor all brush behavior
Configurable beep timer
Weekly goals and rewards
Coverage analysis
Tips to guide better brushing 
Alerts and notifications
Performance report
Share data with your dentist

Daily & Weekly Reports
Get beautiful visual summaries of your chil
bluejetty:00120026:ios.description:
Daily Nanny is the best way for parents and nannies to share photos, track hours and overtime, keep in touch, and stay on top of everything happening in their child's day.
Daily & Weekly Reports
Get beautiful visual summaries of your child's day and week — sleep timelines, feeding totals, diaper breakdowns, temperature charts, and more. See everything at a glance.
Charts & Trends
Track naps, bottles, nursing, and diaper changes over weeks and months. Spot patterns, see averages, and understand your child's routines better with interactive charts.
Shifts
Nannies clock in, enter previous shifts, and see exactly how much they are owed, including overtime! Simply enter your hourly rate and overtime rate, and we do the math. Parents can track shifts, mark them as paid, and maintain a full payment history.
Events
Create events centered around your kids that everyone on your care team can see — appointments, play dates, activities, and more.
Photos & Video
Nannies and parents can upload photos and videos and comment on them, all automatically shared with everyone involved. Add grandma across the country to keep her in the loop!
Messages
A group messaging thread between nannies and parents keeps all your care-related communication in one place.
Tracker
Track daily information like naps, bottles, nursing, meals, diapers, medicine, activities, and more. Parents get push notifications when notable events happen during the day!
Family Sharing
For Premium features, one subscription covers your whole care team — spouse, co-parent, and nanny all get access. No extra cost.
Parents get notified whenever information is entered about their child, when a photo is uploaded, or when a message is received — and notification preferences are fully customizable.
Nannies: Enter the kids you care for and start tracking. Invite as many family members as you want!
Parents: Enter your kids and invite your nanny to start collaborating!
Read our privacy policy here: https://dailynannyapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00150954:ios.description:
O aplicativo Farid é a maneira mais eficaz e prática de realizar suas compras de supermercado. Com uma interface intuitiva e funcionalidades avançadas, ele oferece uma experiência completa de compras online, permitindo que você adquira todos os itens necessários sem sair de casa.
Com o aplicativo Farid, você tem acesso a um amplo catálogo de produtos, que abrange desde alimentos e bebidas até produtos de limpeza, higiene pessoal e muito mais. O catálogo é constantemente atualizado para garantir que você encontre os itens mais recentes e populares.
Navegar pelo aplicativo é simples e intuitivo. Você pode explorar as diferentes categorias de produtos, usar a barra de pesquisa para encontrar itens específicos ou até mesmo criar uma lista de compras personalizada para facilitar suas compras recorrentes. Além disso, o aplicativo permite filtrar os resultados por marca, preço e outros critérios, para que você possa encontrar exatamente o que precisa.
Ao encontrar os produtos desejados, você pode adicioná-los ao seu carrinho de compras virtual com apenas alguns toques. O aplicativo exibe claramente o preço, quantidade e informações relevantes de cada item, para que você possa fazer escolhas informadas. Além disso, você pode visualizar e gerenciar seu carrinho a qualquer momento, adicionando ou removendo itens conforme necessário.
Uma das principais vantagens do aplicativo Farid é a praticidade da entrega. Após concluir sua lista de compras, você pode escolher a opção de entrega em domicílio, selecionando a data e o horário mais convenientes para você. O aplicativo permite rastrear o status da entrega em tempo real, para que você saiba exatamente quando seus produtos serão entregues.
Além disso, o aplicativo oferece a opção de retirada na loja, caso prefira buscar seus produtos pessoalmente. Você pode selecionar a loja mais próxima e agendar o horário de retirada, economizando tempo e evitando filas.
Ao aderir ao aplicativo Farid, você terá acesso a uma série de vantagens exclusivas. Além da praticidade de fazer compras de supermercado online, o aplicativo oferece um programa de benefícios, o FARID COM VOCÊ, que você também poderá desfrutar de descontos exclusivos em uma ampla variedade de produtos, cashback, no qual você acumula créditos em suas compras, que podem ser utilizados em compras futuras. Com o Farid, você economiza enquanto faz suas compras!
O aplicativo também oferece recursos adicionais para aprimorar sua experiência de compras. Você pode salvar seus produtos favoritos para acesso rápido, receber notificações sobre ofertas especiais e promoções, e até mesmo criar uma lista de compras compartilhada com membros da família, facilitando o planejamento e a organização das compras.
A segurança e a privacidade dos seus dados são uma prioridade. O aplicativo Farid ,utiliza tecnologias avançadas de segurança para proteger suas informações pessoais e detalhes de pagamento. Todas as transações são realizadas em um ambiente seguro e criptografado, garantindo a proteção dos seus dados.
O aplicativo Farid, é a solução perfeita para suas compras de supermercado. Com uma ampla variedade de produtos, interface intuitiva, opções de entrega flexíveis e recursos adicionais, ele oferece uma experiência de compras online completa e eficaz.

THE STORY
It's a crazy world, there's food in the ocean! Help your cat fish tons of cute foods in this amazing fishing game. Catch and collect cute foods that will talk to you and your cat. Feed the foods you catch to turn those foods into money. Go deeper into the ocean to discover more foods and surprises!

Gameplay is simple and addicting! Tap to start fishing and swipe left and right to aim for foods. Use the coins to upgrade your fishing gear to catch more valuable foods to make even more money!
OFFLINE PROFITS
Earn coins when offline! Your cafe cat makes drinks while you are away. Use them to feed to your foods, making you even more money!

bluejetty:00098826:ios.description:
Welcome to Glacier Jewel Up — A Colorful Puzzle Adventure with Hidden Treasures!
Glacier Jewel Up is a vibrant and satisfying puzzle game where players merge gems of the same number to rack up points and trigger thrilling combo chains. With intuitive mechanics and gradually increasing difficulty, it's the perfect blend of casual fun and strategic challenge. Use powerful tools and smart moves to reach your highest score yet!
But the adventure doesn’t stop at merging gems. Glacier Jewel Up features a unique side mode — the Treasure Quest — where players can use a special chisel tool to dig through frozen layers beneath the game board. Break through the icy depths to discover hidden relics and ancient treasures, adding a new layer of depth and excitement to the traditional puzzle experience.
This innovative gameplay fusion encourages players to not only aim for high scores but also explore and unlock a rich world of collectible treasures, seamlessly blending core mechanics with rewarding exploration.
Game Features:
Addictive Merge Gameplay – Match gems of the same number for satisfying combos and points
Strategic Power-Ups – Use tools and boosters to maximize your merge potential
Innovative Treasure Quest – Dig beneath the board with chisels to uncover rare underground artifacts
Beautiful Visual Design – Immerse yourself in a glittering gem world with smooth animations and colorful effects
Download Glacier Jewel Up today and discover how deep your puzzle skills can take you — from dazzling combos to hidden treasures!

• Trauma
• Medical, Obstetrics, and Gynecology
• EMS Operations

bluejetty:00063555:ios.summary:

Jinny is helping Mr. Gummy Bunny escape from the hungry
bluejetty:00063555:ios.description:
Jelly Juice is a brand new match-3 game that will “wonderwow” you with its luscious candy, glittering game play, and sugar-crush challenges all filled to the brim with fruit juice! 
Jinny is helping Mr. Gummy Bunny escape from the hungry Pastry Chef! Join them on their adventure through Jelly Land where you'll explore magical and mysterious candy locations. Match 3 your way through an epic 10,000+ levels, create juicy combinations, and crush the magical Special Candies in this jelly-licious puzzle adventure saga! 
Take on the challenge alone or play with friends and crush the competition to see which one of you is the candy matching master! 
Just a taste of what's in store:
• Strategically combine and crush gummies to make magical candy combos (Jelly Beans, Bonbons, and Striped Candy just to name a few)!
• Combine Special Candy to make an even bigger candy explosion!
• Use Boosters like Gummy Hammers and Magic Wands to crush troublesome tiles and help pass levels for higher scores
• Have fun decorating Jinny and her friends’ houses with furniture, toys, and other stuff in the STORIES section!
• Have you finished all of your lives? Play SOLITAIRE and blast boredom while you wait for your lives to recharge!
• Travel through beautifully designed and imaginatively themed landscapes
• Be challenged by various sugary hazards (like Chocolate, Icing, and Cakes) and crush formidable bosses
• Enjoy vibrant graphics and an original story-line as you explore Jelly Land with Jinny and Mr. Gummy Bunny! 
Jelly Juice is:
• Easy and fun to play, but also a compelling and addictive candy strategy match-3 game
• A constantly growing world with 50 brand new levels added to Jelly Land with every single update!
• A game you can play with your friends and crush the competition!
• Enabled with easy game sync between devices: crush candy whenever and wherever you want! 
• • • • • • • • • 
Jelly Juice is completely free to play, though some in-game items such as extra moves or lives will require payment.
Have fun with Jelly Juice!

bluejetty:00074071:ios.description:
Privé: Period & Cycle Tracker offers a cycle tracker, an ovulation calendar, and a fertility tracker.
In a busy world like this, our AI-based menstrual calendar and ovulation calculator work perfectly to reduce your cognitive load, so you don’t have to worry about guessing the important days of your cycle.
Choose how you’ll use Privé: Period & Cycle Tracker according to your needs. You can simply use it as a menstrual calendar and track your periods, or use it for family planning with the help of the ovulation calendar to get pregnant.
Women of every age, including teen girls, can benefit from our all-inclusive flow tracker features and increase their knowledge of women’s health.
BENEFITS OF Privé: Period & Cycle Tracker INCLUDE
PERIOD TRACKER
The period tracker enables you to log your menstrual flow’s details, including your period days, PMS symptoms, flow intensity, spotting, and mood. Get accurate and science-based predictions on your following cycle dates. Your cycle tracker offers every tool you’ll need for your menstruation.
OVULATION CALENDAR
If you’re already trying to conceive for a while or are considering getting pregnant in the near future, all you need to do is to learn your peak fertile days from your personal ovulation calendar. Getting pregnant in the most natural way possible is by tracking your ovulation days, which increases your bbt (basal body temperature) and informs you that you are ready to get pregnant.
HEALTH DIARY
You can see Prive: Period & Cycle Tracker as a true cycle and fertility friend that keeps track of every detail about your reproductive health and offers tips to make you feel better and healthier. Log your PMS and period symptoms, spotting days, vaginal discharge, and mood swings during your cycle. It’s simply your new health diary.
KNOWING YOUR MENSTRUAL CYCLE BETTER
See your cycle and period length.
Realize your PMS and period symptoms.
Learn your ovulation days from the ovulation calendar.
Get an insight into your general health based on your period health.
Learn how you can manage the symptoms of your flow.
REMINDERS
Plan your life with peace of mind—Prive: Period & Cycle Tracker got your back. With our period and ovulation calendar’s high prediction ability on the important days of your cycle, there’s no room for surprises. Get reminders on period start and ovulation days, whether you’d like to track your period or track your fertile window to get pregnant.
INCREASED KNOWLEDGE OF FEMALE HEALTH
Connect with your unique body and increase your knowledge about your reproductive health. Get answers to your potential questions with our science-backed and easy-to-digest information on several categories concerning female health: period health, fertility, medical issues, sex, nutrition, psychology, relationships, exercise, and 40+.
CYCLE HISTORY AND CYCLE ANALYSIS
Cycle history and analysis offer an in-depth view of your menstrual cycles, providing valuable insights into your reproductive health. Accessible through your profile, these features allow you to track and understand your past periods and ovulation days more easily with intuitive graphics. Whether you’re trying to conceive or simply want to understand your body better, these tools are essential for every woman.
DATA SAFETY/PROTECTION
Have no worries about privacy, your personal information is safe with us.
Enjoy your private experience and have the freedom to delete your information anytime you want.
GET Prive: Period & Cycle Tracker AND HAVE ACCESS TO MULTIPLE USEFUL FEATURES INCLUDING PERIOD & FERTILITY TRACKER AND OVULATION CALENDAR
Important Note: Privé: Period & Cycle Tracker’s ovulation calendar should not be used as a form of birth control/contraception.
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
https://kompanionapp.com/en/terms-and-conditions/
PRIVACY POLICY
https://kompanionapp.com/en/privacy-policy/

listings.description:
Waiter is the dating app that gives you the best chance to find love

Forget wasting hours swiping through endless profiles.
Forget matches that never lead to a single conversation.
Forget fake profiles that aren't verified.

QUALITY OVER QUANTITY

Waiter only shows you people who truly match with you because one real match is worth more than a thousand pointless ones.

Every day, our Matchmaking AI selects 3 people for you to meet, and you get to choose the one you'd like to connect with (for free).

2 MILLION MEMBERS

Join a community of people looking for serious relationships, not just one-night stands.

Meet singles who want to take the time to truly get to know each other over time and aren't just there to seduce, please or flatter their ego.

500,000 MATCHES ALREADY MADE

It’s becoming harder to find someone genuine these days, but the good news is that real gems still exist.

Waiter has already brought together thousands of people who struggled to find the right person on typical dating apps.

YOU DESERVE THE BEST

Finding love is the most beautiful thing that can happen.
Waiter has created the best possible conditions to help you get there.
Give yourself every chance to love and be loved.

LET CLOÉ BE YOUR GUIDE

From the moment you sign up, you’ll have support from our godmother Cloé, who will accompany you throughout your search. If you have any questions, you can message her directly in the app.

Cloé can analyze your profile, your photos, and give you tips to break the ice with your matches. You’re in good hands.

READY FOR LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT?

Give yourself every chance to meet someone amazing with Waiter.
Your personality matters just as much as your looks, your passions and values too.
These are the things that make you truly unique, and they can’t be judged in a single second.

Trust us to help you find that rare gem.

Good luck from the entire amazing Waiter team.

bluejetty:00179124:ios.summary:
Grocery is the smartest and fastest grocery shopping app. Keep your list sorted while you shop with your Apple Watch. Easily add items from Siri and Recipes.
** App Store App of the Day - January 23rd 2021**
** MacStories Must-Have iOS Ap
bluejetty:00179124:ios.description:
Grocery is the smartest and fastest grocery shopping app. Keep your list sorted while you shop with your Apple Watch. Easily add items from Siri and Recipes.
** App Store App of the Day - January 23rd 2021**
** MacStories Must-Have iOS Apps - 2018 **
"Extra navigational steps, like remembering where you are in a list or backtracking through a store because of the order on paper, can really push a person over the edge if going to the store is their current 'Impossible Task'. They might opt for leaving with only half of their items, or just not go at all…which can project this task into the future, always a little unfinished or uncertain. Grocery reduces steps needed in the moment, and provides that little bit of joy every time an item is checked off the list in the UI. Knowing that I just made the future better, by going to the store and checking things off the list and improving the sorting algorithm! This is actually a huge relief: reduced doomsday feelings because I know that future store runs are going to be even easier/better because of what I did today (yay positive agency)!" - Amelia W.
- Key Features -
• Share your lists with partners and add items to your list on iCloud! 
• Grocery keeps your list in Reminders so sharing a list is as simple as sharing your calendar.
• Checking items off your list on Apple Watch is lightning fast.
• Create Recipes in Grocery for quickly adding ingredients to your shopping list, and a cooking experience optimized for mobile.
• Always know what items are in your pantry and when they expire with Inventory Tracking!
- Reminders - 
• Add items to your list on Mac or iCloud Reminder's apps
• Share your list by sharing a Reminder's list with others
- Siri -
• Tell Siri: "Add Eggs to my Grocery list"
• Create Siri Shortcuts to quickly add groups of items
- Lightning Fast - 
• Custom auto-complete with your list items and notes
- Sorting -
• Grocery learns every time you shop
• Keeps track of the order you mark off items to sort your list next time
- Multiple Stores -
• Add a Store for every place that you shop
• Associate lists with stores based on how you want to shop at multiple locations
• Assign geofences that change the selected store wherever you go
- Recipes -
• Recipe files are stored in iCloud Drive and sync between all your devices
• Innovative Markdown Recipe format optimized for cooking on mobile phones
• Automatically detects timers in recipe steps
- CleanUp -
• “12 oz of Chocolate Chips” becomes “Chocolate Chips: 12 oz”
• Detect multiple or duplicated items
- CoreML -
• CleanUp can use a custom CoreML model to recognize item titles and notes
- Backup & Data -
• Your list is always stored in Reminders for easy backup or access outside of Grocery
• Grocery will never modify your other Reminders lists
- Quick Add -
• Quick Add uses your shopping history to suggest items you frequently shop for. 
• It's great for adding frequently shopped for items to your grocery list.
- iPad -
• Grocery supports split view for Recipes, so cooking on your iPad works better than ever
• iCloud syncing makes creating a shopping list on your iPad super easy
Premium Features:
• Households share your stores, shopping history, planned recipes, pantry status, and all premium features with family members!
• Keep track of all the items in your pantry
• Automatic expiration and replenishment settings
Grocery Premium is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your Account will be charged the same price for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription’s one-year period. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions or cancel auto-renewal at any time on your Account Settings in the App Store.

bluejetty:00200152:ios.name: SharpStop Depth of Field Calc
bluejetty:00200152:ios.summary:
See what will be sharp before you press the shutter. SharpStop draws the sharp zone on the scene, plans a focus stack shot by shot, and tells you when tonight's Milky Way core is up.
Every tool answers in a sentence, not only in numbers: "
bluejetty:00200152:ios.description:
See what will be sharp before you press the shutter. SharpStop draws the sharp zone on the scene, plans a focus stack shot by shot, and tells you when tonight's Milky Way core is up.
Every tool answers in a sentence, not only in numbers: "Sharp from 1.8 m to infinity: you're at hyperfocal", or "4 shots: focus at 0.47, 0.70, 1.4, 2.5 m".
DEPTH OF FIELD, DRAWN
Camera, subject and horizon in one side view, with the sharp zone shaded from near limit to far limit. Change the focal length, aperture or distance and the band moves with it. The real front-to-back split is spelled out, because the old one-third rule only holds near the hyperfocal distance. One tap focuses at hyperfocal.
FOCUS STACKING PLAN
Enter the nearest and farthest things that must be sharp. SharpStop works out the fewest shots that cover the range with a small overlap, gives the focus distance for each one and draws the stacked zones on the scene. In the field, tick each frame off on a checklist with big targets, then share the plan as text.
MILKY WAY AND STAR TRAILS
For a dark-sky site or your own coordinates, you see when the galactic core is up in full darkness, how much of the moon is lit and which way to face, plus the three best nights in the next 30 days. The NPF rule gives the longest exposure before stars trail for your aperture and pixel pitch, with the 500 rule beside it for comparison. Nights you shoot go into a night log.
ND FILTERS AND FIELD OF VIEW
Your shutter speed with the filter on, in stops, optical density and ND factor at once, with a warning past 30 minutes. Field of view shows what fits in the frame at your subject distance, with a person drawn to scale.
YOUR KIT, SAVED
Save bodies and lenses and load them with a tap. Six sensor formats from 1 inch to medium format, each with its own circle of confusion. Print a hyperfocal card for any lens as a PDF. A glossary explains every term in plain words. Meters or feet.
BUILT FOR THE DARK
Amber on black, so a glance at 4 a.m. does not undo your night vision. Everything is calculated on the phone and works offline. The only part that goes online is the feedback form, when you choose to send a message. No account, no ads.
WHAT IT IS NOT
Depth of field is a standard for acceptable sharpness in a normal-sized print, not a physical edge: at 100% on screen the limits will look soft, and SharpStop says so. The core position is approximate (about half a degree), and weather and light pollution are not included. It does not meter light, model lens breathing or connect to your camera.

bluejetty:00063411:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00063411:ios.description:
A surge of good cheer, an island of your own, and exciting gameplay featuring a simulated amusement park await you in the free time management game Funmania!
Sophie’s friends have helped her reawaken her long held dream of running an amusement park with endless parties, and owning a little paradise on a tropical island where all her loved ones could come together. Sophie embraces her dream and opens her own theme park, where the fun never stops!
Getting everything to run smoothly takes a lot of work, but you can certainly manage it all: serving impatient customers who cannot wait to start having fun, dealing with staff trying to sneak away to take care of their personal problems, sudden breakdowns of arcade machines, and so on.
Thanks to you, Sophie will open amusement centers in amazing new locations. You will accompany her to space, to the jungle, and even... No, wait, that one is still a secret.
Sophie believes that her dreams will come true when she gets her own island! You can put your soul into equipping the island to your own taste, choosing from a huge variety of buildings, plants, decor elements, luxury items, and much more. All you need to do is put a little effort into reaching the Expert level.
In order to successfully pass the levels, you need to:
- serve customers and keep an eye on the queue
- show the door to any unwanted visitors
- play mini-games on arcade machines (Battleship, Claw Crane, and others) and prepare drinks and desserts
- purchase and upgrade arcade machines
- hire staff
- level up Sophie's abilities and buy magical boosters
- serve food and beverages to keep customers happy
What is on Sophie’s mind apart from her business and from improving her island? What is in her future: is it loyalty or betrayal, a secret admirer or a fleeting mirage of infatuation, a love triangle or staying true to her dream, confidence or timid stares and tentative steps?
How will the life story of the charming protagonist play out? You will find this out from vibrant comics and from her chat with friends, in which you will take part!
Game features:
- one hundred ingenuously designed levels of customer service in the time management genre
- ten unique amusement centers, and the secret keys to their success
- a variety of mini-games: arcade machines, a photo booth, a food court, and lots more;
- an engaging storyline: business strategy, romance, and secrets of friendship
- colorful chat screens and comics with memorable characters
- an opportunity to develop an island of your own
Share your success story with friends!
If you have any problems with the game please contact our Technical Support (Settings - Tech Support). We are always happy to help you!
We are using Apple Terms of Use (EULA) https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

FNB Oneida app is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FNB Oneida app:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FNB Oneida app, you must be enrolled as a First National Bank of Oneida digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00074060:ios.description:
Pain Medicine Assistant is your trusted clinical companion for pain management.
Developed by NYSORA, it offers structured, easy access to procedures, injections, and decision-support tools—designed for pain specialists, anesthesiologists, trainees, and educators.
Previously known as the Interventional Pain App, the latest version introduces a refreshed design, region-based navigation, and new clinical features—now including MAIA, your built-in Medical AI Assistant.
MAIA (Medical AI Assistant) is an innovative tool built to support—not replace—clinical decision-making.
Simulate cases, explore dosing strategies, and verify injectates with expert-reviewed, real-time guidance. MAIA brings practical, context-aware support right to your fingertips—when it matters most.
Access over 40 fluoroscopy-guided techniques, clinically validated injectates, and real-world case examples—everything you need, right at your fingertips.
Key Features:
 • 40+ chronic pain procedures organized by anatomical region
• Expert-curated clinical case studies for practical learning
• Regular content updates aligned with current standards
• MAIA – NYSORA’s AI assistant for real-time dosing and decision support
Join thousands of clinicians in 100+ countries using Pain Medicine Assistant to stay organized, informed, and confident in daily pain management practice.

bluejetty:00177541:ios.description:
Introducing "Multi Maze 3D," the ultimate going balls collecting experience that will keep you hooked for hours! 
FEATURES:
Dynamic Wheel Maze Gameplay: Spin the maze left or right to guide colorful balls through intricate labyrinths toward the cup.
Multiplying Ball Mechanic: Multiply balls as they cascade through the maze, filling the cup to the brim with every move.
Vibrant Visuals: Enjoy a feast for the eyes with dynamic, colorful graphics that enhance the puzzle-solving experience.
Intuitive Controls: Easy-to-use controls ensure players of all ages can dive into the action effortlessly.
Endless Puzzle Challenges: Navigate through a variety of mazes for hours of mesmerizing, ball-collecting fun.
Get ready to pull the pin and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world of this rolling ball puzzle game. Follow your journey through intricate mazes filled with rolling balls of various colors. Your objective? Guide the balls towards the cup and spin the wheel left or right. With each spin, watch as the balls cascade through the labyrinth, racing towards their destination.
But wait, there's more! This isn't just about collecting balls; it's about multiplying them and filling the cup to the brim. Prepare to amaze you, pull off impressive maneuvers, bouncing and gathering balls in a colorful frenzy. Can you handle the challenge of collecting as many balls as possible? Get ready for an exhilarating adventure as you navigate through the maze, going balls deep into the exciting world of ball maze!
Spin the wheel maze as it adds a whole new dimension to the classic ball maze concept. The vibrant hues and dynamic gameplay make Multi Maze 3D a feast for the eyes and a joy to play. Get ready to pull the pin and immerse yourself in a world where the possibilities are endless. Amaze yourself with the ability to spin the wheel maze and collect as many balls as you can!
With its intuitive controls and captivating visuals, Multi Maze 3D offers an engaging experience for players of all ages. Whether you're a fan of ball games, going balls, a puzzle enthusiast, or simply looking for a mesmerizing adventure, this game has it all.
So, what are you waiting for? Dive into the colorful depths of Multi Maze 3D and let the rolling ball guide you to victory. Remember, the more you spin, the many going balls you collect, and amaze you with a ball maze in this captivating journey through the world of labyrinth.
Are you ready to take on the challenge of ball games? Pull the pin, enter the multi-dimensional labyrinth, and let the adventure begin! Spin the wheel maze, left or right, to let the ball drop in the cup.

bluejetty:00168207:android.description:
A security guard at a roadside cafe is your new, and most importantly, simple and calm job... or is it?
After listening to a message from the old security guard, you realize that this establishment is not so simple! Your task: to hold out for 5 nights, defending yourself from dangerous animatronics. During the day, they are well-known heroes of the cartoon series of your childhood, favorites of children and parents, and at night they turn into real killers thirsty for revenge!
But you must keep your cool, save energy and constantly check the rooms to leave alive!
The game "Five Nights with Spheres" is a symbiosis of a well-known cartoon and a popular horror
In this game, you will get to know your childhood heroes from a different side!
It will be scary!

Monitor. Understand. Thrive.
Discover a healthier you with PulseFlow — the all-in-one app that puts your heart, mind, and wellness first.
Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast or managing daily wellness, PulseFlow empowers you to take charge of your health with fast, 
accurate measurements and holistic insights.
KEY FEATURES:
Heart Rate Measuring
- Measure your pulse using just your iPhone camera and flashlight
Blood Pressure Tracking
- Track your blood pressure trends and get personalized health insights
Blood Oxygen Monitoring
- Monitor your blood oxygen levels and view long-term patterns
- Blood oxygen monitoring requires manual input
Blood Sugar Recording
- Record your glucose measurements and visualize your daily patterns
Health Journal
- Record blood pressure, and emotional states
- Add personalized tags and notes to each reading
Personalized Health Reports
- Daily summaries to give you a quick snapshot of your wellbeing
- Weekly reports showing heart, stress, energy, stress trends
- Actionable suggestions to improve habits and balance
PREMIUM FEATURES
- Unlimited pulse monitoring
- Full access to wellness features
- Exportable health reports
- Ad-free experience and priority support
Begin with a free trial. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
You can manage your subscription in your iOS settings.
Disclaimer: PulseFlow is not a medical device. It is designed for general wellness and fitness tracking only. Heart rate measurements are for general wellness purposes only.
Privacy Policy: https://landing.pulseflow.health/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://landing.pulseflow.health/terms-of-service.html

Want to be the hotel tycoon? Get yourself into this real hotel & cooking madness life, feel grand hotel mania in Hotel Craze & Cooking Frenzy. People around the world love vacation, cooking. They travel for adventure or pleasure, and they will need the relaxing coffee time after one long day. It is time for you to run luxury hotels, build up your grand hotel team and show people the best hotel service and enjoy the cooking hot. Let's write the doorman story now and be the crazy chef!

Try different appliances to complete your game task, upgrade kitchenwares to get the best gaming experience.

What more Fun things bring to this game?

- Be ready for your guests' whims and serve them in time!
- Cook all kinds of yummy food to satisfy your guests!
- Collect likes, earn more and more love and recognize!
- Upgrade your hotels! Operate high-end hotels and earn more money!
- The Booster system makes your game time more fancy! 
- Don't forget to join our game task and events to get massive rewards! 
What kind of hotel will you get? A little motel with hamburgers and drinks? Or one luxury hotel with an elegant environment? Now it is time to write your own hotel story.

bluejetty:00071496:ios.name: AutoSleep: Watch Sleep Tracker
bluejetty:00071496:ios.summary:
Automatically track your sleep from your Apple Watch*. No buttons to press. Even the Watch app is optional! Just sleep!
Total Privacy.
-------------
AutoSleep has no user analytics tracking. No advertising plugins. No 3rd party code. No da
bluejetty:00071496:ios.description:
Automatically track your sleep from your Apple Watch*. No buttons to press. Even the Watch app is optional! Just sleep!
Total Privacy.
-------------
AutoSleep has no user analytics tracking. No advertising plugins. No 3rd party code. No data upload.
Ask your "free" sleep app if they can say the same.
Everything Included.
--------------------
No extra In App Purchases. No subscriptions. 
Apple Sleep Stages
-----------------
Full integration with Sleep Stages from the Apple Sleep app, so you have the option to use the Apple Sleep app and view all the information in AutoSleep.
Functions
-----------------
AutoSleep includes all the information and functionality you need for sleep monitoring, including:
Time Asleep – sleep duration and sleep bank balance
Sleep Rating – a consolidated rating score of your sleep
Sleep Rings – fill your sleep rings with quality sleep, including heart rate, deep sleep and REM
Apple Sleep Stages – option to use the data from the Apple Sleep app
Sleep Apnea - discover if you have sleep apnea
Sleep Blood Oxygen – measurements while sleeping
Respiration Rate – track your breathes per minute
Noise – environmental noise measurements
Sleep Analysis – view detailed graphs and breakups on your sleep cycles
Sleep Fuel – measure the quality and efficiency of your sleep
Snoring Intensity - using the AutoSnore app, view how snoring impacts your sleep quality
Tonight’s Bedtime – recommends your latest bedtime based on your habits
Readiness – indicates your physical and mental stress
Temperature – track your sleeping wrist temperature
Sleep Consistency – learn about your time to bed behaviours
Lights Off – track the time to fall asleep
Live Sleep Tracking – view your sleep statistics during the night
Smart Alarm – Watch in-built smart alarm to help you wake in lighter sleep 
Widgets – fantastic range of iPhone widgets
Complications – multiple Watch face options 
HomeKit – full integration with Apple HomeKit 
Emojis & Notes – record comments and tags to your sleep session
Explore – deep dive analytics views
Siri – use with Siri voice commands
Shortcuts – create your own shortcuts that you use with AutoSleep
Adjust – a simple function to adjust sleep/wake detection individual to you
History – advanced graphs and trends
Configuration – change the theme and design your clock sleep rings
Setup – customise your sleep goals, setup notifications and reminders
Exports – exporting options to save your data
About AutoSleep
-----------------
Using Advanced Heuristics AutoSleep works out how long you've slept so you don't have to.
If you DO wear your Watch to bed, you don't need to do a single thing. AutoSleep will track your sleep & quality and send you a notification in the morning.
Even if you don't wear your Watch to bed, AutoSleep can track your time in bed. It's extremely simple. If you DON'T wear your Watch to bed, then simply take your Watch off before you go to sleep. As soon as you touch your iPhone or put your Watch back on in the morning then AutoSleep will know that you have finished sleeping. 
As everyone is a little bit different. AutoSleep provides a simple setup wizard and an option to tweak if you are a very restless sleeper. 
AutoSleep also integrates beautifully with the Eclipse Yourself and HeartWatch apps, our premier heart, health, activity, recovery and readiness monitoring apps.
*Requires Apple Watch running WatchOS 4 or higher.

bluejetty:00187031:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00187031:ios.description:
Try Yandex Mail, a free email service for work and personal messages, with a simple interface and protection against spam and viruses.
Yandex Mail helps you stay organized and keep track of what matters. All your mailboxes, calendar events, documents, and notes — in one app.
Protection against spam and viruses
Smart algorithms filter out spam and viruses, so your in box only shows what you need. PIN code sign-in helps keep your emails private. Your data is stored in multiple copies in Yandex data centers, so your emails and attachments stay safe.
Easy email management on the go
What if I need to check my mail between tasks? In the app, you can reply to emails in one tap with smart suggestions, quickly browse new messages, and open attachments.
Offline mode
No connection on the metro or train? Received emails are still available offline, and outgoing messages are sent automatically as soon as the app is back online.
An organized inbox without manual sorting
Set up rules so Yandex Mail can automatically sort emails into folders, forward them, or turn on auto-reply. You can also unsubscribe from all newsletters at once in settings, without having to manually go through each email. 
Emails in any language
Got an email in another language? The built-in translator translates it into your language, so you can easily read emails in any language.
All your mailboxes in one app
To get mail from Mail, Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Rambler, or iCloud, add your account with one of these services to the app, or set up a mail collector.
Yandex Disk, Yandex Calendar, and Yandex Documents
Create events in Yandex Calendar, upload files to cloud storage on Yandex Disk, edit documents, spreadsheets, and presentations, and take notes. The built-in scanner turns a document or photo into a scan and attaches it to an email.
More features with Yandex 360
Want to do more with Yandex Mail? Yandex 360 gives you access to extra features:
— The AI filter highlights important emails in your inbox and gives you a short summary of each one. The smart assistant can also find information in your emails and help you write replies.
— Custom address instead of @yandex.com. Choose a short, unique address with your name or line of work, such as me@my-business.com. It shows what you do and helps your emails stand out.
— Subscription approval. New promotional newsletters will no longer appear in your inbox without your permission: Yandex Mail will notify you, and you can choose whether to receive or block them.
Who Yandex Mail is for
Yandex Mail is for anyone who needs convenient, secure, spam-free email for work and personal tasks. It's especially useful for:
— users with several mailboxes who want to keep them in one place
— users who correspond in foreign languages
— users who need email, calendar, and documents in one app
Install Yandex Mail to keep all your emails and tasks within reach.
Yandex Privacy Policy: https://yandex.ru/legal/confidential/
Yandex Mail Terms of Use: https://yandex.ru/legal/mail_termsofuse/

bluejetty:00136491:ios.description:
This Ukulele tuner app is the perfect app designed for ukulele players of all levels.
Unlike other complex ukulele tuner apps, Ukulele Tuner development by Tunio focuses solely on one instrument, the ukulele.
With the Ukulele Tuner app, you can completely tune your guitar without having to learn or read any instructions. It's really very simple for all ukulele players.
We provide all the tuning mode:
Soprano in C
Concert 
Tenor
etc,.
#1 Ukulele Tuner and Chord
Automatic mode helps users tune the strings quickly. When you regularly play the ukulele, you should use this mode because the application will automatically find the correct string to tune without you having to select each string.
The Optional mode is for ukuleles that have not been used for a long time and have more overlap in the strings, so you should choose the strings to tune accordingly.
** Intuitive & User-Friendly Interface
The app is designed with an extremely simple interface. Featuring three tuning modes, ukulele chord learning, and a relaxing game option, it serves as a companion to enhance ukulele skills, especially for those who are just starting to explore the world of ukulele
** Ukulele Chord Library
The Ukulele Chord Library is not the main feature of the app but our team tries to add value to the app. The chord library helps ukulele players learn and improve their knowledge of music theory in the most vivid and easy-to-understand way.
** The Left-Handed Mode
This feature is specifically designed to accommodate left-handed ukulele players, providing a tailored experience for their convenience. The app essentially flips the instructions and chord diagrams, making them easier to follow for left-handed individuals. This thoughtful feature ensures that left-handed players can comfortably view and comprehend chord placements and instructions, aligning with their natural playing orientation.
** Fun Game To Relax And Memorize Ukulele Chords
Users can test their chord recognition skills through quizzes, challenges, or interactive activities within the app. By gamifying the chord memorization process, it adds an element of fun and entertainment to the learning journey.
With the ukulele tuner, tuning your stringed instruments has never been so easy, fast and accurate! Try it now and let us know your experience!
Rate 5 stars for us if you love our app and continue to support us in the future. On behalf of our application development team, I would like to express my sincere thanks to the beloved users.

Any problem contact: support@appsnemo.com
