bluejetty:00076095:ios.description:
PREMIUM OFFLINE GPS NAVIGATION WITH FREE MAPS AND POI
Genius Maps is a free application that installs on your iPhone and iPad. It's an offline route planning, exploration and navigation app that doesn't require a mobile internet connection to search and navigate. All the maps are stored on your device, so there are no roaming costs and your battery lasts longer.
Genius Maps offers a free 7 day trial with fully-functional Pro Guidance and Live Traffic that can be activated at any time. Choose to upgrade to Pro Guidance during or after the trial or continue using the free professional-grade maps for planning routes and exploring with the pedestrian navigation at no cost.
________________________________________________
GENIUS MAPS IMPROVES HOW WE NAVIGATE OUR PLANET'S ROADS WITH OUR SMART DEVICES.
PROFESSIONAL NAVIGATION MAPS CAN BE DOWNLOADED FREELY, REMOVED AND REDOWNLOADED AS OFTEN AS YOU WANT EVEN AFTER COMPLETING THE TRIAL.
GENIUS MAPS' RICH FEATURE SET EQUALS AND EXCEEDS THOSE OF PROFESSIONAL NAVIGATION SYSTEMS.
________________________________________________
IN-APP PURCHASES
PRO GUIDANCE enables turn-by-turn voice instructions in your language, automatic rerouting, speed limit alerts, POI along the route and unlimited map updates for a selected region.
LIVE TRAFFIC lets you know about congestion, road works and accidents and reroutes your trip automatically. Instantly view realtime traffic info and adjusted travel times on multiple saved routes. Live traffic requires an active internet connection.
VEHICLE CONNECTIVITY allows you to connect Genius Maps to your car's infotainment system.
SAFETY CAMERAS informs you about approaching safety camera locations so you can be more alert to your surroundings and drive safer. 
Pro Guidance, Live Traffic, Vehicle Connectivity and Safety Cameras are paid options with a lifetime license for the selected region.
Check under Settings in the app for pricing and availability of Pro Guidance and Live Traffic. Go to Manage Maps and select a country to check the availability of Safety Cameras.
Unlimited map updates for PRO GUIDANCE users are available without additional charge and for as long as the product is supported. Coverage and feature support in the map will continue to match the original version, as long as the original is commercially available.
Lifetime license refers to useful life of the device and means the period of time that Mireo continues to support the app with updates. 
________________________________________________

Full coverage (including Russia and Turkey)
NORTH AMERICA
United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands
CENTRAL/SOUTH AMERICA
Argentina, Bahamas, Brazil, Cayman Islands, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Saint Barthélemy, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

ASIA/PACIFIC
Australia, Brunei, Hong Kong SAR China, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Macau, Malaysia, Maldives, New Zealand, Singapore, Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam
Genius Maps Puts The World in Your Pocket!
Note: Continued use of any GPS application running in the background can significantly decrease battery life. We strongly suggest using a charger while using the app in your car.

bluejetty:00126001:ios.description:
The South China Morning Post (SCMP) has been the most authoritative voice reporting on China and Asia for more than a century. As Hong Kong’s English-language newspaper of record, our international team of Asia experts, reporters, journalists, photographers and filmmakers are dedicated to providing breaking news and analysis from Hong Kong, China and beyond.
Our unique home base of Hong Kong allows us to have in-depth understanding of the China story from an insider’s perspective, while enjoying a high level of press freedom and independence granted by the city’s special constitutional principle of “One country, two systems”. Today, our dedication to representing the region with our editorial motto, “truth and fairness” is more relevant than ever before.
Our new app is our biggest app update ever. The update lets you explore curated content tailored to your news interests with My News, and informs you on the stories that matter to you with the redesigned top menu that allows you customise your reading preferences. 
AWARD-WINNING JOURNALISM
Download the South China Morning Post app and receive instant access to the SCMP’s award-winning journalism including coverage of the latest breaking news, both regionally and globally, including: US-China trade war and tech war, Trump vs Xi Jinping, the Hong Kong National Security law, Hong Kong protests and electoral changes, China military, South China Sea news, China’s relations with the EU, India and Australia, health and wellness, fashion and lifestyle updates, climate change and much much more.
KEY FEATURES
Breaking news alerts, tailored to your interests, including exclusives, explainers, live coverage and developing stories
Focus View, a personalised content discovery feature that keeps you informed on what matters to you
Article bookmarking to save your favourite features and articles
Follow your favourite topic/author with myNEWS and get five daily stories curated for you, plus a personalised feed of our most popular content
Customisable bottom navigation, so you can add, remove and rearrange your favourite sections with ease
Tailored top menu for seamless browsing of your preferred topics
Listen-to-article feature so you can listen to stories on the go (subscriber-only)
CONTENT AND COVERAGE
Keep informed with the latest Hong Kong and China headlines, opinion pieces, plus stories from the rest of the world
Full access to all SCMP content, including publications such as Post Magazine, This Week in Asia and Style
Full access to SCMP’s award-winning journalism including Hong Kong news, China news, Asia news, Business, Politics, Economy, Lifestyle, Tech, Health, and Sports
Wide-range of regional topics from our Asia experts including North Korea, South China Sea tensions, China’s Economy, Belt and Road, K-pop, as-well-as a spotlight on China’s tech-giants such as Tencent, Baidu, Bytedance, and Alibaba, Huawei and Xiaomi
Explore new ways to discover our insightful, unique content and current issues with SCMP Films, SCMP Spotlight and SCMP Podcasts, plus video, infographics, pictures and special reports
TERMS OF USE

bluejetty:00063578:ios.description:
New: Watch movies and TV shows for free with JustWatch TV
-Enjoy a growing selection of movies and TV shows you can stream for free with ads.
-Whether you're planning movie night, hunting for a hidden film gem, or simply looking for something new to watch, JustWatch TV makes free streaming simple.
-Watch ad-free with JustWatch TV Plus.
The Ultimate Streaming Guide for Movies and TV
Find out what to watch and where to watch it across 4,500+ legal providers globally, including Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Apple TV+, Amazon Prime Video, HBO Max, Tubi, and many more.
Features & Functionality
-100% Legal Offers: Find where to watch movies and TV shows online through paid subscriptions, free streaming, ad-supported streaming, rental, or purchase.
-Filters: Select your favorite services and filter by attributes like genre, release year, or age ratings (G, PG, PG-13, R, and NC-17) to find suitable content for kids.
-Search Engine: Browse 90,000+ movies and TV shows with trailers, synopses, casts, ratings, and VOD offers.
-Timeline: Stay up-to-date with daily lists of new releases and recently added content across your favorite providers.
-Popular: Discover the top-trending movies and TV shows online.
-Price Drops: Get daily updates on the best deals for renting and buying movies and TV shows.
-Watchlist: Add any title to your list, synchronize across all devices with a free account, and get notified when it becomes available on your services.
-Play on TV: Tap the button and start streaming on your TV in an instant.
JustWatch in the Press
"The easiest way to tell which streaming service has the show you want." — David Nield, Gizmodo
"The problem with cord cutting is that it can often be difficult to find what you're looking for on all of these streaming services. Thankfully, one nifty web app is looking to simplify the searching process." — Zach Epstein, BGR
"I have two essential pandemic companions: cheese and a website called JustWatch." — Shira Ovide, The New York Times
"There are several other similar services for finding what's streaming online, but JustWatch is probably the best I've found." — Ryan Hoover, Product Hunt
"JustWatch Debuts A New Search Engine For Cord Cutters" — Sarah Perez, TechCrunch
Global Availability
JustWatch TV is available in the United States, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain, Italy, Austria, Australia, and New Zealand.
In the United States, the JustWatch streaming guide lists offers from Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV+, Hulu, HBO Max, Disney+, Peacock, Paramount+, Tubi, Pluto TV, Starz, MGM+, AMC+, Fandango at Home, Crunchyroll, Shudder, Acorn TV, Sundance Now, BritBox, and Mubi.
The JustWatch streaming guide is available in France, Mexico, Brazil, South Africa, India, Malaysia, and many other countries, showing offers for providers like BBC iPlayer, Rakuten TV, Crunchyroll, Mubi, and Shudder (depending on regional availability).
Support
Got a question about JustWatch? Check our FAQs: support.justwatch.com
Can't find the answer? Get in touch; we'd love to hear from you: feedback@justwatch.com

bluejetty:00182828:ios.description:
Charge into the action in the best Tower Defense TD game ever created! Welcome to Kingdom Rush!
Kingdom Rush is the first installment of the award-winning offline tower defense saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers and critics around the globe.
Use your strategy to defend & guard the kingdom and its castle as you crush the forces of evil. At your command, you will have a vast arsenal of epic towers and spells! Command the mightiest heroes and lead the greatest army in Linirea to victory in this epic offline tower defense game that will keep you hooked for hours!
Fight on a castle outskirts, forests, mountains, and wastelands, customizing your defensive strategy with different tower tests and specializations! Rain fire upon your enemies, summon reinforcements, command your troops, recruit elven warriors and face legendary monsters on this adventure to save the Kingdom from the forces of darkness!
Kingdom Rush game features
SET YOUR STRATEGY WITH THESE AMAZING TOWERS AND UPGRADES
-PLAN YOUR STRATEGY! Choose among very different tower styles. Clash against your enemies! In this TD offline game, you will need to think about your strategy!
-MAXIMIZE YOUR ARMY'S POWER with 18 tower unique abilities. Rush and test them!
GUARD, LEAD AND CONQUER THE KINGDOM
-13 MIGHTY HEROES who will help lead your troops to victory!
-COMMAND YOUR ARMY into action and watch them engage in hand-to-hand cartoon combat! Clash the hordes of enemies!
EPIC TOWER DEFENSE CONTENT
-OVER 50 UNIQUE ENEMIES from Goblins to Demons each with their own unique attributes! Fantasy TD at its best!
-MORE THAN 60 ACHIEVEMENTS with easter eggs to discover and challenges to overcome!
-EXTRA GAME MODES that will push your TD battle strategies to the limit!
-INTENSE BOSS FIGHTS with the Kingdom’s greatest threats, going head to head with your allies!
-IN-GAME ENCYCLOPEDIA with useful information from your towers and enemies alike! Use this to plan your best strategy and clash with your enemies!
-PLAY OFFLINE! Test your defense skills even offline as the battle action does not stop even if the internet does! Enjoy hours of tower defense gameplay anytime, anywhere!
HEARD ON THE MEDIA ABOUT THIS EPIC TOWER DEFENSE ROYALE GAME:
89/100 Metacritic score!
"Probably the best true tower defense game. It's funny, it's polished, and it's hard as balls." - IGN (Editor's choice 9/10 "Amazing")
"One of the most engaging TD games we've played..." -Slidetoplay.com (STP Score of 4 out of 4 "Must Have")
"Kingdom Rush can be filed in the thin folder marked "games that are pretty much perfect" -JayisGames.com
"This is one kingdom you'll be in no rush to escape from" -PocketGamer (Gold Award - Score 9)
"Kingdom Rush proves that the defense genre is still alive." -148Apps (4.5 Stars out of 5) Editor's Choice
"TD with a Touch of Excellence" -toucharcade.com (4.5 stars out of 5)
#8 at CNET's Top 30 Tablet games.
#7 at IGN's Top 25 Mobile games.
Command your troops and towers to protect the kingdom! ! Play the epic tower-defense royale Kingdom Rush game with your defense strategy!

• Receive video calls from the intercom
• Track who called your apartment in the Video archive

• Search camera recordings over the front area using the Video archive with user-friendly event filters
• Open residential gates and wickets
• Communicate in chats with technical support, neighbors, and the property management office
• Send links with electronic keys to your guests
• Store all keys to doors, wickets, and barriers
• Share family access with your closest ones

bluejetty:00182711:ios.summary:
*** The best horse racing series on mobile! ***
Can you win the Cup and take the Crown of Horse Racing? The Quest has begun! 
Hire a jockey, train your horse, and compete in a variety of races from a local derby all the way up to winning
bluejetty:00182711:ios.description:
*** The best horse racing series on mobile! ***
Can you win the Cup and take the Crown of Horse Racing? The Quest has begun! 
Hire a jockey, train your horse, and compete in a variety of races from a local derby all the way up to winning the quest for the Cup! Photo Finish Horse Racing is the ultimate horse race simulation, featuring lifelike animation, stellar graphics, addictive gameplay and intense competition. Live the life of a jockey, owner, and spectator in the Sport of Kings! 
Play a quick race in a spare minute, or battle your way through the major derby to win the Cup!
--------------------------------------
CHAMPIONSHIPS:
Breeder, Jockey, Cup Champion. Triple the roles, triple the fun. Be it all in Photo Finish Horse Racing!
Have Kentucky dreams? Belmont ambitions? Intentions for Epsom? Start your racing quest now!
Will you earn your crown as Champion? Breed a championship caliber horse to win 
Rise in ranks until the day comes – the day you race in the derby! Get to the stable and get going!
BREEDING: 
Develop your stable and breed the ultimate stallion!
Do you have what it takes to be the best breeder? Breed the best to beat the best!
Make your stable a haven for the fastest horses!
RACING EXPERIENCE: 
Triple your rewards in online stakes! 
Graphics so good you’ll think you’re racing in VR! 
Race every day to reach the haven of the success! 
Race online against players from Belmont to Epsom!
TESTIMONIALS: 
Lloydo 2000 – “fantastic game, honestly the best I’ve played on my phone.”
Hannabooba – “This game is amazing if you haven ‘t downloaded yet, go download now”
Jungnshjej – “I love how you can breed the horses and enter contests”
Oh My Gosh Shelby A Wolf – “OH MY GOSH LUV IT!!!”
Hemlock Stable – “I love every aspect of this game”
Matfat – “I’ve been playing this game every day for two weeks!”
Spilla R. – “It is exactly like being in the Kentucky Derby, but being in it” 
Erica I. – “wish each tier of horse could have triple crown depending on their record for their season” – Added more races to every tier! 
Luke W. – “create your own jockey, name your horse, race others online, all this on a phone”
Shah S. – “Best horse racing game I have ever seen in my lifetime”
Miguel N. – “Fun chance to play all roles – jockey, trainer, breeder and owner” 
Well, what are you waiting for? You haven‘t begun your quest for the crown! 
--------------------------------------
* PLEASE NOTE! Photo Finish Horse Racing is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money.
Meet other players and find out more about Photo Finish Horse Racing:
* Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/photofinishgame
* Twitter: @photofinishgame (http://twitter.com/photofinishgame)
Note: Kentucky, Belmont, and Epsom are examples of cities and states our players have played in. No race takes place in Kentucky, Belmont, or Epsom. VR not supported, though we do love VR as much as the next VR enthusiast.

bluejetty:00088025:ios.description:
Unleash Your Entrepreneurial Spirit by building your business empire from the ground up with Sim Life, the ultimate investment simulator game that puts the power of entrepreneurship in the palm of your hands. As a budding virtual businessman, take charge of various aspects of economic and financial management, including stock trading, real estate investments, factory operations, and retail business.
Try Sim Life - Business Simulator Today!
Build Your Business Empire
In this entrepreneur simulator game, the possibilities are endless. Kickstart your entrepreneurial journey by establishing a variety of businesses, ranging from farms cultivating the finest crops to retail shops offering the trendiest products, and cutting-edge factories producing in-demand goods. Each business comes with its unique challenges and opportunities, allowing you to tailor your empire to your strategic vision.
Investment Simulator - Stocks, Real Estate, and Crypto:
Dive into the world of finance and make strategic investment decisions to skyrocket your wealth. This investment simulator goes beyond traditional business simulation games by introducing realistic stock markets, real estate ventures, and even cryptocurrency investments. Stay ahead of the market trends, buy low, sell high, and watch your net worth skyrocket as you master the art of financial management.
Tap Tap Clicker Tycoon Gameplay:
Get ready for an addictive Tap Tap Clicker Tycoon gameplay experience that will keep you hooked for hours. As you tap and click your way to success, watch your business flourish and evolve into a thriving empire. Put your strategic skills to the test and make wise decisions to become a rich man. Manage resources and capital, explore new opportunities, and grow your wealth to become a billionaire tycoon.
Become a Billionaire Tycoon:
Sim Life isn't like other business simulation games; it's an entrepreneur simulator designed to enhance your financial acumen. Sharpen your financial management skills as you navigate through the challenges of running a successful business. Make tough decisions, manage resources wisely, and discover the thrill of watching your empire grow as you inch closer to becoming a rich man.
Build a Reputation as a Successful Entrepreneur:
Unlike other business simulation games, it's not just about making money; it's about building a legacy. In this virtual businessman game, your actions shape your reputation as an entrepreneur. Provide stellar customer service, make ethical business decisions, and engage in corporate social responsibility to earn the respect and admiration of the virtual world. As your reputation grows, so does your influence in the business landscape.
Key Features of Sim Life - Business Simulator:
- Engaging investment games gameplay for all skill levels.
- Diverse range of businesses to start, manage, and expand.
- Realistic investment opportunities in stocks, real estate, and cryptocurrency.
- Experience realistic economic and financial scenarios
- Hire and manage employees to optimize productivity
- Make informed decisions to maximize profits
- Build a reputation as a successful entrepreneur
Are you ready to turn your rich man dreams into reality? Sim Life - Business Simulator and experience the excitement of building your business empire, one tap at a time. The journey to billionaire tycoon status starts here!
This game is solely for entertainment purposes. Please note that all in-game currency and rewards hold no real-life value. They cannot be exchanged or converted into real-world currency or assets.

bluejetty:00147536:ios.summary: Flair is Next Degree™ climate control for your home air conditioning and heating system. With the Flair app, you can enjoy room-by-room comfort anytime, anywhere by adjusting your temperature setpoints and creating schedules for individual
bluejetty:00147536:ios.description:
Flair is Next Degree™ climate control for your home air conditioning and heating system. With the Flair app, you can enjoy room-by-room comfort anytime, anywhere by adjusting your temperature setpoints and creating schedules for individual rooms. Away from home? Our geofencing will make sure you save energy by automatically setting rooms as active or inactive as needed.
You can use the Flair app to
-Easily set up your Flair Puck and Smart Vents. You can also connect your Flair devices to your mini split, Nest, ecobee, Honeywell Lyric, and even your Alexa or Google Assistant devices. 
-Get room-by-room comfort. You can create schedules to make sure every room in your home is comfortable.
-Save energy. Set up geofencing and Smart Away to make sure your rooms are exactly how you want them when you're out of the house.
-Share home comfort. Set up account permissions for friends, family, or a house sitter. But don't worry: anyone can set a temperature directly from the Puck, even if they don't have the App. 
Have some thoughts? We always want to hear your feedback on our app. Send them our way: hello@flair.co

지금, 가장 안심되는 중고거래를 경험해보세요.
※ 앱 접근 권한 안내
2017년 3월 23일부터 시행된 정보통신망법령 제 22조의 2(접근 권한에 대한 동의)에 따라 서비스 이용 시 꼭 필요한 접근권한을 아래와 같이 안내해 드립니다.
[필수적 접근권한]
- 기기 및 앱 기록 : 앱 오류 확인 및 사용성 개선
- 기기ID : 기기 식별 및 추적, 서비스 확인
- WI-FI 연결정보 : 앱 이용 네트워크 연결 체크
[선택적 접근권한]
- 저장공간 : 사진 작성 또는 저장
- 위치정보 : 지도 기능 사용시 위치 정보 검색 및 위치 공유
- 카메라 : 채팅, 글 및 프로필 작성 사진 또는 동영상 촬영
- 마이크 : 동영상 촬영시 음성 인식
■ 선택적 접근 권한은 관련 기능 이용 시 동의하실 수 있으며, 미동의 시에도 해당 기능 외 앱 서비스는 이용 가능합니다.

bluejetty:00121708:ios.description:
Voice Recorder & Audio Memos - My Memos is a full-featured free voice recording app with a streamlined and intuitive user interface. Press the big red button to record voice; press it again to stop and manage your recordings, all with just a fingertip. High-quality sound reproduction. Don’t forget recording music! You can also use it to record voice over. There’s no time limit in this audio recording app.
iPhone audio recording for all occasions, whether you want to record meetings, lectures, interviews, speeches, lessons, band practices, family memories and so on anything you want to save and listen to later with this sound recorder app. Audio Recorder easily share & edit with you recorded audio and memos. You can also manage each voice recording.
Professional Voice Recorder for all iOS devices! No limitations, Secret Voice Recorder, Background voice recorder, Audio to Text, Completely FREE!
Transcribe all your meetings, interviews, lectures, and everyday voice conversations and share with anyone.
Voice Memos can record directly in MP4 (AAC) and WAV (PCM) formats plus convert function for all supported formats.
You can share any recording memos straight from the audio recorder app anywhere you want.
● AUDIO QUALITY OUTPUTS:
- Audio recorder & Podcast recorder - High quality audio recorder
- Recording app to record voice memos via phone recorder
- No time limit for audio recording, easy voice recorder & audio app
- Voice recording formats: M4A, WAV, MP3
- Sound attributes: Mono, Stereo
- Sample rate and Bitrate adjustment
- Sound sources: Mobile phone recording, Microphone recording
● FEATURES:
- Free Record audio voice with Low, Medium, High quality
- Unlimited recording with good sound quality
- Email your recordings directly from Memos
- iTunes File Sharing
- WebDAV, FTP, Google Drive, DropBox, iCloud File Sharing
- Easily Trim recording with Audio trimmer & share it via Email, Messages, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, etc
- Audio trimmer with backup your original audio
- File encoding(M4A or WAV) for audio and voice memos
- Voice Record in the background: record voice when screen is off
- Rename and Share it via Email, Messages, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, etc
- Set Label for recorded audio
- Audio player & Audio cutter for recording
- Fast audio playback support with Audio player
- Use as a Spy Recorder by using Indicator Brightness
- High-quality handheld recording
- Easy, convenient user interface and controls

bluejetty:00172146:ios.description:
Discover the power of our app - Device Monitor Z (also known as iDevice Monitor) is an app optimized for iPhone, iPod Touch, and iPad users. It provides a quick and efficient way to access activity monitor (CPU monitor, detailed RAM, Storage space, ...) and system information of device.
- Key Features:
• View basic CPU information and real-time CPU monitor
• View basic GPU information.
• View basic device information (System status)
• View basic OS (Operating System) information
• View basic battery information
• Check Memory & Disk (RAM & Storage) information details.
• Monitor network traffic with real-time upload and download speeds.
• Support Quick Actions to run functions quickly from Home Screen
• Access camera information.
• Access display information.
• Check supported sensors
- Support Widget to display device information such as RAM/Disk/CPU/Battery/Network info:
• iOS 14 Home Widget
• iOS 16 Lock Widget
• iOS 17 Standby Mode for Widget
- System Fonts:
→ Show all fonts available in the system
- Additional Tools:
• Performance Benchmark:
→ CPU Benchmark: Measure the computational capability of the device's CPU.
→ Disk Benchmark: Measure sequential read/write speed, random 4K read/write speed, and latency of internal storage.
• Network Analyzer (also known as Wifi Analyzer or Network Tool), including:
→ SpeedTest: Evaluate internet download speed and upload speed (powered by SpeedChecker)
→ LAN Scanner (also known as Wifi Scanner or Network Scanner): Scan devices on your local network
→ Ping tool: Measure latency to a domain/IP Address
→ Traceroute
→ Port Scanner: Verify open or closed ports on domain/IP Address
→ DNS Lookup (support DoH and DoT): Retrieve domain information
→ DNS Speed Test (support DoH and DoT): Measures and compares the query response times of various DNS servers, helping users identify and select the fastest server for enhanced network performance.
→ Bonjour Service Browser: List the Bonjour services advertised on your wireless network.
• Screen Test:
→ Perform quick screen tests
• Sensor Monitor, including:
→ GPS
→ ALTIMETER
→ ACCELEROMETER
→ MAGNETOMETER
→ GYRO
→ MOTION COPROCESSOR
→ MAGNETIC
→ GRAVITY
→ ROTATION
→ ROTATE RATE
• Toolkit:
→ Anti-Mosquito
→ Decibel Meter: Gauge ambient noise levels accurately in your surroundings.
→ Bluetooth Scanner: Find Bluetooth devices near your device.
→ Flashlight Torch.
→ Export all device information into a file with multiple formats (csv, pdf, xlsx, json, rtf, txt).
• Thank you for choosing our app as your device information and monitoring app.

bluejetty:00159138:ios.description:
Knowing where it’s legal to fly your drone can be complex. OpenSky is the simplest and fastest way to view drone rules and regulations in the U.S. and Australia. Powered by Google Maps, pilots can find out where to fly their drone, plan a flight with a few quick clicks, check airspace rules and get automated access to controlled airspace (LAANC).
Features of OpenSky include:
Guide for drone flying - Find out where and when you can and cannot fly.
Compliance maps from Aviation Authorities - OpenSky makes it easy to visualize airspace rules tailored to your operation and aircraft; for both commercial & recreational drone operators.
Identify Risks - OpenSky will help identify possible flight hazards in your area like Temporary Flight Restrictions (TFRs).
Airspace authorizations - Drone operators can automatically request authorization to fly in controlled airspace, often the busy airspace near major cities. In the United States this is called LAANC.
Track your missions - OpenSky will track and manage your past and upcoming flights, notify you of changes to any planned flights.
You can find out more about OpenSky at: www.wing.com/opensky.

bluejetty:00186896:ios.description:
Speak a new language with real-life conversations. Babbel is the award-winning language learning app with courses tailored to your native language, built by 200+ language experts and trusted by millions worldwide.
Because lessons are built for speakers of your language, an English speaker learning Spanish gets different lessons than a French speaker does. You learn to speak, listen, and understand grammar in context, then practice real conversations with Babbel Speak, an AI conversation partner that gives you personalized feedback.
Learn a new language faster with bite-sized lessons designed to fit your everyday life. With Babbel’s proven method, you could start having real conversations in as little as 3 weeks. Your language learning adventure starts with a lesson.
WHY BABBEL WORKS
• Tailored to your native language: Courses are created by language experts and tailored to your native language, so you learn naturally and efficiently.
• Real-life conversations: Learn the language people actually speak, for travel, work, and everyday life.
• Speak with confidence: Practice out loud with speech recognition and Babbel Speak, an AI conversation partner to improve your pronunciation.
• Research-proven results: Efficacy backed by researchers at Yale University: 100% improved their oral proficiency in 3 months.*
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
• 25 million subscriptions sold 
• 1.5 million 5-star ratings (based on App store ratings) 
• After 10 hours with Babbel, 96% of learners saw better test scores on grammar and vocabulary**
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Short, effective lessons: Learn in as little as 10 minutes a day 
• Lessons for every motivation: Learn for travel, work, or fun 
• Listen, speak, write: Options for every learning style 
• Stress-free conversation practice: Build confidence with Guided Conversations, then practice freely with Babbel Speak (Beta) 
• Smart review system: Boosts learning and retention 
• Grammar in context: Clear explanations exactly when you need them 
• Offline mode: Download lessons and learn anywhere, anytime 
• 5,000+ courses: Over 60,000 lessons across all languages
LEARN 14 LANGUAGES
Spanish (Latin American or Spain), French, Italian, German, Portuguese, English (American or British), Russian, Polish, Turkish, Norwegian, Danish, Swedish, Dutch, and Indonesian.
TRY BABBEL TODAY
Download Babbel now and take a free lesson.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
A subscription is required to access full courses. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple account.

There are 11 different, interesting and exciting mouse levels! Game is built, timed and optimized for cats! Three mini-games after each 100 hits. Mice a
bluejetty:00121681:ios.description:
Mouse for Cats is legendary 2D game for cats. Catch the mouse in original HDR graphics.
There are 11 different, interesting and exciting mouse levels! Game is built, timed and optimized for cats! Three mini-games after each 100 hits. Mice are all in different colors with animated shape, irritating tail moves and sounds so your cat pays a serious attention to the game.
Important: This is game FOR CATS - NOT FOR DOGS! please READ How To use this app for cats bellow.
*** Game contains free squeak sounds - you must hear test sounds while tapping on Squeak menu entry.
!! Verify that your device is capable to play mice sounds before you buy unlocks !!
If you can't hear any sounds, check your Ringer switch, Effect volume, close all apps or reset device setting. if problem remains, please contact us with your device model and iOS version. ***
Full version offers: 
------------------
- Multi Mouse Mode (1,2,4) - 4 mice for more cat players!
- Select your cat's favorite set of mice, all mice, or just single mouse
- Premium Queeny mouse
- Premium Robo mouse
- Mice sounds
- Random mouse level order
- Vibrations (iPhone)
- Mouse level speed selector
- Screen unlocked forever.
- no Ads.
* this game for cats helps to keep your cats happy and playful, do not leave them alone just with tablet, play with them anyway *
Please read HOWTO use this app for cats:
----------------------------------------
- check if there are no disturbing REFLECTIONS from the cats angle of view.
- if your cat constantly switching between apps, disable MULTITASKING gestures in your iPad settings (cat paw contains more segments it is like 5 figers...).
- adjust BRIGHTNESS - remember that cat needs lower values (10-40%).
- game has "Back to Menu button" - Minimize and restore app and Menu button will appear for 5 seconds.
This game for cats is recommended for active indoor cats.
Kittens always jump in action instantly, older or outdoor cats may ignore game, they know it is virtual, you can try it later ideally when your cat gets in hunters mood, mostly about 3am :)) 
PLEASE REMEMBER: Your CAT IS NOT ROBOT nor TOY with button to activate chase mode. Respect their nature and don't expect that they will do exactly what you have seen on YouTube videos ;) 
Mouse for Cats is free game for cats, 11 different mouse skins for every round. Offers more fun than just single laser point... You can support us by purchasing in-app Unlocks and you will get unlocked Mouse for Cats with real sounds, premium mice, multi mouse, set random or favorite mouse, speed, level order.
This game for cats is only for cats, please note:
SKINS ARE NOT REAL, MICE ARE NOT REAL :) 
As the real rubber toy is not real mouse and even does not squeak like the real mouse, mice in this game are toys and they are colored for cats - not for humans, same applies for selected sounds - everything was massively tested and it is interesting action game for most cats.
TIP:
Try tap on mouse and move it around to get cat interested in game. Show how to tap on screen, they should follow you. Our cat testers reaching score above 100 in few moments, some of them are able to recognize Mouse for Cats icon and start whole application from the iPad home screen!! 
You can try it even on small iPhone, there were nice results too, but game runs best on iPad with retina display.
!
To prevent scratches on the backside of the device, please do not put your device on the hard surface without protection cover!
Carpet or bed are best and safest places.
Cat may have some hard particles on the paws - protection film or tempered glass are recommended too.
!

https://youtu.be/31ZrpgtpW74

we are cat lovers = our games for cats are free.
You can support development by purchasing extended features or just by 5-stars rating on AppStore ;) 
 Thank you.

bluejetty:00013831:ios.summary: AwardWallet can track almost any type of loyalty points, such as frequent flier miles, hotel points, or credit card points. Load up all of your loyalty accounts and let AwardWallet track all of them for you. In addition to tracking points a
bluejetty:00013831:ios.description:
AwardWallet can track almost any type of loyalty points, such as frequent flier miles, hotel points, or credit card points. Load up all of your loyalty accounts and let AwardWallet track all of them for you. In addition to tracking points and miles (and account expirations) AwardWallet also has the following amazing features:
* Management of travel plans. Link your mailbox and let AwardWallet track all of your travel reservations. We will send you push notifications if and when your flights are delayed or canceled and let you share your travel plans with friends and family. 
* Credit card spend analysis. Add your bank accounts to AwardWallet and let AwardWallet analyze your spend and tell you if you are using the right credit cards. This way, next time, when you are shopping, you can use the card that gives you the maximum number of points at a given merchant. 
* Merchant lookup tool. Enter any merchant name, and we will tell you how it is coded and which cards earn the most points at that merchant. 
* Account balance watch. If you are transferring points from your bank into your airline account to book a flight and that transfer is not instant, you can have AwardWallet monitor this account. As soon as we detect the change, we will send you an email and a push notification. 
* Loyalty account history. In addition to tracking your loyalty account balance and expiration, we also load all of your historical account transactions into AwardWallet, so you have one place to review all of your loyalty transactions. 
AwardWallet Plus subscription gives you the following additional features:
* Displaying additional reward account properties
* Showing all of your loyalty account expirations where expiration is known.
* When you update all of your accounts they are updated in parallel, up to 5x faster.
* More comprehensive monitoring and tracking of your flights.
AwardWallet Plus is a subscription-based service, the subscription length is 1 year and when you subscribe it will be set to auto-renew every year thereafter. The cost of the subscription is $49.99 per year. AwardWallet Plus subscriptions purchased from the app will be charged to your iTunes account and will automatically renew within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period unless auto-renewal is disabled beforehand. To manage your subscriptions or to disable auto-renewal, after purchase, go to your iTunes account settings. No refunds will be issued after the annual subscription fee has been charged. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited once a subscription is purchased.
For more information, see the Terms of Use (https://awardwallet.com/m/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://awardwallet.com/m/privacy).

bluejetty:00121928:ios.description:
Experience the top tier mobile motorbike racing!
Surpass maximum speed around the circuit.
Let the speed awaken your instincts and experience the real motorbike racing!
Ride the best Super Motorbikes and experience the racing adrenaline.
Campaign mode’s difficulty varies depending on the tracks.
Break the world records with your skills!
Become the World Champion with your best record!
Easy controls creates an energetic racing experience. 
Just give it a go!
■ Features
- Various view points and controls.
- Realistic speed and motor sound
- Over 150 challenges
- 11 types of unique motor bikes
- Customize each bike with cool colors
- Real-time world record competition through the Leaderboards.
■ TIP
* You can get oil, coins, or other rewards every time you clear an event mission.
* Practice often and collect upgrade pieces.
* Upgrade your bike to increase its speed, acceleration, cornering, and brake performance.
* Login with Game Center ID and race against your friends.
* This game supports 13 languages.
Follow us to get news and updates;
https://www.facebook.com/dreamplaygames/
[Caution]
- Enabling iCloud Save will allow the program to overwrite the data in the device, and may delete the existing data (play and/or purchase information). 
We recommend that this function is used only to transfer saved data when you change your device.
- Data (play and/or purchase information) deleted by the iCloud Save function is irrevocable.
- iCloud Save function can be used only when you are logged in with Apple ID.
- Tap on the "Save Data" button frequently to synchronize the data saved in the iCloud to prevent data loss.
- Use the "Load Data" function only when you have changed to a new device or when all the data is lost. 
- We will not be responsible for any rolled-back data (play and/or purchase information) caused by the "Load Data" function.
- Real Moto's supported optimum service devices are at least over A6 chipset(e.g. iPhone5).

bluejetty:00128202:ios.summary: Making paper sketches of objects can be a tedious job. You have to draw the object, add dimensions and make sure others will understand what you meant. Often they don´t. My Measures is a powerful application for storing and sharing object d
bluejetty:00128202:ios.description:
Making paper sketches of objects can be a tedious job. You have to draw the object, add dimensions and make sure others will understand what you meant. Often they don´t. My Measures is a powerful application for storing and sharing object dimensions. All you have to do is take a photo of an object and add dimensions: arrows, angles, photos of details and equip them with text comments for easier understanding.
My Measures is a must have tool for real estate agents, engineers, carpenters, architects, auction sellers, construction workers and DIY.
With My Measures Cloud you can synchronise projects between your devices, access files on computer via Web browser, collaborate with others using shared folders and share or receive files through Download and Receive links.
Key features:
- Annotate photo with arrows, angles and text comments
- Include multiple detail photos
- Organize projects in folders
- Imperial, Metric, Chinese and Japanese units
- Supports Fractions 
PRO features:
- Share project as PDF or images
- Export projects to Dropbox, Google Drive, …
- Unlimited files and annotations
- Advance tools: snap, zoom, calculations
- Transfer projects to Mac and Windows PC
- Secure projects with password or Touch ID
- Leica DISTO laser meter support
Top App Cloud features:
- Cloud collaboration (group projects)
- Cloud sharing (share only link to files and folders)
- Cloud backup
- Cloud access projects via browser (no app needed)
- Synced projects on multiple devices
Top App Cloud Subscription:
- price is $2.99/month or $19.99/year
- payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- terms of service: http://cloud.topapp.si/legal/tos
- privacy policy: http://www.topapp.si/privacy-policy
Premium subscription
My Measures offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription for $5.99/month, an auto-renewing yearly subscription for $36.99/year and an auto-renewing 3 month subscription for $13.99/3 months to provide you with unlimited projects, Cloud & Backup, Password protection, Sharing, Advanced Tools and Advanced View options while you maintain an active subscription.
PLEASE READ THIS:
This version of My Measures is FREE so you can test it if this is what you are looking for. Advanced features are available with in-app purchase Upgrade to PRO or when Top App Cloud is enabled.
But if you find that you don’t need this app just delete it. There is no need for you to give us a 1 star rating because we want to charge you for something that a team of 5 people was working on for more than a year.

bluejetty:00134076:ios.name: Oeni: #1 Wine Cellar Manager
bluejetty:00134076:ios.summary:
//The most downloaded wine cellar management app in 2025!
Oeni helps you manage your wine cellar/collection and recommend the best wine at the best time (peak). Whether you're a seasoned collector or a casual wine lover, Oeni offers compreh
bluejetty:00134076:ios.description:
//The most downloaded wine cellar management app in 2025!
Oeni helps you manage your wine cellar/collection and recommend the best wine at the best time (peak). Whether you're a seasoned collector or a casual wine lover, Oeni offers comprehensive tools to easily manage your wine inventory.
//Master your inventory at your fingertips
Oeni tracks the history of your cellar, its stock, and aging with precision and simplicity.
- Discover our immersive 3D wine cellar feature to easily visualize and organize your bottles, as if you were there!
- Scan and add your bottles quickly: With a directory of more than 400,000 bottles, including majestic wines, adding your wines to the Oeni cellar only takes a few seconds. Our application has similar performance to other well-known wine apps such as Vivino, VinoCell, Invintory or wine-searcher or CellarTracker.
- Specify their vintage: By adding the vintage of your bottles, Oeni will be able to recommend the ideal time to open them.
- Enter their purchase price: The purchase price of your bottles is a crucial element for tracking your expenses and investments over time.
- Monitor your stock: Oeni allows you to know your stock accurately and will help you manage it over time. Your cellar will no longer have any secrets for you.
- Analyze their aging: Follow the aging phases of each of your bottles to know their maturity level and peak date.
- Enjoy with the right dish: Oeni recommends food and wine pairings with over 5,000 dishes so you don't miss any tasting.
- Analyze Aging: Follow the aging phases of your wines to determine their maturity and peak dates. Oeni’s vino wine scanner feature helps you understand the aging process better.
//Track the financial value of your cellar
Oeni analyzes the price of each bottle and follows its evolution over time.
- Measure your expenses: Analyze your expenses month by month, year by year, to understand and adapt your budget.
- Know the value of your cellar: Every month, Oeni retrieves the market price of your bottles to continuously update the value of your cellar.
- Track your capital gains: Oeni informs you of your real-time capital gains and bottle by bottle, so you don't miss anything.
- Expense Analysis: Monitor your expenses month by month and year by year to better understand and manage your budget.
- Value Tracking: Oeni updates the market price of your bottles monthly, providing an accurate valuation of your cellar. Our wine reviews cellar feature keeps you informed about the current market trends.
- Capital Gains Monitoring: Stay informed about your real-time capital gains on each bottle to optimize your collection.
//A personal and intelligent sommelier
Oeni manages your wine cellar and recommends the right wine at the right time.
- Food and Wine Pairings: Choose from over 5,400 food and wine pairings to find the perfect pairing for any meal. Oeni will make recommendations as relevant, or even more relevant, than other apps like Vivino, cellartracker or Wine Scanner to provide you with the best recommendations.
- Refine your search by specifying the occasion: "an everyday wine," "a nice dinner with friends," or "for special occasions."
- Oeni will then analyze your wine cellar to find the perfect match based on food and wine pairings, the aging phases of your bottles, and their market value.
- Oeni offers its selection of bottles with a recommendation percentage for each of them. All you have to do is choose.
Additional Features :
- Extensive Wine Database: Access a database of over 400,000 bottles and 2,400 appellations.
- Detailed Wine Information: Get complete details on each bottle, including wine reviews and ratings
- Best cellar management tool for wine collection
More information on the terms of use and the privacy policy
Privacy policy: https://oeni.app/en/politique-de-confidentialite/
Terms of use: https://oeni.app/en/conditions-generales-dutilisation/

bluejetty:00131109:ios.description:
Do you often forget to record your blood pressure data?
Do you need reminders to measure your blood pressure and take medication on time?
Do you want a convenient tool to keep track of your health status anytime?
Introducing "Akso: Recording Health"! It's a powerful app that provides comprehensive blood pressure management and health reminder services for you.
Our goal is to help you easily record your blood pressure data, set health reminders, and keep track of your medications.
Key Features:
Blood Pressure Recording: Conveniently record your blood pressure data, including systolic and diastolic readings. You can view your historical records anytime.
Health Reminders: Set regular health reminders such as hydration reminders, blood pressure monitoring reminders, medication reminders, and more.
Medication Tracking: Easily record information about the medications you take, including medication names, types, and dosage times. Never miss a dose.
Abnormal Data Analysis: Monthly statistical reports on any abnormal blood pressure readings you may have, helping you understand your health.
Personalized Reminder Settings: Customize the timing, frequency, and content of your health reminders based on your preferences and needs. You can also personalize medication reminders according to your requirements.
We are dedicated to providing a user-friendly and comprehensive blood pressure tracking and health reminder app to help you better focus on and manage your health. Additionally, keeping track of your medications helps you better manage your medication regimen and maintain your well-being. Let's pursue a healthy lifestyle together and enjoy a better quality of life!
(Please note: This app is for reference and assistance only, and cannot replace medical advice or diagnosis. If you have any health concerns, please consult a doctor.)

bluejetty:00122338:ios.summary:

Play the WSOP Texas Holdem Poker game for free, take your seat at the tabl
bluejetty:00122338:ios.description:
World Series of Poker is the official free-to-play poker app for players who love Texas Holdem, competitive tournaments, and rewarding progression all in one place.
Play the WSOP Texas Holdem Poker game for free, take your seat at the table, and compete with players from around the world. Whether you’re a seasoned poker player or just getting started, WSOP offers a mix of tournaments, collectibles, mini-games, and daily rewards to keep every session exciting.
Compete like a WSOP champion
Win Rings and Bracelets inspired by the World Series of Poker experience and show them off on your profile. Climb the tables, build your reputation, and prove yourself against players worldwide.
Tournaments and game modes
Play Texas Holdem Poker across a variety of game modes designed for different play styles. Join tournaments, take on 3-player showdowns, Beat The House, become King of the Table, and dive into Wild Poker for even bigger moments and rewards.
Whether you prefer classic Texas Holdem action or exciting twists on the format, there’s always a new challenge waiting at the tables.
Collectibles and progression
Complete the WSOP Album, collect cards and Legend Chips, and finish sets to unlock valuable rewards. Progress through the game as you build your collection and strengthen your profile.
Daily quests and rewards
Join Agent Mary on your journey to poker glory. Complete daily quests, gain sponsors, and move through reward-filled progression as you work toward becoming a true poker star. Activate the Season Pass to unlock even more rewards and prizes.
Mini-games and bonus features
Enjoy extra ways to play with Lightning Show, Video Poker, Chip Case Bonus, Daily Blitz, and more mini-games packed with prizes and surprises.
FAQ:
Q: Can I play poker for free?
A: Yes. WSOP offers a wide variety of free poker experiences, including Texas Holdem games, tournaments, and additional game modes for you to enjoy.
Q: Can I play poker online?
A: Yes. You can play WSOP online in the app or website (https://playwsop.com) and compete with players from around the world anytime you want to jump into a poker game.
Q: Is poker hard to learn?
A: No. Poker is easy to start playing once you know the basics, and Texas Holdem is one of the most accessible and popular ways to begin.
Q: Where can I get free chips?
A: You can collect free chips when you start playing, through daily bonuses in the game, and from additional rewards and promotions.
Connect with us on Facebook - http://bit.ly/WSOP_Fanpage
Join the WSOP community - https://bit.ly/3JKpbQV
WSOP is intended for those 21 and older for amusement purposes only and does not offer real money gambling or an opportunity to win real money or real prizes based on gameplay. Playing or success in this game does not imply future success at real money gambling.
WSOP does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. WSOP may also contain advertising. An internet connection may be required to play WSOP and access its social features. More information about functionality, compatibility, and interoperability appears above and in the additional App Store information.
By downloading this game, you agree to future game updates as released on your app store or social network. You may choose to update this game, but if you do not update, your game experience and functionalities may be reduced.
Terms of Service: https://www.playtika.com/terms-service/
Privacy Notice: https://www.playtika.com/privacy-notice/

bluejetty:00185957:ios.description:
“Allo Sidney, tu aimes les films et les séries ?” 
AlloCiné est le guide incontournable du cinéma et du streaming. Trouvez facilement toutes les informations sur les films et les séries : les séances autour de vous, dans vos cinémas ou sur vos plateformes préférés, les notes et critiques de la presse, des spectateurs et des vos amis, les bandes-annonces… et au-delà ! 
Pourquoi utiliser AlloCiné :
Découvrir : la base la plus complète de films et séries avec un moteur de recherche unique. Sorties de la semaine, bandes-annonces, synopsis, photos, casting, anecdotes…
Choisir : avec les notes et critiques de la presse et des spectateurs, les filtres thématiques, les sélections éditoriales ou par plateforme de streaming
Sortir au cinéma : les séances de toutes les salles de France et l’accès à la réservation de vos billets
Regarder en streaming : Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Canal+, offres VOD... naviguer dans les catalogues des plateformes, et découvrir facilement sur quelle(s) plateforme(s) un film ou une série est disponible
S’informer sur l’actualité du cinéma et des séries, avec les articles et les contenus vidéo de la rédaction
Nouveau, grâce au compte Mon AlloCiné vous pouvez :
Personnaliser : vos salles de cinéma favorites et vos plateformes de streaming préférées pour un accès plus direct à vos séances et vos contenus
Noter et critiquer les films et séries, et contribuer à la Note Spectateurs AlloCiné
Obtenir des scores prédictifs d’affinité : sur tous les films et séries, en fonction de vos notes déjà déposées sur AlloCiné
Suivre vos amis sur AlloCiné : découvrez leurs notes, leurs critiques, leur watchlist…
Partager vos notes, votre profil et vos collections sur les réseaux sociaux
Lister : votre watchlist (envies de voir), vos collections de films et séries, votre historique de visionnage
Tracker : votre progression dans les séries, épisode par épisode, pour un meilleur suivi
Pourquoi souscrire à AlloCiné premium ?
Sur AlloCiné, la publicité est, pour l'instant, notre source principale de revenus et nous permet de maintenir un service gratuit.
L’abonnement AlloCiné Premium vous permet de désactiver les publicités au sein de l’application, de modifier vos préférences vidéo et également de choisir l’icône de l’application AlloCiné sur votre écran d’accueil !
Il existe 2 offres premium avec le 1er mois offert :
- Abonnement mensuel pour 0,99€ par mois, renouvelable automatiquement.
- Abonnement annuel pour 9,99€, permettant l'accès pour un an, non renouvelable.
Le paiement sera effectué depuis vos comptes iTunes à la confirmation de l'achat. L'abonnement est renouvelable automatiquement à moins qu'il ne soit désactivé au moins 24h avant la fin de la période courante. Aucun désabonnement de la période courante n'est autorisé pendant la durée active de l'abonnement.
L’abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés en se rendant directement sur les pages dédiées aux comptes des utilisateurs dans l’App Store, après l’achat
Politique de confidentialité : http://www.allocine.fr/service/charte.html
Conditions d'utilisation : http://www.allocine.fr/service/conditions.html

bluejetty:00178261:ios.name: Kingdom War: Tower Defense TD
bluejetty:00178261:ios.summary: Are you a fan of RPG and Real-time defense strategy games? If so, Warring Kingdoms TD is the game that you are always finding. Warring Kingdoms TD is a 2D cartoon tower defense game, which combines with role playing game features to bring t
bluejetty:00178261:ios.description:
Are you a fan of RPG and Real-time defense strategy games? If so, Warring Kingdoms TD is the game that you are always finding. Warring Kingdoms TD is a 2D cartoon tower defense game, which combines with role playing game features to bring to you interesting challenges defense strategy.
The game is set in a fantasy continent which is named Fortias. There are many races living together in this continent including humans, elves, dwarves, orc, troll, goblin, etc. After the Great battle between the alliance of humans, elves and the Dark Lord hundreds of years ago, the continent's creatures are enjoying a peaceful life. The Dark Lord is destroyed under the sword of the human's King, and his army is eliminated. However, evil never really disappears. They are very patient and waiting for the day that darkness will cover this continent once again. 
One day, the Eradel kingdom is suddenly attacked by the Goblin army, which used to be far away from man's land. In the critical situation, Prince Lucius and his companion had to leave the kingdom of Eradel and seek help from other allied races. On his journey, he will have to overcome countless challenges as well as different enemies and need talented tacticians to help. Let’s build powerful towers, train royal soldiers of Eradel, control mighty heroes and destroy the enemies!
GAME FEATURES
* Enter the world of Warring Kingdoms TD: Hero Legend TD defense strategy, enjoy many challenges in different fantasy environments: the plain of human, dense forests of elves, the mountain kingdom of dwarves, the dead swamp, frozen mountain, and many more!
* Show off your talent! Perform your best tactic in each mission with 8 new specialized towers: Barrack tower trains brave warriors of Eradel to help you block the path and destroy the enemies; archer tower deals physical damage and bring useful buffs to nearby towers; magic tower have high magic damage and ability to debuff the enemies; and last but not least, golem tower, the mighty weapon of Eradel Kingdom, which can slam the ground and deal massive AoE damage.
* Various modes of gameplay: beside the campaign missions, players also can enjoy the infinite challenges in endless mode. Let’s show the world who is the best tactician by ranking yourself top one in the leaderboard. The endless mode is also a very good one to farm gems.
* Call 5 epic ancient Gods to help you in the combat: Jupiter, Glacia, Sol, Nyx and Asura. 
* Mighty heroes: many valor heroes from different races with powerful skills. You can control 3 heroes at a time to stop enemies and bring back peace for Eradel. 
* Summon and upgrade runes to increase power for your hero. 
* Variety of monsters in game: more than 30 types of enemies are waiting for you. Each monster has a unique appearance and some events have abilities that may cause a lot of trouble to every tactician.
Learn about your enemies and your towers with an in-game encyclopedia.
Heads up and rush into protecting your castle and kingdom from the evil enemies. We're waiting for you in the world of Warring Kingdoms TD!
Warring Kingdoms TD Community
We'd love to hear your valuable feedback on our game! Join our community channel to participate in open discussions and connect with other players.
- Official Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/warringkingdomstd
- Official Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/440243454452237

bluejetty:00153997:ios.name: Voice Memos
bluejetty:00153997:ios.summary: Voice Memos turns your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a portable audio recorder, making it easy to capture and share personal notes, song ideas, family moments, classroom lectures, and more. Editing tools like trim, replace, and the new
bluejetty:00153997:ios.description:
Voice Memos turns your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a portable audio recorder, making it easy to capture and share personal notes, song ideas, family moments, classroom lectures, and more. Editing tools like trim, replace, and the new “Save As” feature let you fine-tune your recordings without altering the original. The transcription feature converts speech into text, simplifying the process of finding and referencing specific content. And the new feature to record a vocal layer on top of an existing instrumental recording* without the need for headphones making it easy to capture song ideas on the go. Users can then separate and edit the vocal and instrumental layers independently to continue expanding on those ideas. And with iCloud support, you can capture audio on the go with your iOS device, then use your Mac to do even more with your recordings.
Features
Record
• Record using the built-in microphone, a Bluetooth headset, or a compatible external microphone.
• Choose uncompressed audio for maximum sound fidelity, ensuring the highest quality recordings.
• Opt for compressed audio to save storage space and record longer sessions.
• Automatically name recordings based on your location.
• Record a vocal layer* over an instrumental track without headphones.
• Stereo recording adds greater depth and dimension to your audio**.
• iCloud support keeps your recordings and edits in sync across all your devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and Vision Pro.
Edit
• Pinch-to-zoom for more precision when editing.
• Trim your recordings to save just the portion you want.
• Replace and resume to fine-tune your recordings.
• Save As lets you make edits and save them as a new recording without altering the original file.
• Separate and independently edit the vocal and instrumental takes for layered recordings*.
• Transcripts automatically convert speech into text for easy reference***.
• Enhance Recording reduces background noise and room reverberation with a single tap.
Organize
• Quickly find recordings with the search feature.
• Folders make it easy to organize your recordings.
• Mark recordings as Favorites so you can quickly access them later.
Listen and share
• Speed up or slow down playback of your recordings, or jump 15 seconds forward or back.
• Skip Silence analyzes your recordings and automatically skips over gaps in your audio.
• Share multiple recordings at once via AirDrop, Mail, Messages, and more.
• Import vocal layer* recordings into Logic Pro as a two-track project for advanced editing and production.
* Adding a vocal layer on top of a Voice Memos recording is available only on the iPhone 16 Pro models.
** Stereo recording requires Apple devices equipped with stereo microphones and iOS 18 or later.
*** Audio transcription is available on iPhone 12 and later in English (Australia), English (Canada), English (Ireland), English (New Zealand), English (South Africa), English (UK), and English (US).

bluejetty:00146109:ios.description:
TV Remote – The Ultimate Smart TV Controller in Your Pocket
Say goodbye to juggling multiple remotes and take full control of your entertainment experience with TV Remote. This powerful app transforms your smartphone into a fully functional remote control for your smart TVs, streaming devices, and more. Whether you're changing channels, adjusting the volume, or launching your favorite apps like Netflix or YouTube, everything you need is just a tap away.
TV Remote is designed to offer fast, reliable, and intuitive control without the hassle of batteries or complicated setups. With a clean interface that mirrors the traditional remote experience, plus extra smart features, it’s everything you need—right in your pocket.
** Complete Control of Your Entertainment Setup **
- Works seamlessly with smart TVs and other connected devices
- Connects instantly when your phone and TV are on the same Wi-Fi network
- Eliminates the need for physical remotes and batteries
- Compatible with a wide range of brands and streaming platforms
- Navigate inputs, switch channels, adjust sound, and more
- Supports control for soundbars, cable boxes, and game consoles
** Smart Features Made for Convenience **
- Realistic button layout for a familiar and easy-to-use interface
- Quick access to popular apps like Netflix, Hulu, YouTube, and more
- Launch, pause, skip, and rewind content with simple on-screen controls
- Manage all your devices in one app for a clutter-free setup
** Share and Display Media on the Big Screen **
- Cast your photos and videos directly to your TV screen
- View content in high resolution for a better viewing experience
- Great for showing vacation pictures, home videos, or personal projects
** Screen Mirroring Made Simple **
- Mirror your phone screen to your TV for presentations, browsing, or multitasking
- Enjoy greater control with a larger display
- Ideal for sharing content or navigating apps together
No More Remotes. Just One App.
TV Remote is your reliable, all-in-one remote control alternative. Say goodbye to searching under cushions and buying new batteries. Whether you're watching movies, gaming, or streaming music, this app keeps you in full control from anywhere in the room.
Subscription and Payment Information
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account after confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/tvremoteios/privacy
Terms of Use: https://zipoapps.com/tvremoteios/terms

bluejetty:00037332:ios.description:
Browse, edit, and share your picture-perfect moments. Photos is the home for all of your amazing photos and videos, and it's smart and personal, with intelligent features that help you find, enjoy, and share your best shots.*
Browse your library
• The Library tab displays your photos and videos in an interactive, zoomable grid, with options to view by Months and Years 
• Quickly filter down to specific content types, like photos that have been edited, or choose to remove screenshots from the view
Browse by Collections 
• The Collections tab organizes your library by topics, like Recent Days, People & Pets, Trips, Memories, your custom albums, Wallpaper Suggestions, and more
• Media Types organizes your photos by type like Selfies, Videos, Portraits, and Screenshots
• Utilities gathers photos by useful topics like Duplicates, Documents, Receipts, and Handwriting
• Pinned Collections lets you put your most frequently accessed content right at your fingertips
Customize the Photos app just for you
• Reorder Collections sections and choose a size to enjoy just the way you like them
• Choose to add items to Pinned Collections to keep your most-used items close at hand
Find just what you're looking for with powerful Search
• On-device machine learning analyzes your photos so you can search for people, places, dates, events, and even objects and scenes like basketball, birthday cake, or beach
Organize your photos into albums
• Create albums of your favorite topics
Relive your memories 
• Spatial scenes let you view your photos with a delightful 3D effect
• Memories uses on-device intelligence to find trips, holidays, people, pets, and more in your collection, and presents them as movies paced to music, or create your the memory you want to see using Apple Intelligence
Perfect your photos in Edit
• Fine‑tune your photos and videos with powerful tools like auto enhance, highlights, shadows, vibrance, and definition, and apply edits to another image or to a batch
• Remove distractions with a tap using Clean Up
• Slow down high frame rate videos for slow motion effects
Share with friends and family
• Share to Messages, Mail, and third party apps
• Share photos seamlessly with up to five other family members with iCloud Shared Photo Library
• Use Shared Albums to share photos and videos with just the people you choose
• iCloud Links let you send a set of photos and videos that can be viewed on any platform, in any browser
Keep your library safe and up to date with iCloud Photos
• Store your photos and videos safely in iCloud and access them from any device, any time, including iPhone, iPad, and Mac, Apple Vision Pro, on iCloud.com, or even on a PC
Keep your photos private
• Photos protects your privacy by using on-device intelligence to analyze your photos and videos
• Face recognition, scene detection, object detection and more are all done completely on your device
• The Hidden and Recently Deleted albums are locked by default
Use the Photos app on Apple Watch to access your favorite photos right on your wrist
Relive your favorite moments with highlights from Memories
Create a Photos or Portrait watch face
*Not all features are available on all iPhone or iPad models. Refer to your device’s user guide for information on feature support.

bluejetty:00139578:ios.description:
Kpop Pro is a revolutionary Kpop lyrics training app designed for global Kpop fans. Explore 5000+ K-pop songs featured with Hangul & Romanized lyrics, perfect your Korean pronunciation, and sing along with your favorite Kpop artists like never before.
===========
“Can I find my Kpop idols’ songs?”
Absolutely! We've got you covered with a collection of 5000+ K-pop songs and music videos, and the best part? We're updating daily! You'll discover all your favorite K-pop stars right here!
“I’m struggling with Korean words in Kpop songs”
No worries! We provide every song with Hangul, Romanized, and even translated lyrics. It's not just about singing; you can practice the lyrics while learning some basic Korean along the way!
“I want improve my Korean pronunciation”
You're in the right place! Our bilingual Kpop trainers, paired with AI recognition technology, will boost your confidence in pronunciation. Our trainers break down the lyrics and demonstrate how to pronounce every word, while our AI listening technology offers instant feedback to help you refine your pronunciation.
===========
Here’s a list of things that make Kpop Pro different:
Music & Lyrics Player
Kpop Pro offers Kpop songs with music videos, complete with Korean and Romanized lyrics for engaging practice and memorization. Scroll through lyrics, tap sections to listen, slow down or speed up music, rewind lyrics and customize the character type to your liking!
Kpop Lessons by Bilingual Idol Trainers
Unlock 60+ Kpop singing lessons led by expert K-pop tutors, facilitating precise pronunciation. Explore songs from top idol groups here. Tutor videos feature embedded Romanized music lyrics subtitles for seamless singing and learning.
Voice Recognition Technology
Elevate your pronunciation through fun and interactive exercises. Listen to the tutor's voice, repeat the lyrics, and let our advanced voice recognition technology evaluate your performance. Improve your pronunciation anytime, anywhere, and enjoy the journey!
Record & Make Karaoke Lyrics Video 
Sing along to your favorite songs, and record your voice cover video whenever you're ready to shine. Share with friends and brace yourself for your viral Karaoke lyrics video on social media!
===========
Can't find a specific song? Reach out to us at contact@kpoppro.app, and we'll prioritize your favorites!
[Copyright Notice]
Kpop Pro has formally established a licensing agreement with the Korea Music Copyright Association as of April 2023, ensuring compliance with legal procedures through quarterly log submissions and royalty payments. The lyrics player in the Kpop Pro app utilizes YouTube's official API to embed links, guaranteeing that views are properly counted towards the original content creators, and confirming that no MP3 files are stored, duplicated, or transmitted on our servers. For any copyright inquiries, please feel free to email us at contact@kpoppro.app

bluejetty:00065877:ios.description:
Start your career as a bus driver, learning everything that gets into doing the job effectively and dependably. Enter a demanding training arena simulated, try out a selection of varied vehicles and show your skills driving them! Now updated with 2 new cars and 10 new missions!
FEATURES:
▶ DEMANDING OBSTACLE ARENA: Featuring a bus station and varied environment around it
▶ VARIED SELECTION OF VEHICLES: 12 Buses of different shapes and sizes to drive (2 brand new!)
▶ CHALLENGING MISSIONS: 60 trials to complete with precision and on time (10 new!)
▶ FUN & REALISTIC DRIVING MODEL: Learn to drive & have fun in the process!
▶ FREE ROAMING MODE: Explore the area at your own pace
In the game you will have to show your ability to navigate through tricky obstacle courses and show your creativity. You have to show your ready to transport your passenger safely and effectively when the time to start your job comes!
It’s important for you to get to the destination on time, but speed is not the only thing you should be concerned about here. Drive fast but remember to also be safe. Try not to make a mistake that will lead to a fatal crash! Show your skills and talent as a pro bus driver!
You will get to drive a large selection of buses – long ones, short ones, small ones, large ones, articulated ones... To spice things up the game also introduces one limo that is as challenging and demanding to drive as any bus. All of the available vehicles are modelled in high quality for increased immersion.
The challenges presented by the game aren’t easy or straightforward, but with enough practice you will be able to pass them with flying colours! Remember not to treat is as a race, though speed is definitely important too!
Are you up to the challenge?

Keep up with the latest and biggest boxing
bluejetty:00157638:ios.description:
Not only will you have access to the best top-level boxing schedule straight from your home screen, but we’ll also keep you updated with customised notifications so you can follow boxing your way.
Keep up with the latest and biggest boxing stories from the most respected news sources, curated to the fighter and contests you’re most looking forward to.
Enter, store and share your scorecards, predictions and boxing opinions in our community, and then catch up with the action from our fight library.
Most of all, we always ensure you stay close to the big boxing action.
Box.Live - Unify It All!
--- Features ---
Schedule: Stunning visual boxing schedule of all the biggest fights happening in the coming months.
TV & Start Times: Get estimated ringwalk times in your local time zone and TV and streaming options in the US & UK.
Boxing Results: Get all the results updated live as they happen.
Alerts & Notifications: Follow boxing your way and get custom notifications by following boxers and fights to get news, announcements, and reminders straight to your phone. Never miss the big breaking news or fight again!
News: We curate a news feed from the leading boxing outlets in the world to keep you on the sport’s pulse. Every fighter profile and contest has its own boxing news feed.
Boxer Profiles: We have profile pages for over 750 fighters where you can view their stats, rankings, news, next fights, opponent rumours, recent results, replay videos, and ticket details.
Fight Details: We track all the big contests, providing head-to-head stats comparisons, start time estimates, TV & streaming listings, undercard details, curated news feeds and ticket details.
Scorecards: Enter, save and share your boxing scorecards instantly with friends and on social media. The best-looking scoring app available.
Champions & Rankings: We track all the world champions and provide comprehensive stats about their reigns and mandatories, plus all the top 15 ranking details of all the big organisations in all the weights.
Predictions: Leave your predictions and see how the overall community sees the big fights panning out. Generate images to share your predictions with your friends and other fans.
Full Fight Video Library: We’ve curated and organised a library of over 1000 massive full fights for you to watch on YouTube. Catch up on the big action, watch your favourite fighter or enjoy a classic barn burner from our recommendation system.
Tickets: We list all the ticket details for all the big boxing events from the US and UK.
Box.Live - Unify It All!
-------
Help & Support: https://box.live/help/
App Privacy Policy: https://box.live/mobile-app-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00040641:ios.description:
A feature-rich QR and barcode scanner: scan, generate, and share codes — fast and privately.
Scan codes with text, links, contacts, emails, locations, Wi‑Fi networks, product barcodes, and more.
When you scan a code, the app acts on it intelligently: links open in the browser, email addresses let you compose a message quickly, and vCards can be viewed or added to Contacts.
You can read codes with the camera or generate them in the app — plus use action extensions to scan or create codes from other apps.¹
Spotted a QR code in a photo or on a website? Use the Read Code extension to scan it instantly.¹
Main features
• Scan with the camera — text, links, contacts, emails, product barcodes, Wi‑Fi, and more
• Read QR codes and 1‑D barcodes from images with the Read Code extension¹
• Product barcodes can open relevant web pages or Amazon (configurable in Settings)
• Generate QR codes and 1‑D barcodes
• Create codes from text, links, contacts, email, SMS, phone numbers, and Wi‑Fi
• Join Wi‑Fi networks automatically from a scanned code
• Scan and save multiple codes in one session
• Generate a code from text, a link, or a contact with the Generate QR extension¹
• Smooth up to 60fps scanner preview with optical image stabilization and zoom (including optical 2× zoom on iPhones with dual cameras)
• Optionally copy scanned content to the clipboard automatically
• Option to prefer HTTPS and avoid insecure websites
• Recents for scanned and generated codes, with search and filters
• Custom QR colors — two‑finger tap on the image or use the menu when viewing a code
• Share any barcode
• Custom URL scheme to generate QR codes from a URL or text²
• Widgets for recent codes and quick access to the scanner
Code Reader Pro
Upgrade to Code Reader Pro for advanced tools — no ads, and your data stays on your device. Choose monthly, yearly, or a one‑time lifetime unlock.
Pro includes:
• Batch scan — read many codes from photos or PDFs at once
• Export & import history — back up or move your scan library (CSV/JSON)
• Custom names — label scans so you can find them quickly
• Starred scans — pin important codes and filter your history
• Notes — add context to any saved scan
• QR codes with logo — embed your brand in generated codes
• High‑res & PDF export — share sharp QR images and PDFs
• Link safety warnings — alerts for suspicious links (IP addresses, punycode, mixed scripts, and more) before you open them
Restore purchases anytime from the Pro screen.
¹ The extension might need to be enabled manually: open the share menu, tap More at the bottom, and turn on the app extensions (Activities).
² Try it in a browser or messaging app: add generateqr:// before a URL or text to open the app and generate a QR code image.

- Privacy Policy:
