bluejetty:00145404:ios.description:
Estudos Bíblicos para Mulheres é um aplicativo que permite você navegar através de toda a sabedoria da Palavra de Deus em uma linguagem simples e claro com só uns poucos cliques.
Estudo bíblico das mulheres é uma ferramenta que irá ajudá-lo a expandir o seu conhecimento sobre o nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo. 
Centos de recursos e Temas Biblicos para a mulher. Tematicas especiais para descobrir as mulheres da Biblia e ser uma mulher conforme ao coração de Deus
Estudos Bíblicos para Mulheres mais completos. Acerque à Palavra de Deus e sua sabedoria e dedica um momento especial a sentir você abençoada com estes estudos.
Ajudará você a ampliar sua sabedoria sobre nosso Senhor Jesucristo. Descobre as mulheres da Biblia e um amplo surtido de prega , devocionales , Estudos Biblicos , mensagens e temas para mulheres cristãs.
Estes Estudos Bíblicos para Mulheres serão uma bênção e uma ajuda em suas vidas.
Acerque à Palavra de Deus e sua sabedoria e dedica um momento especial a sentir você abençoada com estes estudos e prega.

- FORÇA PARA VENCER OS GIGANTES

- SABEDORIA
- Kairós e Khronos
- Amai-vos uns aos Outros como eu Vos Amei
- “Deuses” no meio Cristão”

Além disso, o aplicativo inclui um melhor estudo e compreensão da Bíblia

Faça o download agora Estudos Bíblicos para Mulheres.

bluejetty:00043418:ios.description:
Dive into the world of Sorting Cube Jam, the ultimate cube sort puzzle featuring patterned cubes and dynamic conveyor belt sorting. In this addictive sorting colors game, your mission is to sort, match, and guide patterned cubes along moving conveyor belts into the correct trays. Experience the thrill of true cube matching and sorting jam gameplay as cubes flow nonstop, creating a fresh and satisfying cube sorting challenge. This cube sort puzzle is designed for players who love sorting games, featuring a unique patterned cube mechanic and a smart conveyor-based strategy.
How to play:
- Patterned Cube Sorting: Match and organize patterned cubes by color and pattern in this addictive cube sort puzzle.
- Conveyor Belt Mechanics: Control the flow of cubes on moving belts, adding timing and strategy to this fun sorting colors game.
- Tray-Based Cube Matching: Guide cubes from the conveyor into the right trays for smooth cube matching and sorting jam action.
What You'll love:
- Dynamic Sorting Jam Levels: Conveyor belts keep puzzles moving, turning every level into an engaging sorting jam and sort puzzle.
- Relaxing Visual Flow: Watch cubes slide and match in a calming color sort and matching game experience.
- Play anytime, anywhere.
Whether you’re a fan of cube sort puzzle games or love relaxing sorting colors game experiences like the color cube breaker game and the colorwood sort puzzle game, Sorting Cube Jam delivers a smooth and satisfying adventure. Match patterned cubes, control conveyor belts, and enjoy a colorful cube sorting and matching game made for puzzle lovers.
Ready to relax and sort with style? Start your sorting jam journey with Sorting Cube Jam today!

uh?! I'm a legendary knight?!

bluejetty:00157999:ios.summary: One account for your money worldwide, with your own US account details. Get paid in USD, hold digital dollars, spend with a Visa card, and cash out to your local bank when you choose. Built for people who earn, move, and spend across border
bluejetty:00157999:ios.description:
One account for your money worldwide, with your own US account details. Get paid in USD, hold digital dollars, spend with a Visa card, and cash out to your local bank when you choose. Built for people who earn, move, and spend across borders. Apply with your local government-issued ID.
Earning in USD from outside the US usually means slow wires, fees at every step, and forced conversion at a poor rate, while your local currency loses value month after month. GrabrFi puts everything in one account instead of three apps.
GET PAID IN USD
A US routing and account number in your name. Receive ACH payments from US companies and platforms like Deel, Remote, Toptal, Upwork, and Fiverr, with no incoming ACH fee, no middlemen, and no complicated setup.
HOLD DIGITAL DOLLARS
Keep your balance in digital dollars inside the same account, no extra app needed. Send to people, platforms, and your own accounts, and receive 24/7. Earn Boost rewards on your balance where available (see the in-app rate and terms).
PAY BY QR IN LATIN AMERICA
In Argentina, Brazil, and Peru, scan and pay for everyday purchases directly from the app. Your dollars are converted at a competitive exchange rate, with the total shown before you confirm. No cash, no card reader needed.
SPEND WHERE VISA IS ACCEPTED
Once approved, open a virtual card in the app and pay online or in person anywhere Visa is accepted, at home and when you travel. No fee to open the card, no maintenance fee. A physical card is available, delivered to your home for a shipping fee.
SEND AND WITHDRAW YOUR WAY
Wire to US or international accounts, ACH to US accounts, or send digital dollars 24/7. Cash out to pesos, reais, or your local currency, directly to your bank account. You see the rate and the total before you send.
BUILT FOR YOUR SITUATION
Freelancers: get paid in USD and keep more of every payment.
Remote workers: receive your salary from platforms like Deel or Remote.
Savers: hold your savings in dollars, in US jurisdiction.
Travelers and everyday spenders: pay by card or QR, cash out when you choose.
WHY GRABRFI
- 250,000+ customers worldwide
- Operated by Grabr, Inc., a US company in business since 2014
- Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors
- Thousands of 5-star reviews on Trustpilot
- Human support in English, Spanish, and Portuguese
No fee to open the account, no monthly fees. Availability varies by country. See grabrfi.com for supported countries and full terms.
One global account for your local life.
GrabrFi is a product of Grabr, Inc. Grabr, Inc. is a financial technology company, not a bank.
Services are provided by Bridge Ventures LLC or one of its regulated affiliates (together, "Bridge"). The assets in your global account are not FDIC insured, are not bank deposits, and are subject to issuer and de-pegging risks that might affect its value. Its value is backed 1:1 by cash and short duration US Treasuries through Bridge or Circle.
The Prepaid Debit Visa Card (the "Card") is issued by Lead Bank pursuant to licensing by Visa U.S.A., Inc. and may be used everywhere Visa is accepted. Must be 18 or older to apply. Fees may apply. See Cardholder Agreement and GrabrFi website for more details.
Bridge is not a bank. Bridge is a financial technology company and is the Program Manager responsible for managing and operating the Card on behalf of Lead Bank. Grabr, Inc. is the Platform Provider responsible for the application, access, and management of/for the services and card.
Boost earnings are a promotional incentive funded by GrabrFi, not interest, yield or investment returns. The rate used in content reflects the current rate at the time it was sent or published. Refer to the in-app rate for the current rate, it is subject to change. It is available to all GrabrFi customers excluding the U.S. and E.U.

bluejetty:00129199:ios.name: SocialFocus: Hide Distractions
bluejetty:00129199:ios.summary:
Hide distractions on websites such as YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn, Gmail and take back control of your attention!
While we acknowledge the distracting and engrossing nature of these sites, completely blocking th
bluejetty:00129199:ios.description:
Hide distractions on websites such as YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, LinkedIn, Gmail and take back control of your attention!
While we acknowledge the distracting and engrossing nature of these sites, completely blocking them is not always feasible due to the valuable content they offer.
This Safari extension allows you to selectively hide attention-grabbing components on each site. For instance, on YouTube, you have the option to conceal recommended videos, shorts, comments, and more. Similarly, on Facebook and Instagram, you can hide the feed, reels, stories, and other elements. The same goes for each supported site.
Furthermore, SocialFocus offers an array of supplementary features, including Startup Settings, Import / Export and more.
Users who want to support the development of the project can additionally subscribe to the PRO version. The PRO version will give access to some additional features that are not available in the standard version, such as hotkey configuration, settings synchronization and some others. 
NOTE: This extension does NOT work with the apps, it works only for websites while using the Safari browser.

bluejetty:00140856:ios.description:
Termius is a modern SSH client designed for productivity and collaboration. Connect with one tap from desktop and mobile. No re-entering IP addresses, ports, and passwords.
With a free Termius Starter plan, you can:
· Connect from your mobile and desktop devices with SSH, SFTP, Mosh, Telnet, Port Forwarding, Serial and through Proxy and jump servers. 
· Get a desktop-grade terminal experience with a virtual keyboard covering all the special keys required, or connect your Bluetooth keyboard.
· Use gestures or shake the device while in the terminal to emulate stroking of Tab, arrows, PgUp/Down, Home, and End, etc.
· Work in several sessions simultaneously with a multi-tab interface and split-view support.
· Customize your terminal themes and fonts for each connection. 
· Set custom environment variables. 
· Save your frequently used commands and shell scripts to execute them with one tap.
· Execute your saved commands on multiple sessions or servers at once, or instantly get them autocompleted in the terminal.
· Get smart autocomplete for commands, paths, and history, and turn plain-language descriptions into shell commands with AI.
· Quickly access the global history of your terminal commands.
· Authenticate using hardware FIDO2 keys.
· Generate SSH keys in the Secure Enclave, confirm each connection with Face ID or Touch ID, and protect your account with two-factor authentication.
· Ad-free.
With the Termius Pro plan, you can also:
· Access your connection settings and credentials from any device at any time with an encrypted cloud vault.
· Sync your data across all your desktop and mobile devices.
· Bookmark session logs with notes to your vault.
· Integrate with AWS, DigitalOcean, and Azure.
Termius reinvents the command-line experience. We strive to make remote access for admins and engineers more productive and enjoyable.
Please review our privacy policy https://termius.com/privacy_policy.html and terms of use https://termius.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00138548:ios.summary: Kalshi is the largest legal and federally regulated prediction market app in the U.S., where you can make money by predicting real-world events, including soccer, baseball, golf, and other sports. Trade real outcomes in a federally regulate
bluejetty:00138548:ios.description:
Kalshi is the largest legal and federally regulated prediction market app in the U.S., where you can make money by predicting real-world events, including soccer, baseball, golf, and other sports. Trade real outcomes in a federally regulated prediction market. Perfect for sports trading, event trading, forecasting, futures-style markets, and real-world predictions.
It’s like trading stocks — but instead, you trade on events you understand. Predict whether an event will happen or not, and earn money if you’re right.
Join 10M+ users trading thousands of prediction markets across finance, weather, culture, sports, and more. 
FINANCIAL MARKETS
Daily S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, WTI oil
ECONOMIC MARKETS
Fed interest rates, Inflation (CPI), GDP, Recession, Gas prices, Mortgage rates
CLIMATE MARKETS
Hurricane strength, Daily city temperatures, Tornado numbers
CULTURE MARKETS
Billboard 100, Oscars, Grammys, Emmys, #1 Hits
HOW KALSHI WORKS
Kalshi is the largest federally regulated prediction exchange where you buy and sell contracts based on event outcomes. Example: NASA announces a manned mission to the moon. Contract prices reflect trader probability estimates. If you think the event will happen, you buy contracts. Contracts cost between 1¢ and 99¢ and can be sold anytime. At market close, each correct contract is worth $1.
TRADE SPORTS
Kalshi lets you trade on real sports outcomes across football, baseball, basketball, golf, MMA, tennis, and more.
Trade pro and college sports with highly liquid prediction markets. 
HOW IS KALSHI REGULATED?
Kalshi is federally regulated as a Designated Contract Market (DCM) by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). Kalshi’s affiliate, Kalshi Klear LLC, is a CFTC-regulated clearinghouse that holds member funds and clears trades.
TRADE YOUR CONVICTIONS
Find prediction markets that match your views. If you think a recession is coming, trade recession and S&P markets. Put your money behind your forecasts.
REDUCE FINANCIAL RISK
Hedge against events that could impact your finances. If you hold stocks, trade Fed and inflation markets to help protect your portfolio.
KALSHI VS. STOCKS
Event contracts are direct. You trade the outcome of an event, not the future stock price of a company. Profits are not tied to company performance. No pattern day trading restrictions. Trade as much or as little as you want, anytime. In stock trading, you can be right and still lose money due to market sentiment or news. Prediction markets remove that layer.
KALSHI VS. OPTIONS
Event contracts are simpler. Options pricing depends on multiple complex factors. Kalshi contracts reflect straightforward event probabilities. No time decay. If the event odds stay the same, contract value stays stable.
HOW MUCH MONEY DO I NEED TO START?
Open and maintain a Kalshi account for free. Prediction markets require less capital than traditional trading, making it easier to diversify without risking large amounts.
ADVANCED TOOLS & API ACCESS
Build trading algorithms in Python with starter code and a dedicated package. Start in minutes with documentation. Access open-source tools from the Kalshi developer community.
18+ only. Restrictions and eligibility requirements apply. Trading event contracts and trading leveraged products, including perpetual futures, involves significant risk and is not appropriate for everyone. Please carefully consider if it is appropriate for you in light of your personal financial circumstances. Kalshi products are not available in all jurisdictions. See kalshi.com/regulatory for more information.
Additional perpetual contract offerings are subject to applicable regulatory review and approval, and availability may vary.
Leverage amplifies both potential gains and potential losses, and losses can exceed the amount deposited. Leverage limits are determined by KalshiEX LLC or the FCM based on its own risk assessment and each customer's individual risk profile, and are subject to change.

The new major update "Roaring Waves! Prismatic Maelstrom!" is here!
Angelina rides the tide back into action, and LLR hero Tidal Vindicator makes her debut! The Fatebrand Ascension system is now live, boosting R-rank hero Laird's rarity to SSR! The Forbidden Battleground Secret Realm returns for a limited time, with upgraded daily mission rewards. A brand-new adventure is about to begin! 
The Japanese SRPG masterpiece Langrisser has finally arrived on mobile! Experience exhilarating turn-based battles, class-based tactical combat, unique upgrade paths for each hero, real-time PvP, world-class artwork, an all-star voiceover cast, and an unforgettable musical score, as you explore a vast fantasy world! Heed the Langrisser’s call and save the continent of El Sallia from the forces of darkness!
Embark on a Magical Quest for the Legendary Sword!
Classic Turn-based Strategic Battles!
Upgrade Classes and Choose Your Destiny!
Stunning Anime Art Style!
Revolutionary Real-time Tactical Combat!
Guild Battles Are Here! A New Challenge Awaits!
Voiced by an All-Star Cast of Japanese Voiceover Legends!
Original Score by Composer Noriyuki Iwadare!
Revisit Over 300 Classic Levels!
Collect Your Favorite Heroes from the Langrisser Series!
Description of subscription and announcement of Apple official subscription feature about “Langrisser”
1. Subscription price and period
You can subscribe “the forgiveness clock” in the game, price is $0.99 and period is 30 days.
2 Subscription contents
Users can get a privileged experience during the subscription period, the contents contain: ① Go back to any previous step in combat (It can be used only three times per combat, cannot be used for group or PVP combat); ② The energy consume of defeating in battle is reduced by 50%.
3 Auto-renewing subscription
Apple App Store official subscription is auto-renewing subscription, confirmed payment by iTunes Account directly. Users need to manually turn off auto-renewing subscription in iTunes/Apple ID setting management. Auto-renewing subscription will be withheld within 24 hours of the end of each subscription cycle, confirmed payment by iTunes Account directly. If you need to unsubscribe, you need to turn off auto-renewing subscription at least 24 hours before the end of each subscription cycle. If auto-renewing subscription not be canceled before this time, the subscription cycle will be extended automatically.
4 Terms of Service
Terms of Service:http://langrisser.zlongame.com/agreement.html
5 Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy:http://langrisser.zlongame.com/privacy.html
6 Unsubscribe
If you want to unsubscribe, go to “Settings”--> select “iTunes Store and App Store”--> click “Apple ID”, then select “View Apple ID”, choose “Account setting”, point “subscribe”--> " manage”, find “Langrisser”, then unsubscribe it.
• When confirming your purchase, the corresponding fees will be charged to your iTunes account.
• Renewal fees will be charged to your account within 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period, at which time you will be asked to confirm your renewal fees.

bluejetty:00082810:ios.description:
Welcome to Pulsify, your personal heart health companion. With Pulsify, monitoring your heart's health becomes a seamless and integral part of your daily life. Our app is designed to empower you with easy-to-use tools for keeping track of your heart rate and blood pressure, anytime, anywhere.
Key Features of Pulsify:
Instant Heart Rate Monitoring: Simply use your fingertip and your phone's camera to measure your heart rate. It's quick, accurate, and user-friendly.
Blood Pressure Logging: Effortlessly log your blood pressure readings and keep a history to track trends over time.
Stress Management: Learn to manage your stress levels effectively with our tailored suggestions, helping you maintain a balanced emotional state.
Habit Tracker: Develop and maintain heart-healthy habits with our intuitive Habit Tracker.
Apple Health Integration: Sync your data with Apple Health for a centralized view of your overall wellbeing.
Using Pulsify is Easy:
- Ensure your fingers are warm for an accurate reading.
- Place your fingertip over the camera lens and flashlight.
- Apply gentle pressure for precise results.
The app requires iOS 17.0 or later. You can choose a free trial with all features available.
UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all the app has to offer.
- Subscriptions are billed automatically at a rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
Medical Disclaimer:
While Pulsify offers valuable health insights and information, it is important to remember that it is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read on this app.
Pulsify is designed to support, not replace, the relationship that exists between a patient and their healthcare provider. The insights and information provided in this app are for general informational purposes only.

Join the Pulsify Community:
Embrace a healthier, more informed lifestyle. With Pulsify, you're not just monitoring your heart; you're taking a step towards lifelong wellness.
Pulsify: Your Heart, Your Health, Your Way.

bluejetty:00084107:ios.description:
Turn your smartphone into a universal intelligent tool. AI Scanner instantly identifies any object from a photo - no more manual searching or endless scrolling.
What can you scan?
| Coins & Collectibles |
Determine the value of coins, collectible cards, valuable toys, and antiques. Find out the origin, condition, and estimated market value of your finds.
| Bug Bite Identifier |
Not sure what bit you? Take a photo of the bite, and our AI will analyze it to identify the likely insect.
! Disclaimer: Results are not medical advice. Always consult a professional healthcare provider.
| Art & Vinyl |
Scan football cards, paintings, or records. Get the item’s detailed history and its current appraisal value for collectors.
| Nature: Birds & Animals |
Bird Song: Record a chirp, and our AI will identify the bird species.
Animals: Identify dog breeds, cats, and wildlife with full characteristic profiles.
| Insects, Reptiles & Snakes |
Explore the world safely. Learn about spiders, snakes, or caterpillars. AI Scanner answers "What snake is this?" and provides essential safety data.
| Universal Recognition |
Car brands, gemstones, gadgets—AI Scanner recognizes it all. Get electronics specs and brand histories instantly.
Features You’ll Love:
- Next-Gen Speed: Powered by the latest AI for maximum accuracy.
- Personal History: Save and organize your favorite finds.
- Real-time Detection: Scan directly through your camera live.
- Deep Database: Detailed insights for every object identified.

• Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited upon subscription.

Privacy & Access:
The app requires camera and gallery access solely for object analysis. We do not store or share your photos with third parties.

bluejetty:00015838:ios.description:
This app includes all new civics questions and all state questions.
During the naturalization interview, applicants will be asked up to 20 questions from the list of 128 questions depending which version you choose. In order to become a US citizen you will need to answer at least 60% of the questions correctly.
The questions cover knowledge of the American Government (Principles of American Democracy, Systems of Government, Rights and Responsibilities), American History (Colonial Period and Independence, 1800s, Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information) and about Integrated Civics (Symbols, Holidays).
This high-quality app helps you to prepare for the actual UCSIS Civics test with a study mode and an exam mode with fast cards and quiz. The questions are based on USCIS latest prep document and are presented in random order.
The statistics page shows how many games you played and how you've done so far. All this makes learning for your US naturalization test fun and challenging!
FEATURES
- All current questions used by the US Government
- Audio support: Push the play buttons and listen to questions and answers
- Study mode with statistics and learning mode
- Flash cards for better learning
- Two exam modes (flash cards or quiz)
- Question of the day to keep learning
- Sound on/off option
- Timer on/off option
- Showing/hiding of correct answers
- Statistic analysis with bar graphs

bluejetty:00063594:ios.description:
***Best Mobile Game 2015 DICE Nominee***
The most addicting tower defense game returns in an all-new prequel adventure - welcome to Kingdom Rush: Origins! 
Praise for the Kingdom Rush series: the #1 Strategy Game franchise for the iPhone, iPod touch, and iPad, Apple’s Editor’s Choice Award, IGN Editor's Choice, Slide To Play Must Have, GameInformer Gold Award, 148 Apps Editor's Choice, Jay is Games Game of the Year, Pocket Gamer Gold Award,CNET Best iPad Games, CNET Editor’s Choice Award, Gamezebo 4.5/5, Touch Arcade 4.5/5, Venturebeat94/100.
What critics are saying about Kingdom Rush: Origins:
"The Kingdom Rush franchise is one of the best tower defense series around, and the third entry, Origins, is as fun as the franchise has ever been.” –Entertainment Weekly
“I’ve played plenty of tower defense games over the years, but none have ever captured my heart the way the Kingdom Rush series has.” –The Verge
“Kingdom Rush Origins HD is more of the same, for the most part, and that’s an excellent thing." –148 Apps 
“Great looks, super fun game play, enjoyable music and fun Easter Eggs. Anyone who loves tower defense games ought to have this on their device." –TUAW
“Everything you might expect from a new game in the wonderfully addictive tower defense series: new towers, new heroes, fantastic gameplay." –Kotaku 
"If you’re a fan of tower defense, you’re well acquainted with Kingdom Rush and its sequel, Kingdom Rush Frontiers. This third entry in the series is available now, and yes, it’s the best to date." –Gamezebo 
Kingdom Rush: Origins is the third installment of the award-winning Kingdom Rush saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers and critics around the globe. Take a trip back to the beginning, before Vez’nan ever thought to threaten the kingdom with the gem of power, and experience even more of the lightning-fast, exceptionally captivating gameplay that made the franchise a cornerstone of essential tower defense games. In this exciting prequel, command your elven army and defend mystical lands from sea serpents, evil sorcerers, and wave after wave of gnoll tribesman, all with the help of brand-spankin’ new towers, heroes, and spells to fend off every last baddie. 
Kingdom Rush: Origins packs in a treasure trove of new content and features while keeping the signature look that millions have come to love. 
GAME FEATURES
 • Re-enter the world of Kingdom Rush: visit mysterious elven forests, magical faery realms and even floating ruins of an ancient metropolis!
 • Unleash the power of the elves with brand new towers and troops! Elf Archers, Mystic Mages, Stone Druids and the Elven Infantry make up the backbone of your army.
 • Discover eight new specialized tower upgrades with over 18 abilities! Vanquish your enemies with elven marksmen, runed bears, magic-wielding wizards, and even giant animated trees.
 • Take up arms against 30 new enemy types and engage in epic boss battles! Face hordes of Gnolls, giant spiders, and the terrible Twilight army.
 • Master and upgrade 16 legendary heroes and their awesome powers and spells!
 • Rain lightning, summon reinforcements, and use each hero’s unique power to obliterate scores of enemies!
 • Immerse yourself in hours of gameplay with over 70 achievements, with three difficulty modes for the newbs and veterans alike. 
 • Play different game modes - Classic, Iron, and Heroic - and prove your mettle as a master tactician.
 • Purchase new-and-improved equipment using your hard earned gems in a revamped Gnome shop.
 • Study your enemies and your towers with an in-game encyclopedia
-
Indonesia Rating (IGRS): 13+
This game has been officially rated by the Indonesia Games Rating System (IGRS).

LingChat: Talk Your Way to Fluency—With AI or Real People!

bluejetty:00141741:ios.description:
LingChat: Talk Your Way to Fluency—With AI or Real People!
You’ve been learning a language for a while, but when it comes to speaking, you freeze up. Sound familiar? LingChat is here to break that barrier! The secret to fluency is simple: speaking, speaking, and more speaking—because practice makes perfect.
Now, you can practice anytime, anywhere—with smart AI characters or real language partners from around the world!
* Speak Freely with AI & Real People
LingChat gives you a safe, fun, and effective way to practice over 60 languages. Chat with quirky, friendly AI who never judge—or join our growing language exchange community to connect with fellow learners and native speakers.
It’s real conversation, made easy.
* Smart AI Characters That Keep It Fun
LingChat’s AI isn’t just smart—it’s your personal speaking coach. Get instant feedback, grammar tips, and confidence-building practice. Want to practice a business meeting, a date, or a debate with a robot? You got it.
The AI adapts to you—so your learning feels natural and real.
* Connect with Real People, Just Like You
Whether you’re a beginner or fluent speaker, sometimes you just want to talk to a real person. Now you can join global chat rooms, find speaking partners, or join group discussions to sharpen your skills through authentic human interaction.
* Smart Tools That Make Conversations Easier
LingChat is more than just chatting—it’s smart learning on the go:
• Tap to Translate – Instantly understand your partner’s messages, or translate your own into their language.
• Native-Like Replies – Polish your sentences to sound natural and fluent with our one-tap message optimizer.
• Real-Time Grammar Help – Get instant corrections and suggestions to improve your writing as you go.
• Instant Word Lookup – Tap any word in the chat to see its meaning and save it to your vocabulary list.
• Smart Reply Hints – Stuck on what to say? LingChat suggests natural responses to keep the conversation flowing.
• Cross-Language Messaging – Type in your native language and let LingChat translate it for your partner—or vice versa.
These powerful tools help you communicate clearly, learn faster, and stay confident—whether you’re chatting with AI or a new friend.
* Perfect for Everyone
• Language Learners – Build confidence by actually speaking
• Students – Prep for TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL with real-time chat
• Professionals – Practice real-world business scenarios
• Travelers – Learn essential phrases for real-life adventures
• Shy Speakers – Speak without fear—AI or human, it’s safe here!
* Languages Supported
English, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, Portuguese, French, Italian, Russian, Hindi, Bengali, Turkish, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch, Thai, Indonesian, Greek, Swedish, Hungarian, Vietnamese, Finnish, Danish, Bulgarian, Norwegian, Slovak, Croatian, Lithuanian, Slovenian, Irish, Kazakh, Serbian, Azerbaijani, Swahili, Amharic, Uzbek, Albanian, Filipino, Malay, Armenian, Khmer, Romanian, Bosnian, Czech, Georgian, Lao, Icelandic, Mongolian, Nepali, Estonian, etc.
Join LingChat today and start speaking your way to fluency—with your AI BFF or a real conversation partner. Fluency starts with a chat!
Terms of Services for Lingchat: https://www.lingchat.pro/terms.html
Privacy Policy for Lingchat: https://www.lingchat.pro/privacy.html

bluejetty:00146077:ios.description:
**Pass the VTNE Without Needing Nine Lives**
You’ve survived animal restraint labs, memorized more drug names than a pharmacist, and learned how to keep a cat calm while it screams into the void. Now all that stands between you and your vet tech credential is the VTNE. EZ Prep is here to help you pass it without turning into a stressed-out rescue case.
EZ Prep’s VTNE Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least overwhelming way to prepare for the Veterinary Technician National Exam. Whether you’re reviewing after your shift, offline at work, or studying in the bath next to a dog that won't stop staring at you, this app goes wherever you go and adapts to your progress as you learn.
Built around the latest 2024 VTNE test plan and written by certified vet techs, EZ Prep covers all nine exam categories and adjusts to your strengths and weaknesses. You’ll know what you’ve mastered and what still needs work, without wasting time reviewing topics you already know better than your supervising DVM.
**Here’s what the app covers:**
• Pharmacy and Pharmacology
• Surgical Nursing
• Dentistry
• Laboratory Procedures
• Animal Care and Nursing
• Diagnostic Imaging
• Anesthesia
• Critical Care
• Pain Management and Analgesia
All questions are designed to mirror the VTNE format with adaptive difficulty, so you’re always challenged at the right level.

bluejetty:00184000:ios.description:
Goalsetter is a mobile banking, debit card that focuses on educating the next generation with fun financial quizzes based on pop culture, putting them on the path to financial freedom. Whether you're a teen wanting financial independence, a parent wanting to start saving with their kids, or an adult who wants to jump-start their financial literacy, we have features for every need.
Goalsetter is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided by Webster Bank, N.A., Member FDIC and Cashola Prepaid Debit Mastercard® is issued by Pathward, N.A. fka MetaBank, N.A., Member FDIC.
Goalsetter - Debit Card & Banking For All
With Goalsetter, everyone can take control of their finances, learning money management skills to work their personal finances. With a debit card for everyone, you can learn to earn, spend smartly and save. Parents can send money to their kids' and teens' debit cards, control when it's active, and have complete insight into their transaction's history. Together, families can establish smart spending and saving habits. 
Financial Literacy via Memes & Games
Our financial literacy quizzes are made for all family members of all ages - for adults, teens, kids, and tweens. All quizzes are mapped to national financial literacy standards, so every individual learns healthy money habits, financial language, and math skills through pop culture memes and gifs.
Chores & Allowance
Since we know that every family does allowance differently, we've set up Allowance Rules that let you give allowance according to your family's philosophy. You set up the amounts to pay each kid and link your bank account, and we'll make the weekly allowance transfers to your kids' Goalsetter accounts. No more IOUs required!
Savings & Goal Tracker
Kids and parents can set up goals within the app to save and track progress for long-term goals, whether a rainy day or a vacation fund. Families can contribute to these goals, and they also serve as a continued reminder for kids to be setting aside money for the future. Once the goal is met, the funds can be cashed out and used. Don't worry though; we know that plans change and life happens. You can cash out from a goal at any time.
Safety & Security
Goalsetter uses 128-bit encryption, and we do not store any of your personal information and do not move money without your authorization.
Steps for App Data Deletion: Please contact us at Hello@goalsetter.co for data deletion requests. Please note that financial transaction related data is maintained based on Federal and State guidelines.
Awards
*Winner of an FDIC Award 2021*
*Winner of JP Morgan Chase Financial Solutions Lab 2018*
*Winner of Morgan Stanley Innovations Lab 2018*
*Winner of FinTech Innovation Lab 2019*

bluejetty:00136504:ios.description:
Start learning Persian (Farsi) with words and phrases you can read, listen to and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you explore the language.
CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, including the alphabet, greetings, numbers, food, family, home, work, travel, transport, nature and more.
Prefer a focused route? Choose from five mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency. Each brings related lessons together around a useful topic.
LISTEN AND REVIEW
Choose between the Yasmin and Arash voice options for bundled recordings. Adjust playback speed and replay words or phrases as you study. Lesson text and bundled recordings can be used offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support messages require an internet connection.
PRACTICE WHAT YOU LEARN
Review with flashcards, answer multiple-choice and true-or-false questions, match words with their meanings, and type answers in writing exercises. Revisit words that need more practice and check your exercise results.
MAKE STUDYING PERSONAL
Save favorite words and phrases for quick review. Follow your learning progress, record daily check-ins and set study reminders with notification permission. Choose a theme and learning appearance that suits you.
KEEP A COPY OF YOUR PROGRESS
Use manual Backup & Restore to export your favorites, progress, exercise history and included preferences to a file. Import a compatible backup when you need it. Purchases and notification permissions are not transferred in the backup.
HELP IMPROVE THE CONTENT
Use the flag beside a word to prepare a report about its audio, translation or example. You can also open Feedback & Support in Settings or contact support@dugloapps.app.
ACCESS
Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires a one-time purchase or subscription. See the in-app purchase screen for available plans and terms.
Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-persian/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-persian/terms/

bluejetty:00160939:ios.name: Daily Planner & Goals: Griply
bluejetty:00160939:ios.summary:
Plan your day, build better habits, and make steady progress on the goals that matter to you, all in one app.
Griply connects your daily tasks and habits to your bigger goals and the why behind them, so today's plan ties back to where you
bluejetty:00160939:ios.description:
Plan your day, build better habits, and make steady progress on the goals that matter to you, all in one app.
Griply connects your daily tasks and habits to your bigger goals and the why behind them, so today's plan ties back to where you actually want to go. That golden thread, from a long-term vision down to today's tasks, is what pure to-do apps and habit trackers leave out. It also works as a clean, flexible daily planner on its own. Tasks can stand alone and don't have to link to a goal, so if you came here from another task manager and want something that also helps you grow, you'll feel at home from day one.
People run Griply for methodologies like the 12 Week Year, Getting Things Done (GTD), yearly goal-setting, and ADHD-friendly daily planning.
GOALS & SUBGOALS
Set a measurable goal with a start value, a target, and a deadline, then watch your progress fill in as a chart climbs toward the finish line. Break a big goal into smaller subgoals, then break those down into the daily habits and tasks that move them forward. That golden thread, from goal to subgoals to the things you actually do day to day, is what turns a year-long ambition into a clear set of next steps you can start today.
HABITS
Build routines that stick. Track your completion rate and perfect weeks by week, month, or year, and keep your momentum going on the habits you care about most. Schedule them however you like, from every weekday to a set number of times per week.
DAILY PLANNING
The Today screen brings your tasks and habits into one view, and carries overdue items forward for you so nothing slips. Set reminders on any task or habit, get a daily overview each morning, and a weekly nudge to plan the week ahead.
CALENDAR
Plan your day on a real calendar with 1 to 5 day views. Press and hold to draw a time block and see whether the plan actually fits before it starts, then drag things around until it does. Connect your Google Calendar and Outlook to see those events right alongside your tasks and habits, so your whole day lives in one place.
WIDGETS
Put your day on your Home Screen. Add widgets for your Today list, your habits, and your goals, and check off habits straight from the widget without opening the app.
SMART LISTS & FILTERS
Filter, sort, and group tasks to focus on what matters today. Save the views you use most as smart lists and reopen them in one tap. Add tags to organize across goals, projects, and contexts, and search across everything in seconds.
LIFE AREAS
Group your goals, habits, and tasks under areas like work, health, and finance, each with its own goals and a vision of what good looks like, so you can keep your whole life in balance instead of just your work.
PREMIUM
Unlock an Insights dashboard that tracks your goals and habits over time, a goal Roadmap that lays your timeline out at a glance, custom life areas beyond the built-in set, and unlimited smart lists.
Use it your way. Run the full goal system from your long-term vision down to today's tasks, or keep it simple with a clean daily planner you actually enjoy opening.
Griply is named App of the Day in 200+ countries, with a 4.7-star average across 620+ ratings worldwide, and a daily home for people who want to set goals and actually reach them.
Sync your goals, habits, and plan across iPhone, desktop, and web, so today's plan is always with you. Download Griply and plan your first day in minutes.

bluejetty:00062876:ios.description:
Toya Kids – Educational Games for Toddlers
Welcome to Toya Kids, a playful world where toddlers learn through exploration. Children travel across colorful islands, each filled with engaging activities designed to build essential early skills in a fun and natural way. Every activity is simple, intuitive, and tailored for young learners. With no reading required and easy tap-and-play controls, children can explore independently while developing confidence and curiosity.
Explore Learning Islands
Each island focuses on a different developmental skill:
Matching – recognize and pair objects to build visual memory
Sorting – group items by size, shape, and color
Shapes – discover basic geometric forms
Hide & Seek – improve attention and memory through playful challenges
Logical Thinking – solve simple puzzles and patterns
Numbers – learn to count, recognize number names, and trace numbers step by step
Counting – practice counting through interactive gameplay
Colors – identify and explore colors in a fun environment
Coloring – enjoy guided and free coloring activities
Designed for Toddlers
- Friendly, colorful visuals
- Simple and intuitive interface
- No reading required
- Safe, child-friendly environment
- Encourages independent play
Why Parents Choose Toya Kids
Toya Kids combines learning and play in a balanced way. Children develop early cognitive skills, improve coordination, and build confidence while enjoying a variety of fun activities.
Whether your child is matching shapes, counting objects, or creating colorful drawings, Toya Kids offers a rich and engaging experience that grows with them.
Start your child’s learning journey today with Toya Kids.
About the team
Toya Tap is a small independent team built by parents of young children who know firsthand what it means to look for good, meaningful screen time. With years of experience in the educational apps industry, we set out to create the kind of apps we wanted for our own kids.
We work closely with professional childcare experts and talented artists to shape every detail, from how a child interacts with a game to how it feels visually and emotionally. Everything we build is designed to be simple, safe, and genuinely enjoyable for children, while giving parents peace of mind that playtime is also learning time.
At the heart of Toya Tap is a very personal mission: to create thoughtful, high-quality games that families can enjoy together and that truly support a child’s early development.

Matching – recognize and pair objects to build visual memory
Sorting – group items by size, shape, and color
Shapes – discover basic geometric forms
Hide & Seek – improve attention and memory through playful challenges
Logical Thinking – solve simple puzzles and patterns
Numbers – learn to count, recognize number names, and trace numbers step by step
Counting – practice counting through interactive gameplay
Colors – identify and explore colors in a fun environment
Coloring – enjoy guided and free coloring activities

Designed for Toddlers
- Friendly, colorful visuals
- Simple and intuitive interface
- No reading required
- Safe, child-friendly environment
- Encourages independent play

Why Parents Choose Toya Kids
Toya Kids combines learning and play in a balanced way. Children develop early cognitive skills, improve coordination, and build confidence while enjoying a variety of fun activities.
Whether your child is matching shapes, counting objects, or creating colorful drawings, Toya Kids offers a rich and engaging experience that grows with them.
Start your child’s learning journey today with Toya Kids.

About the team
Toya Tap is a small independent team built by parents of young children who know firsthand what it means to look for good, meaningful screen time. With years of experience in the educational apps industry, we set out to create the kind of apps we wanted for our own kids.
We work closely with professional childcare experts and talented artists to shape every detail, from how a child interacts with a game to how it feels visually and emotionally. Everything we build is designed to be simple, safe, and genuinely enjoyable for children, while giving parents peace of mind that playtime is also learning time.
At the heart of Toya Tap is a very personal mission: to create thoughtful, high-quality games that families can enjoy together and that truly support a child’s early development.

ניתן לאסוף כסף קבוצתי באמצעות קבוצות תשלום משותפות שלא מוגבלות בזמן, בהן אפשר לראות מי כבר שילם ומי עדיין לא, ואפילו אפשר לשלוח למי שלא שילם תזכורת. והכל בצורה מאובטחת ושקופה. 
בנוסף, אפשר לפתוח Boxים ולשלם מהם ומהיתרה האישית בחנויות, באופן מאובטח ונוח ללקוחות בעלי כרטיס אשראי PayBox - כרטיס דיגיטלי ללא דמי כרטיס.
Box אישי

הכסף ב-Box נשאר נזיל וזמין ובכל זמן אפשר להשתמש בו.
Box משותף
מחזיקי כרטיס אשראי PayBox יכולים לפתוח ולהיות חלק מ-Box משותף שמאפשר לנהל כסף יחד עם עוד משתתפים למטרה משותפת
במקום לרוץ לבנק לפתוח חשבון משותף, להתנהל באקסל מסובך או להתחשבן בווטסאפ, ב-PayBox פותחים בכמה רגעים Box משותף ומנהלים תקציב בקלות.
הכסף ב-Box המשותף נזיל וזמין לכל המשתתפים וכולם יכולים לשלם ממנו בחנויות ובאונליין. 
כרטיס אשראי PayBox. דיגיטלי. בחינם. ללא דמי כרטיס. לכל החיים!
כרטיס PayBox הוא כרטיס דיגיטלי בלבד, בחינם ללא דמי כרטיס, המאפשר לשלם עם הכסף שב-PayBox שלכם בחנויות ובאונליין.
מחזיקי כרטיס PayBox יכולים לקבל ריבית על היתרה באפליקציה - טוענים או מקבלים כסף ממשתמשים אחרים ונהנים מהריבית על הכסף שנצבר.
איסוף כספים בקבוצות
מנהלים את הקופה של ועד הכיתה או ועד הבית? אוספים כסף למתנה או לאירוע? עם PayBox אתם יכולים לקבל תשלומים מכולם בלי להתרוצץ, להפריד את הכסף הקבוצתי מהחשבון הפרטי, ולעקוב בקלות אחרי מי שילם ומי לא…
הלוואה ליתרה
הלוואה חוץ בנקאית שלא מתערבבת בחשבון הבנק. לוקחים הלוואה והכסף נכנס ישירות לאפליקציה
*השימוש ב-PayBox בטוח ועומד בתקן אבטחה מחמיר 1 PCI DSS LEVEL.
*בכפוף לתנאי השימוש ולספי הפעילות באפליקציה. ריבית על היתרה תשולם למחזיקי כרטיס PayBox זכאים, אך אינה מותנית בשימוש בכרטיס; יתרה מירבית לחישוב הריבית: 20,000₪; התנאים באתר; ההצטרפות אינה אוטומטית; הנפקת הכרטיס בכפוף לאישור כאל, בתנאיה ובאחריותה; אי עמידה בפרעון ההלוואה עלול לגרור חיוב בריבית פיגורים והליכי הוצאה לפועל. המלווה: כ.א.ל (מימון) בע"מ.

bluejetty:00014089:ios.summary: FieldClock, is the solution for managing crews on your farm. The intuitive UI means your employees can get started in seconds without needing a user manual. Easy and accurate data collection is automatically uploaded to our secure cloud s
bluejetty:00014089:ios.description:
FieldClock, is the solution for managing crews on your farm. The intuitive UI means your employees can get started in seconds without needing a user manual. Easy and accurate data collection is automatically uploaded to our secure cloud so you can manage your workforce in real time.
BUILT FOR FARMERS
FieldClock is purpose-built for the unique needs of farmers. Rugged environments and complicated business needs produce a challenging set of requirements that are hard to understand unless you've been a farmer. FieldClock was founded by farmers and draws on their unique ability to produce software that's customizable, reliable, secure, and affordable.
EASY ACCURATE DATA
FieldClock enables your employees to track accurate time, breaks, piecework, and more with ease. Clock-in or -out, tally piecework, or take notes with no more effort than snapping a photo. It's that simple! FieldClock makes it so easy to track activity in real-time that you'll be able to throw out those old notepads you've been carrying around.
EASY PAYROLL
FieldClock's powerful Ag Pay Engine takes the pain out of complicated rules surrounding agricultural pay. Straight time is a cinch, as is piecework, AEWR, trainings, travel time, overtime, night shift premiums, break and meal premiums, and anything else you can throw at it. The pay is automatically calculated according to your rules, and easily exported to your payroll system. 
FLEXIBLE CONFIGURATION
Configure FieldClock to meet the unique needs of your operation. No two farms are alike and you should use software that is flexible enough to match your workflow.
RELIABLE AND SECURE
FieldClock continues to work, even when you have no internet connection. When internet is available, FieldClock automatically uploads data to our secure cloud platform. Our cloud platform is constantly monitored and regularly audited by third-party security professionals. Check out the FieldClock Trust Center for more information.
AFFORDABLE
Pick the FieldClock plan that meets your financial needs. Farming is a low margin business and FieldClock's plans are specifically designed to be accessible to all farmers.
FARM BUREAU MEMBER BENEFIT
Special pricing is available for active Farm Bureau members in participating states. Ask your local Farm Bureau rep if FieldClock is a member benefit available to you.

bluejetty:00152329:ios.description:
Solitaire Revelry: Welcome to the grand solitaire carnival!
Game Overview
Welcome to Solitaire Revelry! This is a fresh take on the classic solitaire game, blending card strategy with a joyful carnival atmosphere. Step into a lively amusement park filled with fireworks, balloons, and laughter as you flip your way to good fortune. Join a lucky pig and an adorable puppy on your journey to win real cash rewards. Here, every move shines with excitement, and every victory feels truly rewarding.
Core Gameplay
At its heart, Solitaire Revelry features the timeless Solitaire gameplay you know and love. Swipe, flip, and stack cards in perfect order as you combine skill and focus to clear the board. Each move brings satisfaction, and clever strategy leads to bigger wins. Whether you’re unwinding for a moment or diving into longer sessions, Solitaire Revelry delivers both relaxation and the thrill of real rewards.
Art Style
Solitaire Revelry is designed with a vibrant celebration theme full of life and color. Brilliant fireworks light up the night sky, hot air balloons drift above the park, and roller coasters race through the festive landscape. A cheerful pig and a playful puppy add charm and warmth to the adventure. With bright colors and smooth animations, every round feels like a magical celebration of joy.
Game Value
In Solitaire Revelry, you’ll find more than just entertainment — you’ll discover achievement, excitement, and real cash rewards. Its easy-to-play style makes it perfect anytime, anywhere, while its rhythm keeps you engaged and relaxed. There are no complex rules, just the perfect mix of luck, skill, and satisfaction. Every victory sparkles with value, bringing happiness and rewards together in one unforgettable experience.

Your child has endless questions. Now they have a safe AI friend who loves answering them - like Siri or Alexa, but designed specifically for kids.
Askie lets kids chat naturally using just their voice - no typing, no spelling required. They can ask about dinosaurs, create magical artwork, get help with homework, or explore bedtime stories. Every response is age-appropriate, educational, and designed to spark curiosity.
Powered by Gemini from Google for natural conversations and advanced AI for instant image creation - all wrapped in multiple safety layers.

Kids simply talk, and Askie listens. Conversations feel natural - like chatting with a patient friend who never tires of questions.
Perfect for:
- Car rides and travel - hands-free learning
- Bedtime curiosity - stories and gentle Q&A

- The endless "but why?" moments

Askie adapts responses based on age. A 4-year-old asking about space gets wonder and simple words. A 12-year-old gets deeper science. Same curiosity, appropriate depth.

bluejetty:00069813:ios.summary:
EquateAccess is the secure authentication app for EquatePlus and EquateMobile. It does not provide access to your account, holdings or transactions. To view or manage your account, use EquateMobile or the EquatePlus website. 
Designed to
bluejetty:00069813:ios.description:
EquateAccess is the secure authentication app for EquatePlus and EquateMobile. It does not provide access to your account, holdings or transactions. To view or manage your account, use EquateMobile or the EquatePlus website. 
Designed to help protect your account, EquateAccess provides a fast and secure way to verify your identity using multi-factor authentication (MFA). Whether you're signing in, recovering access to your account or approving sensitive actions, EquateAccess adds an extra layer of protection while keeping the experience simple and convenient. EquateAccess is the preferred authentication method across the Equate platform and works seamlessly with both the EquatePlus website and the EquateMobile app. 
Key features 
• Secure authentication using Face ID, Touch ID, biometrics or a PIN
• Fast approval of verification requests
• Works with both the EquatePlus website and EquateMobile
• Supports multiple participant accounts
• Built on modern authentication standards for enhanced security
• Designed to help protect against unauthorised account access
How it works 
After registering EquateAccess to your EquatePlus account, you'll use the app to verify your identity when authentication is required. 
EquatePlus website 
When accessing the EquatePlus website, simply scan the QR code displayed on screen and approve the request using the device you have registered EquateAccess to. 
EquateMobile 
When using EquateMobile on the same device, the authentication process is even more seamless, allowing EquateMobile and EquateAccess to work together for a smooth verification experience.

bluejetty:00063848:ios.description:
Create amazing 3D Photos and make your content unique and popular. 
Parallax is a brand new way of making your photos and videos look incredible. We bring conventional photos to the next level with 3D Photos! Simply imagine any place where you can make a usual photo… With 3D Photo, you will make it twice cool! This is because you add more life to your moments. It’s just awesome!
Create 3D photos from regular photos
・ Choose any photo from your camera roll and turn it into 3D with just one click
・ All devices are supported, no matter what type of camera you have
・ Change the direction of the 3D photo (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally)
・ Blur out the background to give the effect of depth
・ Play with 3D Photo by increasing or decreasing the amplitude of motion
Capture with 3D Camera
・3D Camera has 4 capture modes for you: Short, Classic, Smooth, and Manual
・Capture your stunning 3D Photo using one of them
・Experiment with manual mode: shot from bottom to top or diagonally
・You can easily adjust the number of shots, getting a short or long 3D effect
・Adjust speed, grain amount, and more 
・Apply trendy filters and effects to make your artwork look really great 
・Share in high resolution to any platforms
Edit Photo
・Along with 3D Photo, you can use the same cool filters and effects to edit usual photos 
・Blur out the background for any photo
・You can apply light leaks to your photos, adjust grain and more 
Terms of Use - https://www.zedit.info/Service_Terms.html
Privacy Policy - https://www.zedit.info/PrivacyPolicy.html
We always welcome your ideas and feedback.

bluejetty:00145530:ios.description:
Traccar Manager is the official mobile app for managing and monitoring your GPS tracking devices with Traccar, the open-source GPS tracking platform.
• Live Tracking: View the real-time location of all your devices on an interactive map.
• Device Management: Add, edit, or remove devices directly from your mobile device.
• Event Notifications: Receive alerts for geofence crossings, device status changes, and more.
• History and Reports: Review past routes and generate trip history for any device.
• Secure and Private: All your data stays on your own server, no third-party access.
Connect the app to your Traccar server, log in with your credentials, and instantly manage and monitor your fleet or personal devices from anywhere.
Don't have a server yet? Try the free live demo or set up your own for free at traccar.org.

bluejetty:00068190:ios.description:
****Para usar o aplicativo é preciso contratar o PontoWEB da Ahgora com o Multi****
O Multi traz uma inovação tecnológica para facilitar ainda mais a gestão de presença dos colaboradores na sua empresa.
O reconhecimento facial é um dos processos de identificação mais rápidos. O algoritmo encontra um conjunto de métricas no rosto de cada pessoa permitindo a comparação com o banco de dados do sistema.
Com o Multi os colaboradores da sua empresa podem registrar ponto em um Tablet ou Smartphone, substituindo o relógio de ponto tradicional.
Se o Multi já foi contratado pela sua empresa, siga os passos abaixo para começar a usar:
1) Baixe o APP
2) Na tela inicial informe a chave de ativação gerada no PontoWEB.
3) Siga os passos indicados no próprio aplicativo
Para utilização do aplicativo é preciso dar as seguintes permissões para os cenários específicos:
 *Permissão de câmera: Utilizado para batida de ponto por reconhecimento facial
 *Permissão de Biometria: Utilizado para batida de ponto por biometria
 *Permissão para Localização: Para enviar a geo localização na batida
Estamos trabalhando constantemente para melhorar o Multi. As suas considerações e sugestões são valiosas, fale conosco através do contato suporte@ahgora.com.br

bluejetty:00074072:ios.name: Equipd Bible
bluejetty:00074072:ios.summary:
Welcome to the Equipd Bible - a powerful Bible reading and personal study app. 
What makes the Equipd Bible different from other Bible apps? It has been carefully optimised for daily workflows, from using in the ministry, to daily bible re
bluejetty:00074072:ios.description:
Welcome to the Equipd Bible - a powerful Bible reading and personal study app. 
What makes the Equipd Bible different from other Bible apps? It has been carefully optimised for daily workflows, from using in the ministry, to daily bible reading and collating your favourite scriptures and study notes. Use it one-handed on your iPhone or in split-screen mode on your iPad. Look up selected verses with the fastest copy scripture tool ever. Personalise this Bible app and make it your own.
* Load compatible Bibles in EPUB format from the Equipd website or other approved sources. Check www.equipd.me/bibles for more information.
* View different Bibles side-by-side for easy comparison. Or read just one Bible full-screen.
* Load multiple languages side-by-side for sharing in the ministry with those from different cultures. Great for language learners.
* Bible Reading Schedules with reminder notifications. You can setup one or multiple schedules at a time. Never get behind on daily Bible reading again.
* For Chinese users or learners ... automated Pinyin, Zhuyin (Bopomofo), Sidney Lau, or Yale romanization can be generated and shown in 2-line format above the Simplified or Traditional characters. 
* For Japanese users or learners ... automated Furigana or Romaji in 2-line format. 
* Jump from viewing just the selected verses to the Chapter window to get the full context.
* Multiple ways to look up scriptures. Use the 3 scrollers at the top, or the Bible Picker accessed from the toolbar. Use the double-tap or "shake" gestures to show the Picker - great for one-handed use on the iPhone. 
* Add study notes against verses. View notes for the current chapter in a side-panel (iPad and iPhone Plus). Access all notes from the toolbar.
* Import MP3 files for offline audio. In Safari locate a MP3 ZIP file and "Open in..." the Equipd Bible.
* The easiest "Copy" scripture feature you have ever seen. Great for copying scriptures into note-taking apps.
* Bookmarks organised by topic or category. You can even put a comment against a bookmarked scripture to highlight a main point or line of reasoning.
* History of scripture lookups.
* Backup and Restore of verse notes and bookmarked scriptures, with backup reminders.
* Clipboard Lookups - just copy a scripture from another document or app, and then open Equipd ... Equipd will try and look it up for you!
* A powerful URL scheme so that you can create links to open scriptures in the Equipd Bible from external apps or documents. The Equipd Bible implements the x-callback-url scheme for developers to integrate with.
* Streamlined workflow and screen rotation for all devices from the iPhone 4S to the larger iPhone 6 Plus, and of course it works great on the iPad. iOS 7 or above is required.
* Split Screen support for iPad mini 4, iPad Air 2, iPad Pro.
---
Please view the website and forums on www.equipd.me for more details and support. All official support is in English, but community users may offer support in other languages.
I sincerely hope the Equipd Bible app can help you to be "completely equipped for every good work"! — 2 Timothy 3:17.
---

Forums: www.equipd.me/forums
FaceBook: facebook.com/equipd.me
Twitter: twitter.com/equipd
---
If you enjoy Equipd Bible, you might also enjoy...
*** ServicePlanner ***
A new Field Service and Ministry App with automated Dropbox Sync, full Call and Return Visit Management, Reporting, Time Scheduling and much more.
www.serviceplanner.me

AskEasy* is your personal AI assistant, who helps with daily tasks, making your life easier, more fun, and efficient. 
It swiftly finds answers to any query, writes texts, generates images, assists with daily tasks, and can even recommend a book to read or a movie to watch! Simply input your request, and watch as accurate responses magically appear on your screen.
Key Features:
【AI IMAGE GENERATOR】
Transform words into stunning visuals. Enter a description, and let AI generate captivating images tailored to your vision.
【YOUR AI WRITING ASSISTANT】
From essays and ad copies to witty tweets and poems, smart AI writer generates polished content in seconds. If you're a student, professional, or content creator, this free AI writing tool ensures your texts are clear, creative, and engaging.
【UPLOAD AND ASK】
Save time searching! Upload PDFs to AskEasy*, and get precise answers and valuable insights fast and without manual searches.
【TITLE FOR PHOTO】
Effortlessly create creative captions, hashtags, and engaging stories for your photos. Perfect for social media posts!
Explore More AI Super Powers:
Language Assistance: Translate or simplify learning new languages.
Ask by Link: Paste a webpage or video URL to get the details you need without extra browsing.
Text Scanner: Snap a picture, and AI Chatbot analyzes text for quick insights.
Summary of Texts: Simplify complex articles or documents into easy-to-read pieces.
Quote Maker: Generate impactful and creative quotes in seconds.
Help with Daily Tasks: From grocery lists to travel plans, AskEasy* keeps life on track effortlessly.
Friendly ChatBot: More than just answers—it’s a witty, engaging companion to chat with anytime.

AskEasy is free to download. A subscription is required to use the service. 

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal depends on your subscription plan. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in the user’s Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
Privacy Policy: https://mychat-ai.cloud/pp
Terms of Use: https://mychat-ai.cloud/tou
Support Contact: support@mychat-ai.cloud
*AskEasy app is not affiliated, endorsed, or sponsored by OpenAI.

bluejetty:00134467:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00134467:ios.description:
What's your Fitness Age? Compare your Apple Watch health metrics with thousands
of real users and find out.
Health Hive benchmarks your HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, cardio fitness and
VO2 max against people of similar age and BMI — and turns them into one number:
your Fitness Age.
See real-world distributions and trends, not vague averages. Understand whether
your health data is typical, improving, or unusual for someone like you.
Whether you are curious, improving your health, or simply want reassurance,
Health Hive helps turn raw health data into understanding.
------------------------------------------------
■ NEW: FITNESS AGE
Your key health metrics, benchmarked against real users, distilled into a single
age. Is your body younger than your birthday says?
 - Calculated from VO2 max, HRV, resting heart rate and more
 - Based on real data from users like you — not textbook formulas
 - Watch it change as your health improves
------------------------------------------------
■ WHAT HEALTH HIVE HELPS YOU UNDERSTAND
 - Is this normal for someone like me?
See how your Apple Watch metrics compare with people of similar age and BMI
 - See real distributions, not vague averages
Understand where you sit, not just "above" or "below" average
 - Track how your health changes over time
Follow trends and see whether you are improving compared to similar people
 - Discover meaningful patterns across health metrics
Explore how metrics like activity, fitness and recovery relate
 - Private and anonymous by design
Only aggregated summaries are shared. No names, no sign ups, no raw health data
Built from insights across 65,000+ anonymous Apple Watch users.
------------------------------------------------
■ SUPPORTED HEALTH METRICS
 - Resting heart rate
 - Heart rate variability (HRV SDNN and rMSSD)
 - Cardio fitness (VO2 max)
 - Step count and distance
 - Sleep duration, REM sleep and deep sleep
 - Blood oxygen saturation
 - Respiratory rate
 - Cardio recovery
 - Move energy, exercise time and stand time
 - Stairs/flights climbed
 - Wrist temperature
 - Breathing disturbances
 - Blood pressure (coming soon)
------------------------------------------------
■ PREMIUM
Health Hive includes an optional Premium subscription, available monthly with a
7-day free trial or as an annual plan.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions automatically
renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in App Store account
settings.
------------------------------------------------
■ PRIVACY & APPLE HEALTH
Health Hive integrates with the Apple Health app to read your health data.
Your privacy comes first:
 - Only anonymised, aggregated summaries are shared
 - You are always in control
 - You can remove your profile at any time
------------------------------------------------
■ LEARN MORE
Privacy Policy: https://www.helixapps.co.uk/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.helixapps.co.uk/health-hive-terms-of-use
Please note:
 - Health Hive reads data from the Apple Health app
 - Health Hive does not diagnose medical conditions or replace medical advice

SpyGuard VPN Pro is a reliable solution for those who value their privacy and security online. Our app provides a fast and stable VPN service, protecting your connection from unauthorized access and ensuring anonymity on the internet.
Enjoy safe internet surfing with SpyGuard VPN Pro. Our app is designed to provide maximum confidentiality and protection from online threats, giving you full control over your internet activity.
SEVERAL USER CASES AND USE CASES:
Securely connect to public Wi-Fi networks:
You often travel for work and have to use public Wi-Fi networks in cafes, airports and hotels. Are you sure they are safe and reliable? With SpyGuard VPN Pro, you can be sure that your data is protected from potential threats and intruders.
Anonymous surfing on the Internet:
Every user values their privacy and doesn't want online activity to be tracked by advertising agencies and websites. With SpyGuard VPN Pro, you can safely visit any web resources without leaving any traces of your activity.
Home Wi-Fi Network Management:
Does it happen that your internet connection has become slower? With the Wi-Fi network analysis feature in SpyGuard VPN Pro, you can detect that there are several unauthorised devices connected to the network. Now you can monitor who is using Wi-Fi and prevent unauthorised access.
MAIN FEATURES:
Fast and Stable VPN: 
Enjoy high-speed and uninterrupted internet connection thanks to our powerful VPN service.
VPN Usage Statistics: 
Track your VPN usage and monitor data consumption for more efficient internet resource management.
Wi-Fi Network Analysis: 
Check your Wi-Fi network for connected devices and ensure there is no unauthorized access.
Link Storage:
Create and store links for quick access to your favorite web resources.
Automatic Link Transition After Connection:
Convenient feature of automatic transition to pre-saved links immediately after connecting to the VPN.
SpyGuard VPN Pro is not just a VPN service, it is your reliable partner in the world of online security. Our team is constantly working on improving the app to provide you with the highest level of protection and comfort when using the internet.
Download SpyGuard VPN Pro today and discover a new level of internet security and convenience!

* Create a Profile with great photos, a bio and more
* Set your preferences for us to show you compatible Muslims
* Start swiping

* Get married!

bluejetty:00047685:ios.name: Fishing Clash: Sport Simulator
bluejetty:00047685:ios.summary: Have you wanted to catch a fish, but you couldn't go to your favorite fishing spots? Have you been dissatisfied with casual fishing games? Play Fishing Clash – a free multiplayer fishing game chosen by millions of anglers and bring fishing
bluejetty:00047685:ios.description:
Have you wanted to catch a fish, but you couldn't go to your favorite fishing spots? Have you been dissatisfied with casual fishing games? Play Fishing Clash – a free multiplayer fishing game chosen by millions of anglers and bring fishing and life together! 
Fishing Clash mixes the best features of multiplayer fishing games: the realism of simulator games, the competitiveness of sports games & the social aspect of fishing and hunting apps. With fishing spots from all over the world, it's the most realistic simulator amongst multiplayer fishing games.
How to quickly catch a fish in Fishing Clash?
• Launch the game.
• Tap the ""Cast"" button in the bottom-right corner.
• Tap the ""Strike"" button continuously to ensure the line tension indicator is in the center of the top bar.
• Enjoy the look of the fish on your fishing hook!
What's next?
• Relax, catch more fish, or win matches in exciting multiplayer duel mode.
• Take part in multiplayer challenges and championships.
• Upgrade your lure cards to level up and unlock new fishing spots.
• Conquer the fishing world!
Fishing around the world
In this multiplayer simulator, you can find a fishery almost everywhere: from the Florida Coast and the Kenai River to Lake Biwa, Galapagos, and Loch Ness. Here you can find a fishery almost everywhere in the world! Catch lots of fish like bass, carp, trout, and even some monster fish from the Deep Sea!
Collect and upgrade lure cards
Winning duels or getting top positions in championships will reward you with packs of lure cards. Collect them like in collectible card games and upgrade them to catch bigger fish! The bigger they are, the bigger the chance to win competitive multiplayer games and fishing world cup tournaments!
A simulator with real-time duels
Feel the thrill of multiplayer games and play a fishing duel against other anglers. You'll need not only skills but also your wits! Become a fishing master, get the biggest catch on your fishing hook and win every fishing battle.
Take part in live events
Every day you can hunt for amazing rewards like new rods, lure cards, and skill tokens in daily or weekly events. Pass the fishing trial, challenge angry sharks, become a catfish hunter or a traveler catching the biggest fish on a few different fishing spots!
Join or create a clan
Although Fishing Clash is a simulator at its heart, it enables ways to socialize like in free fishing apps. Meet fellow anglers, chat, exchange (or donate!) lure cards, and work together for great rewards in multiplayer Clan Wars.
The better the skills, the better your catch
All fishing spots have their skill tree. Use skill tokens to unlock new skills and get bonuses for fish of all rarities, and more!
Breathtaking fishing locations
Whether you prefer fly fishing, ice fishing, or trolling, you'll admire the look of all fishing spots. Every fishery in Fishing Clash features beautiful 3D vistas and hand-crafted fish you'll love to see on your fishing hook. It's a realistic simulator, after all.
Fresh, new content every week!
New fish, new fishery, new rods: in this realistic simulator, you can find new content every week, so there's no shortage of fish to catch! Bring fishing and life together!
Whether you're a seasoned angler or a multiplayer simulation games fan, Fishing Clash is a great casual time-killer. With dozens of fishing spots worldwide and hundreds of fish species, it offers an excellent experience for anybody looking for a realistic fishing simulator. DOWNLOAD NOW!

bluejetty:00151305:ios.description:
WELCOME TO FLOP HOUSE
Think you can run a homeless shelter without losing your cool? In Flop House, you’re the idle manager of the most chaotic “home away from home” you’ll ever build. Take in folks, hand out meals, and prove you’ve got what it takes to turn a flop into a full-on success story.
BUILD YOUR SHELTER, YOUR WAY
Start small with a beat-up homeless shelter that barely has a bed and a bathroom. Upgrade it step by step—add kitchens, showers, and all the essentials. The better your shelter gets, the more people show up to crash at your Flop House.
FROM NOTHING TO TYCOON STATUS
This isn’t just about good vibes—it’s about smart moves. Manage resources, hire staff, and unlock upgrades like a pro. With every level-up, you’re not just giving people a place to sleep—you’re building your own legend as an idle tycoon.
TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK
Cooking, cleaning, caring—it’s a lot for one guy. Luckily, you can build a team to keep your shelter running. Just don’t slack off too hard—your Flop House doesn’t manage itself!
LOVE SIMULATIONS?
If you’re into simulation games, Flop House fits right in. It mixes the fun of animal shelter games, the strategy of idle tycoon games, and the chill grind of a classic simulation game—all with its own chaotic twist. Whether you call it a shelter simulator or an idle manager, this game delivers the laughs, the upgrades, and the endless grind you’re looking for.
WHY FLOP HOUSE RULES
-Addictive shelter games mechanics with a casual idle life vibe
-Play as an idle manager running a real homeless shelter
-Build, upgrade, and expand like it’s your personal idle hotel
-Experience shelter management with a mix of humor and heart
So, ready to dive into homeless life (the game kind, not the real deal) and prove you’re the boss of the ultimate homeless shelter? Download now and start managing!
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

bluejetty:00150785:ios.description:
A Exmed é uma solução completa para a sua saúde e bem-estar! 
Veja tudo que oferecemos em um único aplicativo:
REDE MÉDICO-HOSPITALAR
Rede completa e de alta qualidade onde você poderá escolher consultas médicas, hospitais para pronto-socorro, clínicas de exames laboratoriais e de imagem.
TELEMEDICINA 24 HORAS
Atendimento médico on-line nas especialidades de clínica geral e pediatria, 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, 365 dias por ano.
BEM-ESTAR
Com a plataforma de saúde e bem-estar da Exmed você tem acesso a diversas atividades físicas disponíveis no app. Nenhuma pulseira ou outro hardware é necessário para começar. Funciona inteiramente a partir do seu telefone sem configuração adicional. Você acompanha todas as suas caminhadas e passos, esteja o telefone na mão, no bolso, na jaqueta ou na bolsa. Nosso app tem um link com o app Apple Health, dessa forma você pode visualizar os seus passos, calorias, distância e tempo ativo também no Apple Watch.
Com o app Exmed você irá descobrir que ter acesso a serviços de qualidade é mais acessível do que você imagina.

bluejetty:00062229:ios.description:
The Florida WIC Program is a supplemental nutrition program for women, infants and children under age 5.
The Florida WIC Mobile App will give WIC participants the opportunity to view upcoming appointments, view food benefits that have been issued to them in the clinic, scan UPCs while shopping at the store to see if the UPC is a WIC Approved item or not, and provide information on locations of WIC Stores and WIC Clinics across the State of Florida.
The goal of the Florida WIC Mobile App is to give participants all the information they need at their fingertips to make their shopping experience fun and easy.
To register to use the Florida WIC Mobile App, you must be a WIC participant and have been issued an eWIC card.

bluejetty:00030466:ios.description:
Thanks for visiting MonCalite.
MonCalite is a software dedicated to monitor your schedule on and only on a monthly basis.
It was developed to mimic the actual usage of schedule paper notes, with a view of your monthly schedule at a glance.
This software is suitable for those:
Who writes the plan to manage desk calendar or diary of the month view.
Who tried many scheduler but ended up using monthly view only.
Registered schedules will be synchronized with your iPhone via standard calendar app. If other calendar apps such as iCloud Calendar and MS Exchange are set to sync with the standard calendar app., they will be reflected as well.
The fonts used are relatively small but with the Retina display, you will be able to view both the time and place without a stress. In addition, you can choose the fonts from 7 different size variations for a better view.
Your daily schedule will be displayed in a popup by tapping the date.
Please try! !
Functions:
+ Monthly calendar view
+ Detailed Event view
 + Launching the maps from a location text
 + Launching the browser from a URL in notes
+ Sync with the standard calendar app.
+ Create a event from input histories.
+ Color selection per calendar (Text color also available in black and white)
+ Adding or deleting calendar in iCloud or Local
+ Event repeat
 (Yearly, Monthly, Weekly, Bi-Weekly, Daily and Custom setting)
+ Alarm
+ Beginning of the week
+ Fonts ( 4 types, 7 size variations) And bold
+ Layout of an event display ( 3 types )
+ Icon badge
+ Event copy
+ Landscape mode
+ And other Customizing...
+ Supports for URL Scheme ('com.gggatelier.moncalite://')
+ Supports iOS 15 / 16 / 17 / 18 / 26 / 27
+ Supports multitasking(Slide Over & Split View)
--------------------------
Feedback, requests are
X(Twitter): @gggatelier
mail: gggatelier.apps@gmail.com
