bluejetty:00024019:ios.name: Oak Gables Golf Club
bluejetty:00024019:ios.summary:
Welcome to Oak Gables Golf Club
Oak Course
A par 32, 2080 yard test, the oak course is a favorite amongst the staff at Oak Gables.
Its variety of Par 3 holes gives the golfer a chance to use all the clubs in their bag. The stretch of par
bluejetty:00024019:ios.description:
Welcome to Oak Gables Golf Club
Oak Course
A par 32, 2080 yard test, the oak course is a favorite amongst the staff at Oak Gables.
Its variety of Par 3 holes gives the golfer a chance to use all the clubs in their bag. The stretch of par 3 holes tests the short game as well as the long irons where precision is crucial.
If you can survive the difficult dog leg par 5 first hole you know you are on your way to a great round and even better day!
Maple Course
Perhaps the most scenic and diverse nine, the Maple Course offers a great variety of holes. Manage to navigate your way around the 2 ponds on hole #1 and you will be a leg up on your competition for the day!
The 3rd hole offers a rare but exciting chance to make a birdie with an exciting slope that pushes your ball towards the green. As you complete the 5th hole you will find yourself with an enjoyable walk (or ride) down the scenic slope to the 6th where our “valley holes” great you.
Perhaps our fan favorite hole is the 7th on the maple. A short par 4 with a tricky green allows the hope of a birdie while punishing those who take it for granted. The par 5 finishing hole offers a relaxing finish to the longer hitters.
Pine Course
The Pine Course is the favorite of the long hitters at Oak Gables. With 1 par 5 and 4 par 4 holes it allows the big hitters to let it rip and at times go for the green.
The undulating fairways offer interesting lies and scenarios to challenge all golfers. With a couple of blind shots on holes 7 and 8, course knowledge plays a role in any successful round.
Short par 3 holes 5 and 9 offer the golfer a chance to make up for any mistakes made with the chance of making a par or even a birdie.
The biggest challenge on Pine comes on the uphill par 3 #6. A long iron or even a wood is required to even come close to the green in regulation.

bluejetty:00119514:ios.description:
The Reveal ELD Logbook app is designed for businesses that use the Verizon Connect Reveal fleet management software, and helps drivers of heavy duty vehicles comply with FMCSA Hours of Service (HOS) and Electronic Logging Device (ELD) regulations. 
The Reveal ELD Logbook app gives you:
• Extensive HOS rule and exception support, including state and federal rulesets.
• ELD compliance.
• Configurable clocks for displaying different daily, break and cycle limits (or time remaining).
• Warning and alerts for approaching violations or break completions.
• Inspector mode for roadside inspections.
• The ability to schedule repairs with driver vehicle inspections reports (DVIR). 
Download the Reveal ELD Logbook app now and get the driving and regulatory data you need..
Please note: A data connection is required in order to use this app. This app requires a Bluetooth connection to the Verizon Connect Reveal hardware installed in each vehicle. It sends HOS data from your mobile device back to the Reveal system when connected to Wi-Fi, a personal hotspot or over a cellular data connection.

bluejetty:00079320:ios.summary:
3BMeteo, the official iOS app from 3bmeteo.com. The best and most accurate weather forecasts!
Download the brand new app for FREE, and find out lots of new stuff! Renewed and modern interface, charts that will help you read clearly the for
bluejetty:00079320:ios.description:
3BMeteo, the official iOS app from 3bmeteo.com. The best and most accurate weather forecasts!
Download the brand new app for FREE, and find out lots of new stuff! Renewed and modern interface, charts that will help you read clearly the forecasts in your city. The brand new photo-reports feature: you can now report the weather in your city through a photo!
And then the unchanged strength of 3bmeteo: reliable and accurate weather forecasts, updated constantly during the first 24 hours: thanks to the Nowcasting technique, using real weather data, satellite images, radar and lightning strikes. This allows a very reliable forecasts even on very small areas.
No automatic forecasts, but maintained by a staff of more than 15 meteorologists who work 365 days a year to give the best possible service. 
But it's not over! Live weather news are available in Italian language, scientific and environmental curiosity, videos made by meteorologists and a large community of users!
Unmissable automatic GPS tracking feature; you will receive forecasts automatically in your favourite cities. No need to select them every time, your Smartphone will know where you are, but especially the exact weather in that place! There is no limit in the number of favorite cities, you have a great chance of selection. 
What you get, in detail? The representation of the average day weather, synthetic forecasts for night, morning, afternoon and evening. Forecasts with detailed timetable, monitoring of seas and winds, atmospheric agents analysis, and every other possibile parameter. All with new graphic interface, clear symbolism, full in-climate weather details.
We also present the opportunity to watch real-time images from webcams. You can also join the big community, and share with your photos and videos or just report the weather conditions in your area.
If this is not enough, here is the 3BMeteo widget that will make the relationship with the weather information even easier, fast and functional. Choose the desired width and height, the widget will resize automatically and fill the space with a lot of information.
Reliable predictions require confirmations and explanations: with this app you can not only constantly check for any major changes in real time, but you can also choose to receive climate alerts and insights through push notifications. The weather journal is full of necessary information to understand the weather, written in simple language, clear and appealing as the graphical interface, very intuitive as well as easy to use.
And if Italy is too small for you, don't fear: 3bmeteo will also provide the forecasts for the entire world! In fact you can get weather forecasts all over the world, with an automatic control and up to 7 days.
3BMeteo is perfectly optimized with the latest iOS operating system, and features are available both in Italian as in English!
The app include the possibilities to remove ads, unlock regional maps and more days of data.
- The subscription service is called 3BMeteo Premium
- Length of subscription - 6 months, 3 months or 1 months based on your choice.
- Price of subscription - 8.99€ for 6 months, 4.99€ for 3 months, 1.99€ for 1 months.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Here https://www.3bmeteo.com/privacy-policy/en/ios you can find the Privacy Policy 
- here https://www.3bmeteo.com/termini-condizioni/ios/en you can find Terms of Use

goodroom（グッドルーム）は月間訪問者数50万人の国内最大級のセレクト賃貸サイトです。
丁寧にくらしのイメージができる物件紹介がユーザーから支持を得て急成長を遂げてきました。
そんなgoodroom（グッドルーム ）のお部屋探し公式アプリです。
■「goodroom」の特徴と使い方
▼おしゃれな賃貸物件が満載
リノベーション物件やデザイナーズマンションをはじめ、おしゃれなお部屋がたくさん掲載されています。
ナチュラルテイスト、北欧風インテリアやカフェ風インテリア、コンクリート打ちっぱなしの壁のお部屋など、あなたの住みたいお部屋に出会えます。
goodroomのオリジナルリノベーションブランドの賃貸物件「TOMOS（トモス）」も掲載。おしゃれです。
▼物件はgoodroomが取材して掲載
goodroomでは、ひとつひとつの物件をgoodroomスタッフが訪れて取材をしています。
入居者様の目線に立ったお部屋のポイントを独自の目線で掲載しています。写真のキレイさはもちろん、ちょっと気になるマイナスポイントもしっかり掲載されているので、初めての一人暮らしにも安心です。
※一部未取材の物件あり
▼便利な機能とカンタンな使い心地
・気になった物件は「お気に入り」に入れて、他の物件との比較ができます。
・あなたが見た部屋の他に見ている部屋をリコメンド。住みたい物件をオススメします。
・お部屋のお問い合わせや内覧予約もサロンの様にカンタンにできます。
・お問い合わせや内覧についてはアプリ上の「メッセージ機能」でスタッフとやりとりができます。
・内覧はスタッフと現地集合で気軽にお部屋を見学できます。
▼楽しいコンテンツがたくさん
goodroomがお届けする、街と暮らしにまつわるコラム「goodroom journal」のコンテンツも掲載されています。
お引っ越しの悩み解決やおしゃれなインテリアのアイデアなどが満載です。

bluejetty:00171727:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a fast and accurate thermometer.
Check the current outdoor temperature, humidity, pressure, and wind at your location.
Used by over 5,000,000 people worldwide!
Most weather apps merely display data from the nearest weather station, which could be hundreds of kilometers away and more that an hour outdated. We utilize AI technologies to combine data from multiple weather stations, providing accurate predictions for temperature, humidity, pressure, and wind at your current location in real-time.
Features:
- Shows temperature, humidity, pressure, and wind. You can use it as a thermometer, barometer, or hygrometer.
- Use your current location or choose any location on a map.
- Minimalistic design: shows only the necessary data.
- Displays Celsius and Fahrenheit degrees on a beautiful thermometer picture.
- Switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit degrees with a tap.
- Helps you quickly decide what to wear.
- Helps you keep track of the weather during heat and cold waves.
Permissions:
- Location (optional): Used to automatically show the weather for your current location. You can also choose a custom location manually from the map — no permission is required for that.
Privacy policy: https://www.singularioapps.com/thermometer-privacy/
Terms of service: https://www.singularioapps.com/thermometer-terms/

bluejetty:00063379:ios.description:
Fliptastic Pro: no watermark, no ads, and the core transitions included from day one.
Fliptastic Pro is the easy photo slideshow maker, with no watermark on your videos. Turn your photos into stunning videos with music for Reels, TikTok, YouTube and more.
WHAT YOU GET WITH PRO
• No watermark on any video, ever
• All core transitions unlocked: Ken Burns, Crossfade, Reveal, Slide In, Flip In, Zoom, Cube, Bounce and more
• Christmas effects, 17 theme songs, all 13 filters and all 6 formats included
NEW: MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Unfold iPhone Duo and Fliptastic Pro opens up: your video and its controls sit side by side on the big inner screen. Half-fold it like a mini laptop to watch your slideshow above the fold while you fine-tune it below. Folded or unfolded, in every pose, Fliptastic fits.
AI AUTO-CREATE
Let AI pick your best photos and arrange them into a slideshow for you. It looks at quality, faces, composition and lighting, right on your device, and your photos are never uploaded.
40+ TRANSITIONS & EFFECTS
17 transitions and 24 effects with hearts, falling stars, Lunar New Year and Christmas themes. Use one style, mix them up, or pick a different transition for any slide. Pro includes the core transitions and the Christmas effects; Premium adds the rest.
6 FORMATS FOR EVERY SCREEN
• 9:16 for Reels, TikTok & Stories
• 16:9 for YouTube
• 8:10 for Instagram posts
• 1:1 Square
• NEW: 4:3 Landscape and 3:4 Portrait, the classic photo shapes
MUSIC THAT FITS
Choose from 26 theme songs (17 included with Pro), or add songs you own from your music library or the Files app. Set your video's length in one tap, from 15 seconds to 3 minutes.
PHOTO EDITOR & FILTERS
13 filters, crop, rotate and flip, plus brightness, contrast, saturation and warmth. Draw or add text right on a photo, with undo and redo.
BEAUTIFUL TEXT SLIDES
Add titles and captions with handpicked decorative fonts like Billabong, Pacifico and Permanent Marker. Perfect for intros, outros and storytelling.
STOCK PHOTOS BUILT IN
Need more photos? Browse thousands of free stock images from Pexels right inside the app, or take new ones with the camera.
MORE FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
• Save unlimited projects and edit anytime
• Drag & drop to reorder photos
• Fit, Fill or Blur Fill for every photo shape
• Smooth 30 or 60 fps export
• Live Activities & Dynamic Island progress
• Save to Photos or Files, or share to your favorite apps
OPTIONAL: FLIPTASTIC PREMIUM
Want even more? Fliptastic Premium is an optional subscription that adds the 5 Galaxy transitions (Particle Sweep, Light Saber, Time Warp, Portal and Radar Scan), the Love, Starry and Lunar effects, 9 more theme songs, and all future content. Packs you bought before stay unlocked.
Fliptastic Pro: stunning slideshows in minutes.
Subscription Terms:
- Fliptastic Premium is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings
- Privacy Policy: https://fliptastic.me/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://fliptastic.me/terms

bluejetty:00143068:ios.description:
Picuki - The Ultimate Instagram Story Viewer & Content Saver
Explore Instagram like never before with Picuki, your go-to app for viewing and saving Instagram content. Whether you want to catch up on stories, browse highlights, watch reels, or keep your favorite posts - Picuki makes it effortless.
▸ WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH PICUKI
- View Stories & Highlights
Browse through Instagram stories and highlights from your favorite creators, celebrities, and brands. Never miss a moment from the accounts you love.
- Save Photos & Videos
Keep high-quality photos and videos directly to your device. Build your personal collection of inspiring content from Instagram.
- Watch & Save Reels
Enjoy trending reels and save them for offline viewing. Perfect for entertainment on the go.
- Browse Profiles
Explore profiles, view posts, check followers, and discover new content creators to follow.
- Keep Profile Pictures
Save profile photos in full resolution - great for contacts or creating mood boards.
▸ WHY MILLIONS CHOOSE PICUKI
- Simple & Intuitive - Clean interface designed for ease of use
- Fast Saving - Keep content in seconds with just a tap
- High Quality - Original resolution photos and videos
- Organized Library - Keep your saved content neatly organized
- Regular Updates - Constantly improved with new features
- Lightweight - Minimal storage space required
▸ PERFECT FOR
→ Content creators seeking inspiration for their next post
→ Social media managers tracking trends and competitors
→ Fans who want to keep content from favorite influencers
→ Anyone who loves discovering great Instagram content
→ Users who want to preserve memorable moments forever
▸ KEY FEATURES
● Story Viewer - Watch stories anytime
● Highlights Browser - Explore saved highlight collections
● Reels Saver - Keep trending short videos
● Post Saver - Save photos and carousel posts
● Profile Viewer - Browse any public profile
● HD Quality - Full resolution media saving
● Quick Search - Find profiles instantly
● Clean Interface - No clutter, just content
▸ HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Picuki and search for any Instagram username
2. Browse their stories, highlights, reels, and posts
3. Tap on any content to view it in full screen
4. Hit the save button to keep what you love
5. Access your saved content anytime in your library
▸ SAVE INSTAGRAM CONTENT EASILY
Picuki makes it simple to save the Instagram content you love. Whether it's a stunning photo, an inspiring reel, or a story you want to remember - just tap and save. Your favorite Instagram moments, always available offline.
Download Picuki now and transform how you experience Instagram!

bluejetty:00030477:ios.description:
Simplify scanning with DocScan: The effortless way to turn your iPhone into a feature-rich PDF scanner and QR code reader!
DocScan is your pocket-sized powerhouse for scanning and editing documents, extracting texts, converting scans to PDFs, and deciphering QR codes with ease and precision. With DocScan, managing paperwork is a breeze, whether you're a professional on the move, a student juggling assignments, or simply organizing personal documents.
FEATURE-PACKED PDF SCANNER
- Quickly digitize documents: Scan receipts, notes, invoices, business cards, and more. Effortlessly export them as high-quality PDF or JPG files.
- Multi-Page PDFs: Assemble multi-page documents with ease. Perfect for reports, presentations, and lengthy contracts.
- Signing: Sign any scanned document with your signature. Create and save custom signatures for easy use later.
- Edit documents easily: markup, highlight, blur, add formatted text, rotate, crop, grayscale, and remove pages.
- OCR (optical character recognition): Extract a part of a scanned text and paste it where you need it.
- Import smartly: Automatically detect and import document photos, handwritten notes, and receipts from your photo library into dedicated folders. Simply select a category, and DocScan will sort and sync everything for you.
- Organize files in folders: Streamline your workflow by grouping your business, study, personal, and other documents in dedicated folders.
YOUR GO-TO QR CODE READER:
Need to scan a QR code? DocScan handles that seamlessly, making it your all-in-one scanning solution.
SIGN AND SEND
DocScan allows you to scan any paper document and add your signature for easy sending as a PDF.
SAFE AND SECURE
With DocScan, your documents remain confidential. Keep your sensitive PDFs protected from prying eyes.
AI-ENHANCED SCANNING
Advanced AI technology automatically detects borders, enhances sharpness, and corrects perspective—ensuring your scans are clear and readable.
PDF SCANNER FOR EVERY NEED
Whether it's a single receipt or a stack of pages, DocScan caters to all scanning scenarios. It's the document scanner that adapts to you.
USER-FRIENDLY INTERFACE
Enjoy a sleek, intuitive interface that makes scanning documents as simple as snapping a photo.
WHY CHOOSE DOCSCAN?
- Fast and reliable PDF scanning
- Signing and signature management
- Powerful editing tools
- Automatic AI importing
- Optical character recognition
- Advanced AI for perfect scans
- QR code reader integrated
- Secure document management
Experience the next level of scanning with PRO features:
- Scan and share unlimited PDFs
- Sign any document in seconds
- Scan and save multiple page documents
- Extract text with OCR
- Go ad-free for a cleaner interface
Languages supported by OCR: English (United States), French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Cantonese (Simplified), Cantonese (Traditional), Korean, Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai, Vietnamese.

bluejetty:00086694:ios.description:
Touch Portal is the #1 All-in-One Remote Control Macro and Stream app for Phones and Tablets with a deck of buttons as a board on your desk and workspace.
You will get the following features:
- OBS STUDIO INTEGRATION (OBS web-socket required)
- STREAMLABS OBS INTEGRATION
- STREAMELEMENTS OBS.LIVE INTEGRATION (OBS web-socket required)
- ADOBE PHOTOSHOP INTEGRATION
- ADOBE LIGHTROOM CLASSIC INTEGRATION
- REMOTE CONTROL PC AND/OR MAC
- XSPLIT INTEGRATION
- TWITCH INTEGRATION
- HOME AUTOMATION
- PHILIPS HUE INTEGRATION
- MACRO BUTTONS
- SMART TOUCH BUTTONS
- CUSTOMIZABLE LOOK AND FEEL
- COMMUNITY-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT
Touch Portal is a companion app to control a PC or a Mac by using a deck of buttons to improve the workflow & productivity of game streamers, content creators and professionals.
Touch Portal gives you all the essential controls you’d need, we keep adding more features every update! With Touch Portal you are allowed up to 110 unique buttons per page for the Pro version, not to mention you could use the pages to even increase this!
Use it as a Macro Deckboard or Shortcut Board for your video and photo editing software and edit faster and more efficient.
Use cases:
- Game streamers:
Stream your games while having total control of your broadcast overlays with a deck of buttons.
- Video editors:
Edit your videos faster, easier and smarter with a fully customizable page with the buttons you use most often on your Touch Portal deck. Create macros and shortcut buttons to optimize your workflow.
- Photo editors:
Edit your photos faster, you don't have to learn all the shortcuts the photo editing software gives you, just add the action you want to the "Touch Portal Desktop" app and start editing.
- Professionals:
Create your own customizable page to improve your productivity and workflow. The app is an extension of your keyboard, with much more features.
IMPORTANT!:
* You need to download the "Touch Desktop" app on your PC or your Mac to use this app. Please go to our website to download it from our website.
https://www.touch-portal.com/
Please join us at our Discord server for the fastest help. We are daily available on discord, our community is also willing to help you further with your Touch Portal experience.
Discord server: https://discord.gg/MgxQb8r

Imagine you could play our game in different versions such as
bluejetty:00027567:android.description:
Jibi Land : Princess Town is the new world for the Jibi Land pretend play dollhouse game, where we present a farming world for you to play in with an open-ended style of play. 
Imagine you could play our game in different versions such as pets town or like the princess, hospital, and salon versions. However, you'll never know just how cute it is until you try the version with pets, town, and farming.
We offer beautiful graphics in our series set in the pet town world and farming theme, allowing you to take care of your pets and cultivate your garden yard.
How to play:
Our game is a bit like playing make-believe or with a farm pet town. There are no strict rules to follow; it's a space where kids can let their imaginations run wild. Simply pick your favorite character - maybe it's 'My Farming' - and use your imagination to craft your very own story."
Game Feature:

bluejetty:00082708:ios.name: xHP Flashtool
bluejetty:00082708:ios.summary: xHP Flashtool is the worldwide first and complete Tuning solution for your ZF6HP, ZF8HP Automatic or 7-Speed DCT transmission. xHP is the only tool that focuses fully on getting the best from your Auto-Transmission and is the worldwide lead
bluejetty:00082708:ios.description:
xHP Flashtool is the worldwide first and complete Tuning solution for your ZF6HP, ZF8HP Automatic or 7-Speed DCT transmission. xHP is the only tool that focuses fully on getting the best from your Auto-Transmission and is the worldwide leading solution for the best vehicles from Bavaria! xHP put's the power to fully customize your automatic transmission at your hands. Connect your Apple iPhone, IPad or Mac M1 to your car and customize by yourself or choose from pre-defined OTS maps. 
The ZF Autos are used throughout the whole range, from the 1-Series hatchbacks, to the mighty Alpina and M cars!
While the hardware stays widely the same throughout all applications and is mainly divided in only 2 types (6HP19/21 and 6HP26/28 for 6-Speed, 8HP45/50/51 and 8HP70/75/76 for 8-Speed), the software inside the controller makes it possible to adapt the transmission, to every vehicle and mimic a wide range of driver styles. Smooth and comfy in the Luxury applications, the same transmission can be tweaked to deliver snap-on take-off behavior, surprisingly fast shift times and even race-style throttle blips on downshifts.
Tweaking your transmission is not only about getting quicker, or holding more power. An automatic transmission is deeply involved into vehicle dynamics and contributes very much to the overall driving experience. From crawling in traffic, over city driving, to taking your vehicle to the drag strip or a race track, the TCU widely defines how your car feels. Like everyone drives different with a manual, the maps inside the TCU hide the secrets to tweak your automatic transmission to your personal likings and finally experience what was once promised in the glossy brochure: Sheer driving pleasure!
For a seamless start, please read the manual on needed hardware and prerequisites: https://www.xhpflashtool.com
To connect to your car, you have many options: xHP Wifi Adapter (blue), Wifi Thor Adapter, MHD Wifi Adapter (black and orange) or a standard OBD INPA USB or ENET cable! Please check our Connect-Diagram on our website to get further information and sources! 
https://www.xhpflashtool.com/connect_diagram/

bluejetty:00187305:ios.description:
HighRadius radiusOne™ Network is the world’s first network enabling digital collaboration between supplier A/R processes and buyer A/P processes. While credit-to-cash technology provides process level automation, the radiusOne™ Network focuses on filling the gaps in supplier-buyer collaboration created by standalone technology. Built on top of the HighRadius Integrated Receivables platform for credit-to-cash, radiusOne™ closes gaps in collaboration between buyers and suppliers for processes across credit, billing, collections, payment processing and dispute resolution.
The RadiusOne mobile app enables in settlement of open A/R transactions with incoming payment through various payment methods like Credit Card & Checks.
Key Features:
1. Remote Deposit Capture allows you to scan checks and remittances, and create digital deposits. The digital deposits can then be transmitted to your bank via a secure Internet.
2. Enable companies to accept credit card payments across multiple origination points natively from their ERP system.
3. Secure tokenization capability via transaction processors and eliminate storage of sensitive transaction information within your environment.
4. The PCI-DSS-compliant solution uses cloud technology to leverage processor tokenization services
Benefits to Suppliers:
1. Seamless payment processing: Integration of payment and remittance information with your ERP ensures straight-through cash application
2. Lower payment processing costs: Simplify e-payments for your customers by enabling integration with their accounting systems

The RadiusOne mobile app enables in settlement of open A/R transactions with incoming payment through various payment methods like Credit Card & Checks.
Key Features:
1.     Remote Deposit Capture allows you to scan checks and remittances, and create digital deposits. The digital deposits can then be transmitted to your bank via a secure Internet.

2.     Enable companies to accept credit card payments across multiple origination points natively from their ERP system.

3.     Secure tokenization capability via transaction processors and eliminate storage of sensitive transaction information within your environment.

4.     The PCI-DSS-compliant solution uses cloud technology to leverage processor tokenization services

 
Benefits to Suppliers:
1.     Seamless payment processing: Integration of payment and remittance information with your ERP ensures straight-through cash application

2.     Lower payment processing costs: Simplify e-payments for your customers by enabling integration with their accounting systems

bluejetty:00077304:ios.description:
This new comprehensive wellness tool is your guide to daily sessions of breathing exercises, cold exposure, and mind-powering practices. Witness a transformative impact on your life, leading to increased energy, reduced stress, better sleep, and expedited recovery. It is more than just a breathing app, it is your guide to the Wim Hof Method practice and a stress-free life.
Discover the transformative power of the Wim Hof Method, backed by extensive scientific research. This unique approach to wellness influences your immune and autonomic nervous systems, along with the critical mind-body connection, bolstering physical strength and mental resilience. Across decades of dancing with the cold, the Iceman set 26 world records and broke a Guinness World Record 18 times. Grounded in rigorous studies, the Wim Hof Method isn't just a wellness practice; it's a scientifically validated pathway to enhanced health, well-being, and resilience. Experience its impact today..
BREATHING EXERCISES
• Increase energy, alkalize the body, stimulate the vagus nerve, activate brown fat, and achieve calm sleep through various guided breathing techniques
• Immerse yourself in the breathwork practices with the help of Wim Hof's voice, and connect with your breath
• Suit your needs with the fully customized Guided Breathing bubble - pre-set the rounds and connect to your Spotify or Apple Music playlist
COLD EXPOSURE
• Boost immunity and reduce inflammation with cold water therapy practices
• Have cold become your warm friend through your daily Guided Cold Showers, Guided Ice Baths, Feet, or Hands-in-Ice practices!
• Increase your cold tolerance with the 20-Day Cold Shower Challenge and watch your sleep deepen effortlessly
POWER OF THE MIND
• Improve focus, resilience, and discipline with the power of the mind exercises
• Create routines that support your well-being with Wim's Challenges
• Increase strength and flexibility with Body weight and Equipment exercises
GUIDED MEDITATIONS
• Find your equilibrium among the business of modern life with Guided Meditations directly from Wim
AUDIO
• Find out what is on Wim´s mind through Contemplations
• Immerse yourself in real stories through the Iceman Speaks 
• Discover the method through the 30-Day Audio Challenge
E-LEARNING & CONTENT
• Access your purchased Video Courses all in one place
• Explore the exciting world of Wim through our Comic
RESULTS & CALENDAR
• Track your swift improvement over time with a clear Calendar & Bar Chart overview for each exercise
• Cold plunge, breathwork, and exercise counter
• Every step of your journey is celebrated with achievement Badges, serving as motivational milestones
COMMUNITY
• Connect with our global community for encouragement by sharing your progress with fellow Hofers
• Celebrate your commitment with your friends and family by keeping them up to date with your achievements
“A cold shower a day keeps the doctor away.” Wim Hof
Elevate your sense of calm, enhance mindfulness, and achieve mental clarity and focus like the Iceman with the Wim Hof Method app.
Subscription Terms & Conditions
We offer Supporter Monthly and Supporter Yearly subscription plans, both give you access to the same premium features. Both subscription plans renew automatically and are charged either on a monthly or a yearly basis, respectively. A 7-day free trial is available for the Supporter Yearly plan. Pricing per country may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

bluejetty:00186937:ios.description:
Reading on YOUR TERMS - Anywhere, Anytime, Anything
Welcome to Aloud!, the ultimate Text-to-Speech (TTS) reader that transforms your content into audio.
Turn your documents, articles, and eBooks into a personal audio library. Aloud! is the perfect voice reader for your commute, workout, or study session. It’s a powerful accessibility tool for anyone who needs reading support, and an essential productivity app for those who want to give their eyes a rest.
■ HEAR PDF, DOCX, EPUB & WEB PAGES
Finally, a reader that handles everything. From critical PDF reports and Word (DOCX) documents to your favorite EPUB or Mobi eBook. Use our integrated browser to instantly import and listen to web pages, saving them for offline access. No more format juggling.
■ BACKGROUND & OFFLINE PLAY
Aloud! works where you do. With true offline playback for all saved files, you're never limited by a connection. Continue listening with your screen locked or while using other apps—your audio plays seamlessly in the background.
■ AUTO PROGRESS TRACKING
Never lose your place. Aloud! automatically remembers your position in every document and article. Pick up right where you left off, every single time.
■ YOUR VOICE, YOUR CHOICE
Tailor your listening experience. Adjust the speech rate and pitch to find a voice that's perfect for you. Follow along with synchronized word highlighting, an essential tool for study, proofreading, and improving reading comprehension.
THE ALOUD! ADVANTAGE:
• Trusted Since 2014: A decade of continuous improvement and user-focused updates.
• Universal Format Support: Our powerful engine supports PDF, Microsoft Office (DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX), iWorks Pages, OpenOffice (ODT, ODP), EPUB, MOBI, AZW, FB2, TXT, RTF, HTML, and even files inside ZIP, RAR, & 7Z archives.
• Accessibility Focused: A vital tool for users with dyslexia, visual impairments, and other reading challenges.
Stop reading, start listening. Download Aloud! today and reimagine your content.

■ BACKGROUND & OFFLINE PLAY
Aloud! works where you do. With true offline playback for all saved files, you're never limited by a connection. Continue listening with your screen locked or while using other apps—your audio plays seamlessly in the background.

■ AUTO PROGRESS TRACKING
Never lose your place. Aloud! automatically remembers your position in every document and article. Pick up right where you left off, every single time.

■ YOUR VOICE, YOUR CHOICE
Tailor your listening experience. Adjust the speech rate and pitch to find a voice that's perfect for you. Follow along with synchronized word highlighting, an essential tool for study, proofreading, and improving reading comprehension.

• Trusted Since 2014: A decade of continuous improvement and user-focused updates.

• Accessibility Focused: A vital tool for users with dyslexia, visual impairments, and other reading challenges.

Stop reading, start listening. Download Aloud! today and reimagine your content.

ClerkOne brings togethe
bluejetty:00200219:ios.description:
ClerkOne 2027: ACC/PCC Exam Preparation
Prepare for the 2027 New York State Associate Court Clerk and Principal Court Clerk promotional exams with ClerkOne 2027, a comprehensive study app built for court employees.
ClerkOne brings together study notes, law highlights, practice questions, flashcards, study aids and games to help you review the exam material, reinforce what you learn and prepare for a high score.
All copyrighted study content in ClerkOne was developed by Angelo Tropea, a retired Deputy Chief Clerk in the New York State Unified Court System. Since 1985, Mr. Tropea has been developing notes, questions, quizzes and review materials to help court employees prepare for promotional clerk exams. His materials have helped thousands of candidates prepare and achieve high scores.
Study and practice with ClerkOne
- Study Notes and plain-English Law Highlights organized by article of law
- More than 5,000 practice and review questions, including over 3,000 multiple-choice and True/False questions, over 1,300 review questions in the Notes, and 780+ additional Four Squares questions
- Create custom tests, review questions and bookmark questions for later
- Create and organize flashcards from Notes, Law Highlights and Important Facts
- Review Civil, Criminal and Family Important Facts
- Study legal terminology and use Mnemonic Lab to practice important lists
- Use the Report Card to monitor your study coverage, quiz performance and areas for further review
- Reinforce what you learn with five games: Clerk Quest, Ring the Bell!, Four Squares Challenge, Courthouse Codebreaker and Final Appeal
- Track top game results on your personal scoreboard
ClerkOne 2027 is designed as a mobile study companion for phones and tablets. The Notes are formatted for on-screen study and are intended for use within the app, not printing.
The Law Highlights are study tools that have been rewritten, shortened and clarified for exam preparation. They are not official legal text or legal advice. When you want to read the full text, the app provides convenient links to public sources, including the New York State Senate and New York Courts websites.
ClerkOne 2027 combines structured study, repetition, review and interactive practice in one professional exam preparation app.
The ClerkOne app was developed by Best Way Media Group, Inc. All copyrighted study content was developed by Angelo Tropea.
